monsters.name: frilled lizard
monsters.description: A lizard with a giant and colourful fringe folded around its neck. It flares its impressive frill at its victims while hissing angrily.

monsters.name: iguana
monsters.description: A green lizard with strong jaws and sharp teeth, prized for its flesh.

monsters.name: komodo dragon
monsters.description: An enormous monitor lizard more than capable of preying on large animals.

monsters.name: basilisk
monsters.description: A crested lizard of middling size with a terrible petrifying gaze.

monsters.name: bat
monsters.description: A large grey bat that, despite being herbivorous, is quite aggressive. It is myopic and uses echolocation to navigate.

monsters.name: fire bat
monsters.description: A bat whose leathery body burns with a hot flame.

monsters.name: ball python
monsters.description: A small snake that can augment its bite by constricting small creatures.

monsters.name: adder
monsters.description: A common dungeon snake, a species of troglodytic reptile commonly found in subterranean spaces.

monsters.name: water moccasin
monsters.description: A largish venomous brown snake. It usually lives near water, and is an able swimmer.

monsters.name: black mamba
monsters.description: An astonishingly fast tropical snake whose bite bears a deadly venom.

monsters.name: anaconda
monsters.description: A very large snake that moves with startling swiftness. It kills not by poison but by constricting its prey.

monsters.name: sea snake
monsters.description: A brightly coloured snake, very comfortable in the water. It has a highly potent venomous bite.

monsters.name: rat
monsters.description: A dirty rodent that has grown large and aggressive in the dungeon environment.

monsters.name: river rat
monsters.description: A rodent with hair of a most peculiar green colour, and a powerful bite. It tends to form great swarms with its kin.

monsters.name: hell rat
monsters.description: A unusually large rat. Its weird, knobbly orange skin glows with the infernal energies that spawned it.

monsters.name: quokka
monsters.description: A pesky little marsupial that is a bit like a rat, but not quite.

monsters.name: jackal
monsters.description: A small canine scavenger. Packs of jackals roam the underworld, searching for carrion to devour.

monsters.name: hound
monsters.description: A fearsome hunting dog, lithe and alert.

monsters.name: wolf
monsters.description: A strong wild canine, with sharp teeth and a healthy appetite.

monsters.name: warg
monsters.description: A particularly evil-looking wolf, usually found in the company of orcs.

monsters.name: hell hound
monsters.description: A huge black dog with glowing red eyes, and smoke pouring from its fanged mouth.

monsters.name: hog
monsters.description: A large even-toed ungulate. Like human beings, it is omnivorous, intelligent, and nearly hairless.

monsters.name: hell hog
monsters.description: An extremely large and aggressive swine, bred in Hell, whose breath burns its foes to ash.

monsters.name: holy swine
monsters.description: A rare celestial version of a usually filthy animal, said to be an angelic being who succumbed to hostile magic.

monsters.name: tyrant leech
monsters.description: An exceptionally aggressive blood-sucking annelid that thrives in swamps and marshlands.

monsters.name: alligator
monsters.description: An aggressive crocodilian with great crunching jaws full of sharp teeth.

monsters.name: crocodile
monsters.description: A crocodilian with powerful jaws.

monsters.name: hydra
monsters.description:
A great and nightmarish lacertilian beast. It has many heads, and the potential to grow many more!

Hitting it with any bladed weapon bigger than a short blade risks lopping a head off and causing two more to grow in its place. Very large claws, such as trolls', are long enough to do the same. Only a weapon branded with flame will cauterise the wound and prevent more heads from growing.

monsters.name: yak
monsters.description: A common dungeon yak, covered in shaggy yak hair and bearing a nasty pair of yak horns.

monsters.name: death yak
monsters.description: A larger and beefier relative of the common dungeon yak. Its little red eyes gleam with hunger for living flesh.

monsters.name: catoblepas
monsters.description: A sluggish black buffalo, its hide encrusted with dull scales. It carries its hog-like head just above the ground, protected by a stiff mane of bristles. Its fearsome breath turns flesh into stone.

monsters.name: elephant
monsters.description: A large, thick-hided pachyderm. It crushes its foes and then thrashes them with its trunk.

monsters.name: dire elephant
monsters.description: A huge pachyderm, wilder and fiercer than normal elephants, with a very thick hide, powerful legs, and a memory to die for.

monsters.name: hellephant
monsters.description: An abhorrent pachyderm, descendant of demons, burning from within with the fires of Hell.

monsters.name: manticore
monsters.description: A hideous cross-breed, bearing the features of a human and a lion, with great bat-like wings. Its tail bristles with spikes that can be loosed at potential prey.

monsters.name: hippogriff
monsters.description: A large creature with the hindquarters of a horse and the wings, head and talons of a great eagle. As popular heraldric creatures, some fortresses may keep them as symbols and defenders alike, where they in turn launch intruders into the waiting blades of their masters.

monsters.name: bullfrog
monsters.description: An unusually aggressive amphibian that pursues its prey with rapid hops. Its croak is loud and distinctive, but unlike its smaller counterparts above ground, the dungeon bullfrog is as large as it sounds.

monsters.name: cane toad
monsters.description: A hideous toad whose thick, warty hide is covered in poison glands. Unlike its smaller above-ground relatives, this dungeon-dweller is the size of a wolf.

monsters.name: blink frog
monsters.description: A species of frog that possesses the ability to blink at will. It can blink itself close to its intended prey, or blink away to escape harm. It is commonly found in packs.

monsters.name: polar bear
monsters.description: A bear covered in glistening white fur, habituated to cold conditions. Like all ursines, it will become enraged if badly hurt.

monsters.name: black bear
monsters.description: A small black bear. Like all ursines, it will become enraged if badly hurt.

monsters.name: ribbon worm
monsters.description: A giant annelid, glistening with slime, with unusually large teeth. It expels fragments of its own innards to ensnare unsuspecting prey.

monsters.name: brain worm
monsters.description: A slimy fluorescent worm with a greatly distended head. This creature feeds on others' intellect as it squirms through unworldly grime.

monsters.name: wyvern
monsters.description: A dragon-like creature with a long, sharply pointed tail. Although smaller and less formidable than true dragons, it is nonetheless a foe to be reckoned with.

monsters.name: lindwurm
monsters.description: A small serpentine dragon with a pair of strong forelimbs. Its thick scales give off an eerie red glow.

monsters.name: rime drake
monsters.description: A small but dangerous dragon. Its breath is visible even on the warmest days.

monsters.name: swamp drake
monsters.description: A small and slimy dragon, covered in swamp muck and giving off a terrible stench.

monsters.name: death drake
monsters.description: A dark and baleful minor dragon. It breathes a lethally potent miasma from its pestilential maw.

monsters.name: steam dragon
monsters.description: A relatively small grey dragon, with a resilient-looking scaly hide and steam pouring from its mouth.

monsters.name: acid dragon
monsters.description: A small dragon with brilliant yellow scales, its mouth dripping with corrosive slime.

monsters.name: swamp dragon
monsters.description: A slimy dragon, its gnarly hide covered in swamp muck. Noxious gases dribble from its snout.

monsters.name: fire dragon
monsters.description: A great reptilian beast with powerful claws on its limbs, covered in thick red scales and with two huge bat-like wings. Little trails of smoke spill from its toothy maw.

monsters.name: ice dragon
monsters.description: A white, frost-coated dragon. Snowflakes trickle from its nostrils.

monsters.name: shadow dragon
monsters.description: A great umbral dragon, radiating evil and death. Its breath reeks of the grave.

monsters.name: storm dragon
monsters.description: A powerful dragon with a hide of thick matte scales almost like blue rubber, and enormous scaly wings crackling with sparks.

monsters.name: bone dragon
monsters.description: A mighty undead abomination, pieced together from the broken bones of many dragons by powerful necromantic magic. The collective despair of such desecrated dragons gives this horror its own undying breath weapon, in billowing clouds of excruciating misery.

monsters.name: quicksilver dragon
monsters.description: A long and sinuous dragon, seemingly more neck and tail than anything else. Its skin shines like molten mercury, magical energies arc from its pointed snout, and it moves with terrifying swiftness.

monsters.name: iron dragon
monsters.description: A very heavy, slow and apparently flightless dragon. It is named for its scales, which are so tough they might be iron. Small flakes of metal trail from its nostrils.

monsters.name: golden dragon
monsters.description: A great winged dragon covered in shining golden scales. Legends say that its blood runs both hot and cold, and is venomous to boot.

monsters.name: pearl dragon
monsters.description: A dragon consecrated to the holy divine powers. Its breath is blessed fire, and its claws sear its victims with divine wrath.

monsters.name: endoplasm
monsters.description: A glob of grey sludge that has somehow developed a rudimentary awareness and limited motility. It periodically draws heat from its surroundings to sustain itself, freezing enemies unfortunate enough to be adjacent at the time.

monsters.name: jelly
monsters.description: A pulsating mass of acidic protoplasm.

monsters.name: colossal amoeba
monsters.description: An unfathomably massive pile of mystic pulsating protoplasm. The slightest threat will cause it to undergo rapid weaponised mitosis, rapidly overwhelming potential meals in a cytoplasmic tidal wave.

monsters.name: azure jelly
monsters.description: An extremely cold blob of bright blue cytoplasm, forming bits of frost in the air around it.

monsters.name: acid blob
monsters.description: A lump of sickly pustulent flesh, dripping with lethal acid.

monsters.name: slime creature
monsters.description: An icky glob of slime that slithers along the ground. It can merge with other slime creatures to become dramatically more dangerous, and is especially likely to do so in confined spaces.

monsters.name: glass eye
monsters.description: A floating eyeball formed from living glass. Only the divine Jiyva could form such a curious servitor.

monsters.name: eye of draining
monsters.description: A hovering horror, rare and unnatural even amongst servitor eyes, radiating baleful energies. They monitor the flow of chaotic life and ever-present death for the divine Jiyva.

monsters.name: shining eye
monsters.description: A strangely deformed floating eyeball, pulsating with flesh-twisting energy.

monsters.name: eye of devastation
monsters.description: A huge eyeball, encased in a levitating globe of incandescent energy.

monsters.name: great orb of eyes
monsters.description: A levitating ball, covered in malignant eyes and humming with eldritch energies. Many is the adventurer ripped limb from limb by its dreadful eyeteeth.

monsters.name: glowing orange brain
monsters.description: A huge pulsating brain, floating just off the floor and glowing with mutagenic energies. It radiates a constant psychic influence upon nearby allies, using its vast intellect to empower their spellcasting abilities.

monsters.name: dancing weapon
monsters.description: A weapon enchanted to dance through the air and attack under its own power.

monsters.name: harpy
monsters.description: A bird-like creature with a human face that roams the coasts endlessly, feared for its sharp claws and harrying strikes.

monsters.name: raven
monsters.description: A jet-black corvid with a nasty beak and a reputation for heralding bad luck. Most ornithologists consider this a baseless stereotype; the rest are still recovering from a series of staggeringly unlikely accidents.

monsters.name: fire crab
monsters.description: A variety of crab prized for its brilliantly jewelled shell. The rarity of the shells is only enhanced by its almost supernatural ability to wade through molten lava and expel massive quantities of flames.

monsters.name: butterfly
monsters.description: A large, brightly coloured butterfly with beautifully patterned wings, fluttering incongruously through the darkness of the cave.

monsters.name: killer bee
monsters.description: A giant bee, bearing a deadly barb which can sting repeatedly.

monsters.name: queen bee
monsters.description: A ruler of a swarm of bees, even larger and more dangerous than its many offspring.

monsters.name: vampire mosquito
monsters.description: A mosquito that has fed upon tainted blood and been transformed into a revolting and pestilent undead insect, seeking to drain its victims to the last drop.

monsters.name: hornet
monsters.description: A buzzing hornet with a vicious stinger dripping with paralytic poison.

monsters.name: boulder beetle
monsters.description: A grey beetle with an almost impenetrable rocky carapace. When at some distance from its foe, a boulder beetle is capable of rolling at high speed, attempting to crash into its target for heavy damage.

monsters.name: assassin centipede
monsters.description:
A living weapon whose forcipules are dagger-sharp and reach is long. Its sting can deliver crippling toxins to those it strikes and at higher levels of enchantment, can even briefly slow or paralyse foes.

After performing a moderate number of attacks with this, it will separate itself from your body to attack foes independently for a short while before dying.

monsters.name: wolf spider
monsters.description: A hairy fast-moving hunting spider with vicious mandibles, the size of a wolf. It roams the dungeon in search of prey, which it kills with its deadly venom.

monsters.name: jumping spider
monsters.description: A spider which weaves webs between its front legs and leaps at its prey, ensnaring them. The speed with which it leaps is almost supernatural.

monsters.name: orb spider
monsters.description: An eerily glowing spider with strands of pure energy emerging from its spinnerets. It seems to want to keep its distance.

monsters.name: tarantella
monsters.description: A small but greatly-feared spider. Its touch alone causes victims to break into a frenzied dance.

monsters.name: redback
monsters.description: A vicious black spider with a splash of red on its swollen abdomen. Its mandibles drip with lethal poison.

monsters.name: scorpion
monsters.description: A loathsome arachnid, armed to the teeth. Its body is covered in a thick carapace, its tail is tipped by a venomous sting, and its forelimbs are equipped with a pair of sharp grasping claws.

monsters.name: emperor scorpion
monsters.description: A giant scorpion with a massive barb on its tail dripping deadly venom. It is one of the largest arachnids known.

monsters.name: ghost moth
monsters.description: A vile interdimensional predator that feeds on the life force of living beings. It resembles an enormous, spiny moth.

monsters.name: moth of wrath
monsters.description: A moth known for its ability to inspire rage by touching its foes, or merely gazing at its friends. For some inexplicable reason, it was eradicated from the surface centuries ago.

monsters.name: demonic crawler
monsters.description: A hellish insectoid creature, fueled by some infernal power that constantly regrows its chitinous segments. Nothing short of a lethal blow will stop it for long.

monsters.name: snapping turtle
monsters.description: A belligerent testudine with an armoured carapace. Its neck is surprisingly extensible and can reach out and bite from afar.

monsters.name: alligator snapping turtle
monsters.description: A particularly large and nasty snapping turtle. Like its smaller relative, it can reach out and bite from afar.

monsters.name: felid
monsters.description: A feline creature that has been granted sentience by magical means. It uses the gift of speech to demand milk, treats and catnip.

monsters.name: vampire bat
monsters.description: A large black bat with vicious fangs that feeds on blood. It is the preferred form for vampires in disguise.

monsters.name: demigod
monsters.description: A human-like figure with an aura of power betraying its divine ancestry.

monsters.name: demonspawn
monsters.description: A half-mortal, half-demonic creature, with its hellish heritage asserting itself through a certain devilish cast to its features.

monsters.name: gargoyle
monsters.description: A granite statue of a hideous winged monster, somehow brought to life.

monsters.name: war gargoyle
monsters.description: A rare type of gargoyle, constructed from a solid steel statue and imbued with vicious strength, speed, and weaponised breath.

monsters.name: molten gargoyle
monsters.description: A hideous molten stone statue come to life, with flames licking across its body.

monsters.name: ugly thing
monsters.description: An ugly thing. According to legend, it is the otherworldly spawn of a wizard's breeding experiment. Yuck.

monsters.name: very ugly thing
monsters.description: A very ugly thing. According to legend, it is the otherworldly spawn of a wizard's breeding experiment. Double yuck!

monsters.name: ice beast
monsters.description: A terrible creature, formed of snow and crystalline ice. Its feet leave puddles of icy water on the floor.

monsters.name: sky beast
monsters.description: A strange aerial creature formed of fleshy clouds and electric feathers. It commands the faint wind currents of the Dungeon with every strike, which will buffet its victims in dramatic correlation to the amount of open air around said prey.

monsters.name: guardian sphinx
monsters.description: A fearsome aged hybrid with a woman's head, a lion's body, and the wings of an eagle. It solemnly guards the temples and treasures of the Dungeon with a multitude of mind-clouding maledictions.

monsters.name: Orb Guardian
monsters.description:
A huge, glowing, four-limbed purple creature with heightened senses, created by the Orb itself. It guards the Orb with enormous punctiliousness and violence, and its death will alert any Boundless Tesseracts on the level to begin creating reinforcements.

Unless the Orb has already been disturbed, it will refuse to abandon its duty by leaving the floor.

monsters.name: iron golem
monsters.description: A large, ponderous and very solid statue of metal, given the power of locomotion through some esoteric means.

monsters.name: crystal guardian
monsters.description: An intricate animated statue made of heavily ensorcelled crystal that is immune to most forms of magic. The spells which created it are so powerful that even flesh may start to crystallise around any fragments that become embedded in it - leaving its foes brittle and vulnerable.

monsters.name: toenail golem
monsters.description: A huge animated statue made entirely from toenail clippings. Some people just have too much time on their hands.

monsters.name: electric golem
monsters.description: An animated figure made completely of electricity, created in some demented wizard's experiment.

monsters.name: orb of fire
monsters.description: A globe of raw primordial fire, capable of impressive pyrotechnics and of twisting the very flesh of creatures who come into its ken.

monsters.name: earth elemental
monsters.description: A spirit drawn from the elemental plane of earth. It exists in this world as a sinuous stream of silt and stone, capable of smoothly flowing through solid rock.

monsters.name: fire elemental
monsters.description: A spirit drawn from the elemental plane of fire, which exists in this world as a brilliant column of raging flames.

monsters.name: air elemental
monsters.description: A spirit drawn from the elemental plane of air. It exists in this world as a lightning-spitting spirit, stunning foes with its crackling bursts.

monsters.name: twister
monsters.description: A whirling vortex of frost.

monsters.name: golden eye
monsters.description: A tiny and shimmering floating eye, swift as the wind and glistening like gold. It has a peculiarly hypnotic look.

monsters.name: fire vortex
monsters.description: A swirling cloud of flame. After striking a foe, it disintegrates.

monsters.name: spatial vortex
monsters.description: A crazily shifting twist in the fabric of reality.

monsters.name: toadstool
monsters.description: A short-lived species of fungus typically found on or around decaying organic matter.

monsters.name: fungus
monsters.description: A lumpy {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:1: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}} fungus, growing well in the dank underground dungeon.

monsters.name: wandering mushroom
monsters.description: A large, fleshy mushroom that wanders slowly around the dungeon. It is both innately curious and incredibly shy, pursuing the objects of its curiosity only when out of sight. Noxious spores drift around its cap.

monsters.name: plant
monsters.description: A plant that has adapted to grow in the unpleasant dungeon environment, somehow thriving even underground in the absence of the sun.

monsters.name: oklob sapling
monsters.description: A young oklob plant. It is more fragile than the mature specimen, but the acid it sprays is just as deadly.

monsters.name: oklob plant
monsters.description: A very dangerous plant which fends off predators by spraying corrosive vitriol at them. Even experienced adventurers give oklob plants a wide berth.

monsters.name: bush
monsters.description: A woody plant. It looks dry enough to be easily set on fire, and its foliage is not very dense, permitting both magic and missiles to pass through unaffected. However, it is firmly rooted, and requires significant effort to destroy.

monsters.name: scrub nettle
monsters.description: An irritable, bristling shrub. It fends off anything that might graze upon it by launching some of its innumerable toxic stinging hairs.

monsters.name: ballistomycete spore
monsters.description: A fast, gas-filled floating spore released by a ballistomycete when it senses a threat. After seeking out its foe, the spore will explode, damaging anything caught in the blast and further confusing living creatures.

monsters.name: ballistomycete
monsters.description: A lumpy reddish fungus covered in knobbly rhizome growths, growing well in the dank underground dungeon. When it senses a threat, the ballistomycete may release a deadly floating spore that explodes on its victims.

monsters.name: goblin
monsters.description: A short, impatient and unfriendly humanoid. Goblins first appeared only a few years ago, but are now remarkably numerous. Sadly, no number of raucous goblin parties will put them in a welcoming mood toward adventurers.

monsters.name: hobgoblin
monsters.description: A larger and even ruder goblin. Hobgoblins are perfectly capable of wielding weapons, but most prefer to beat their opponents to death with their bare hands.

monsters.name: gnoll
monsters.description: A taller and better-equipped relative of goblins, and ally of orcs. It is somewhat doglike in appearance.

monsters.name: gnoll bouda
monsters.description: A gnoll witch possessed by a spirit of spite which flashes out from behind their eyes. Its strange chants and ululations send other gnolls into a wild frenzy.

monsters.name: gnoll sergeant
monsters.description: A commander of a pack of gnolls. Scars on its stout body give evidence of how it earned its rank.

monsters.name: boggart
monsters.description: A malevolent and dangerous little sprite. The shadowy illusions it summons may not be real, but are deadly all the same.

monsters.name: kobold
monsters.description: A small, greyish creature with the look and temperament of a feral dog. No one knows for sure where kobolds come from, but ancient demon-gods, evil spirits, and meddling wizards have all been suggested as culprits.

monsters.name: kobold brigand
monsters.description: A kobold that is bigger and tougher than the ordinary kobold, with a penchant for underhanded tactics.

monsters.name: kobold demonologist
monsters.description: A kobold in league with demonic powers, able to call forth beings from the depths of Hell.

monsters.name: orc
monsters.description: A subterranean tribe whose forebearers were once scattered across every corner of the surface world. Eons of persecution have taught them the necessity of violence and the importance of having your brethren at your side.

monsters.name: orc warrior
monsters.description: An experienced, armoured and well-armed orc soldier, able to command a small mob of its fellows.

monsters.name: orc priest
monsters.description: A servant of Beogh, the ancient god of the orcs. Beogh rewards its devoted prayers by striking down its enemies.

monsters.name: orc high priest
monsters.description: An exalted servant of the orc god Beogh and a master of many foul rites, to whose aid Beogh will even send beings from the netherworld.

monsters.name: orc wizard
monsters.description: An orc who has gained proficiency in the occult arts, using them for martial purposes.

monsters.name: orc knight
monsters.description: A heavily armoured orc, covered in scars from many past battles. It commands its brethren in battle, rousing them to greater, more violent efforts with bloodcurdling shouts.

monsters.name: orc sorcerer
monsters.description: An exceptionally competent orcish wizard, in league with hellish and chthonic forces and motivated by the purest imaginable strain of malevolence.

monsters.name: orc warlord
monsters.description: A supreme commander of an orc host, skilled at both melee and ranged combat.

monsters.name: dwarf
monsters.description: A member of a short, sturdy mountain-dwelling folk.

monsters.name: deep dwarf
monsters.description: A pallid, stocky subterranean dwarf whose body has adapted to the crushing weight of the deep earth. Though incapable of natural regeneration, it shrugs off blows with uncanny resilience and mends its own flesh with dark subterranean magic.

monsters.name: death knight
monsters.description: A warrior-priest of Yredelemnul, chanting fearful supplications to its dark god.

monsters.name: elf
monsters.description: An elf, a member of an ancient fey race.

monsters.name: deep elf knight
monsters.description: A battle-hardened deep elf fighter.

monsters.name: deep elf pyromancer
monsters.description: A deep elf learned in the ways of fiery magic. It is capable of casting a wide array of scorching spells.

monsters.name: deep elf high priest
monsters.description: An exalted servant of the ancient dark god of the deep elves, basking in hellish death magic.

monsters.name: deep elf demonologist
monsters.description: A deep elf who is marked heavily by long years of contact with unnatural demonic forces and the creatures of the Abyss.

monsters.name: deep elf annihilator
monsters.description: A deep elf who exults in conjured mayhem and destruction. It is widely hated and feared, both for the power and for the precision of its destructive magics.

monsters.name: deep elf sorcerer
monsters.description: A mighty spellcaster who draws power from the very Hells, and possesses lethal arcane abilities.

monsters.name: deep elf death mage
monsters.description: A deep elf surrounded by a shimmering aura of negative energy, as a result of its practice of necromancy and life-sapping magic.

monsters.name: deep elf blademaster
monsters.description: A champion of the deep elves, who scorns magic and is devoted to the study of the sword. It wields two weapons with astonishing dexterity and speed.

monsters.name: deep elf master archer
monsters.description: A deep elf archer who has devoted a lifetime to the mastery of archery, dismissing magic as a frivolous distraction.

monsters.name: spriggan
monsters.description: A small humanoid, resembling a human or elf except for the size. It moves at a great speed, and loves playing dirty tricks on people.

monsters.name: spriggan druid
monsters.description: A spriggan whose connection with the birds and the beasts is exceptionally strong. If it dies, its sacrifice will heal and temporarily strengthen nearby animals.

monsters.name: spriggan rider
monsters.description: A spriggan that has tamed a hornet as its mount, and is tasked with protecting the spriggan fens and cairns from intruders.

monsters.name: spriggan berserker
monsters.description: A relatively mighty spriggan that plunges recklessly into combat.

monsters.name: spriggan defender
monsters.description: An elite, well-equipped spriggan warrior, renowned for its unbelievable agility and its prowess with advanced weaponry.

monsters.name: spriggan air mage
monsters.description: A magically adept spriggan blessed with the secrets of the winds.

monsters.name: tengu
monsters.description: A humanoid figure with the head and talons of a bird. Its ferociously combative nature belies its fragile appearance.

monsters.name: minotaur
monsters.description: A large muscular human with the head of a bull. It makes its home in a gauntlet where it awaits worthy challengers.

monsters.name: naga
monsters.description: A hybrid that is human from the waist up; below is a scaly, muscular snakelike tail. Its mouth drips with venomous saliva.

monsters.name: naga warrior
monsters.description: A fearsome naga warrior clad in sturdy armour and wielding a mighty weapon.

monsters.name: naga mage
monsters.description: A naga that has trained in the use of magic, trailed by an eldritch nimbus. It is especially skilled in spells dealing with poison and venom.

monsters.name: nagaraja
monsters.description: A magnificent example of the naga. It is an expert at both martial and magical arts.

monsters.name: guardian serpent
monsters.description: A rare and distinct member of scaly society, light and swift like a snake, yet also intelligent like a naga. It is said that a guardian serpent would rather die in battle than leave anything to an intruder.

monsters.name: octopode
monsters.description: A more intelligent cousin of the mighty kraken, capable of using tools and spells. It is fully amphibious, but most of its species choose to stay beneath the waves and serve their King.

monsters.name: merfolk
monsters.description: A hybrid with the torso of a human and the tail of a fish. It is capable of dwelling both in water and on land, and fiercely defends its domain.

monsters.name: merfolk siren
monsters.description: A beguiling merfolk whose voice can mesmerise listeners.

monsters.name: merfolk avatar
monsters.description: A beguiling merfolk whose voice mesmerises listeners. It carries no weapon, but its song summons drowned souls to defend the sea against intruders.

monsters.name: merfolk impaler
monsters.description: A powerfully muscled merfolk warrior, bearing a deadly weapon.

monsters.name: merfolk aquamancer
monsters.description: A slender merfolk mystic with unusually webby hands. Its form shifts and glistens as if seen through ocean spray.

monsters.name: merfolk javelineer
monsters.description: A fearsome merfolk champion with a piercing gaze and a large bundle of javelins.

monsters.name: centaur
monsters.description: A hybrid with the torso of a human atop the body of a horse. It is highly skilled in archery.

monsters.name: centaur warrior
monsters.description: A muscular centaur, veteran of numerous battles, armed with well-made weapons and able to use them skilfully.

monsters.name: yaktaur
monsters.description: A hybrid with the torso of a robust human atop the body of a yak. It excels in ranged combat, and is also a formidable foe in close quarters.

monsters.name: yaktaur captain
monsters.description: An exceptionally strong and brutish yaktaur, able to order its weaker brethren around to do its bidding.

monsters.name: ogre
monsters.description: A large, ugly, and fat creature, distantly related to goblins. It is tremendously strong, and likes fighting alongside its orc friends.

monsters.name: two-headed ogre
monsters.description: A huge ogre with two heads on top of its bloated body. It is capable of holding a weapon in each giant hand.

monsters.name: ogre mage
monsters.description: A rare breed of ogre, skilled in the use of magic. It usually becomes a chieftain among its kin.

monsters.name: troll
monsters.description: A huge and physically powerful humanoid creature. Short on intelligence but long on brawn, its thick knobbly hide heals rapidly from most wounds.

monsters.name: iron troll
monsters.description: A great troll, mighty of limb and plated with thick scales that resemble lightly rusted iron, especially in their hardness.

monsters.name: deep troll
monsters.description: A stooped troll with dark skin. It often travels in packs.

monsters.name: cyclops
monsters.description: A giant with one eye in the centre of its forehead. Despite its lack of binocular vision, it is able to throw boulders with fearsome accuracy.

monsters.name: ettin
monsters.description: A two-headed giant, stronger than most, and able to land devastating blows left and right with its two huge weapons.

monsters.name: stone giant
monsters.description: A gigantic humanoid with grey skin almost as hard as rock. It carries several boulders, and is perfectly capable of flinging them a great distance.

monsters.name: fire giant
monsters.description: A giant with obsidian skin and a wild mane of glowing red hair, holding aloft a fiery sword. Fire giants believe that they are destined to unite and burn the entire world to cinders.

monsters.name: frost giant
monsters.description: A giant with blue skin and hair like ice and snow. Its eyes are as bleak as winter skies. It marches grimly into battle with a great, frosty axe and howling blasts of cold.

monsters.name: titan
monsters.description: A huge, bolt-hurling, lightning-limned humanoid. It is unusually large and powerful, even among giants.

monsters.name: human
monsters.description: An uppity sort of surface-dwelling, hairless ape. Dwarves think of them as fragile, elves think of them as clumsy, and monsters think of them as tasty.

monsters.name: hell knight
monsters.description: A heavily armoured warrior, in league with the powers of Hell, and usually accompanied by other unsavoury beings of its ilk.

monsters.name: necromancer
monsters.description: An evil wizard who is devoted to the practice of death magic, the mastery of unholy energies, and the raising of corpses into a parody of life.

monsters.name: occultist
monsters.description: A wizard fond of illusion and treachery. They scorn the crudeness of other magicians, who hurl wild conjurations toward their foes rather than cunningly exploiting their greatest weaknesses.

monsters.name: vault guard
monsters.description: A heavily armed and armoured guardian of the Vaults.

monsters.name: Killer Klown
monsters.description: A comical figure full of life and laughter. It looks very happy to see you... but is there a slightly malicious cast to its features? Is that red face paint or something altogether less pleasant?

monsters.name: shapeshifter
monsters.description: A disturbing creature with the power to change its form. It is very rarely observed alive in its natural state.

monsters.name: glowing shapeshifter
monsters.description: A shapeshifter which has lost control over its transformations, and is constantly changing form.

monsters.name: draconian
monsters.description: A brown-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings. It is yet to develop the distinct colouring and powerful breath attack of its mature form.

monsters.name: black draconian
monsters.description: A muscular black-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and powerful wings.

monsters.name: yellow draconian
monsters.description: A muscular yellow-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

monsters.name: green draconian
monsters.description: A muscular green-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

monsters.name: purple draconian
monsters.description: A muscular purple-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

monsters.name: red draconian
monsters.description: A muscular red-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

monsters.name: white draconian
monsters.description: A muscular white-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

monsters.name: grey draconian
monsters.description: A muscular grey-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

monsters.name: pale draconian
monsters.description: A muscular humanoid with pale scales, a reptilian tail and small wings.

monsters.name: draconian stormcaller
monsters.description: A draconian deriving its thunderous powers and draconic allies from the worship of Qazlal.

monsters.name: draconian monk
monsters.description: A draconian who has eschewed the study of weaponry and magic in order to train in the art of unarmed combat. Its scaly fists, well-thewed legs, and mighty tail rain down blows upon its opponents.

monsters.name: draconian shifter
monsters.description: A draconian master of the warp, who can translocate both itself and anyone else to any place, either on this world or outside of it.

monsters.name: draconian annihilator
monsters.description: A draconian that uses powerful conjurations to destroy anyone who dares to stand in its way.

monsters.name: draconian knight
monsters.description: A draconian protected by thick scales, skilful weapon use, and complementary magic.

monsters.name: draconian scorcher
monsters.description: A cunning draconian who has mastered the inner secrets of the element of fire. Its scales are sooty from years of magical pyrotechnics.

monsters.name: lava snake
monsters.description: A burning red snake which dwells in pools of lava. It spits gobs of molten rock at passers-by.

monsters.name: salamander
monsters.description: A red, flaming half-human half-snake creature with a legendary affinity for fire.

monsters.name: electric eel
monsters.description: A type of fish capable of generating a powerful electric field.

monsters.name: water elemental
monsters.description: A spirit drawn from the elemental plane of water. It exists on this world as part of a body of water and can engulf other beings in its form, depriving them of breath and voice.

monsters.name: swamp worm
monsters.description: A large slimy worm, adept at traversing swamps and marshes.

monsters.name: kraken
monsters.description: A gargantuan sea monster, capable of devouring entire ships. Its many tentacles reach towards the shore and crush any who draw near.

monsters.name: tentacle
monsters.description: The mighty tentacle of a kraken. Any damage dealt to it hurts the whole creature.

monsters.name: orange crystal statue
monsters.description: An intricately carved idol of some nameless godling, hewn of translucent orange crystal. Its lifeless eyes seem to glitter uncannily with a wicked intelligence. It is capable of unleashing a powerful psychic assault upon the minds of any who approach it.

monsters.name: obsidian statue
monsters.description: A beautiful statue of an unknown creature, jet-black like a tear in reality. Its eyes glow with an otherworldly, malignant radiance.

monsters.name: ice statue
monsters.description: An imposing idol of some nameless arctic god, carved in glistening deep blue ice. Freezing vapours swirl about it, and a chill pervades the air.

monsters.name: statue
monsters.description: A piece of sculpted granite with glowing red eyes. Although it is rooted to its base, it can still move parts of itself.

monsters.name: training dummy
monsters.description: A mannequin used for battle practice.

monsters.name: lightning spire
monsters.description: A buzzing contraption made from a coil and a rod. It irregularly zaps electricity at the most distant enemy in its range.

monsters.name: crimson imp
monsters.description: A small, ugly minor demon. Its fanged maw seems locked in a permanent malign grin, and its horns protrude obscenely from its scaly pate.

monsters.name: drude
monsters.description: A conniving demon born from the nightmares of sleeping mages. It delights in coaxing the imagined fears of mortals into reality.

monsters.name: white imp
monsters.description: A small and mischievous minor demon covered in frost.

monsters.name: lemure
monsters.description: An accursed soul magically bound to hellish servitude for the highest bidder. If its master is slain, it will be freed, departing this realm with gratitude.

monsters.name: ufetubus
monsters.description: A chattering and shrieking minor demon. They delight in sneaking past and backstabbing their prey.

monsters.name: iron imp
monsters.description: An ugly, twisted little minor demon with metal skin.

monsters.name: shadow imp
monsters.description: A shadowy minor demon, with an affinity for the necromantic arts.

monsters.name: red devil
monsters.description: A larger cousin of the common imp, with a fiendish grin and two short wings sprouting from its shoulders. It favours tridents and loves to skewer its victims with painful barbs.

monsters.name: hellwing
monsters.description: A hideous skeletal demon. It swoops through the air on powerful wings of ancient withered skin, taking sadistic joy from harrying those who would try to flee its grasp.

monsters.name: sixfirhy
monsters.description: A small vile creature that moves in bursts, stopping then darting with lightning speed. It sprays sparks as it goes.

monsters.name: neqoxec
monsters.description: A weirdly shaped demon, pulsing and shifting with mutagenic energies, its belly distended with the devoured brains of its victims.

monsters.name: orange demon
monsters.description: An amber-coloured demon with a barbed tail not unlike that of a scorpion.

monsters.name: smoke demon
monsters.description: An infernal demon that manifests itself as a writhing cloud of smoke. Having considerable pyrokinetic powers, it can very effectively attack its enemies from afar.

monsters.name: ynoxinul
monsters.description: A winged demon covered in shiny metallic scales. It has a legion of minor demons at its command, which it impels to savage fury.

monsters.name: chaos spawn
monsters.description: A being of pure chaos, its form is constantly shifting, growing and then losing eyes, mouths, claws and tentacles. It corrupts everything it touches.

monsters.name: hellion
monsters.description: A hateful demon, desirous to see all life destroyed by its damnation.

monsters.name: tormentor
monsters.description: A malign devil covered in all manner of claws, spines, and cruel hooks. It is able to inflict torturous agony on those foolish enough to gaze upon it.

monsters.name: reaper
monsters.description: A haunting form wielding a giant scythe, ceaselessly harvesting the souls of the living.

monsters.name: soul eater
monsters.description: A demon that manifests as a malignantly shifting shadow gliding through the air. It radiates an intense aura of negative force.

monsters.name: ice devil
monsters.description: A man-sized demon covered in glittering ice.

monsters.name: sin beast
monsters.description: A ravenous brute of a demon - as much animal as person. Born from the residue of mortal depravity, it gorges itself on malice and magic alike.

monsters.name: rust devil
monsters.description: A hideous humanoid figure with rust-spotted metal skin, spreading corrosion and decay to all it touches.

monsters.name: Executioner
monsters.description: A horribly powerful and swift demon, its shape obscured by a cloud of swirling scythe-like blades.

monsters.name: green death
monsters.description: A bloated form covered in oozing sores and exhaling clouds of lethal poison.

monsters.name: blizzard demon
monsters.description: A greater demon formed from wistful snow and bitter lightning.

monsters.name: balrug
monsters.description: A huge and very powerful demon, wreathed in fire and shadows.

monsters.name: cacodemon
monsters.description: A maniacal demon, brimming with accursed power. Its gleeful laughter rarely ceases, even in the heat of battle.

monsters.name: sun demon
monsters.description: A demonic figure shining with the heat and fury of a fallen star.

monsters.name: shadow demon
monsters.description: A mysterious demonic figure, difficult to distinguish from the darkness around it. It weaves the shadows into powerful minions.

monsters.name: Hell Sentinel
monsters.description: A towering monolith constructed and possessed by demonic forces. A thousand eyes leer through slits in its jagged, spiked armour.

monsters.name: Brimstone Fiend
monsters.description: A huge and powerful demon wreathed in damnation, with great scaly wings. It is one of the most fearsome denizens of any of the Hells.

monsters.name: Ice Fiend
monsters.description: A huge frigid demon covered in frost and wreathed in freezing air. It is one of the most terrible denizens of the many Hells.

monsters.name: Tzitzimitl
monsters.description: A horrific fallen divinity, possessing jaws of gnashing stone and a necklace of starry organs. It spreads disease and despair, and patiently awaits the end of days when it will devour the sun.

monsters.name: pandemonium lord
monsters.description: A formidable demon lord inhabiting the endless halls of Pandemonium. Each one is different, with its own set of strengths and weaknesses.

monsters.name: efreet
monsters.description: An imposing, muscular figure engulfed in a cloud of searing flame.

monsters.name: rakshasa
monsters.description: A maneater demon, bestial and misshapen, in search of hidden power and knowledge. It is an expert in the art of illusion, and is exceptionally intelligent and cruel.

monsters.name: unseen horror
monsters.description: A creature rarely seen by anyone; those few who have seen one would rather they hadn't. It moves erratically.

monsters.name: tentacled starspawn
monsters.description: A lumbering maw shrouded in a mass of sinuous tentacles. On spotting prey, its tentacles lunge outward, dragging victims directly to its waiting gullet.

monsters.name: lurking horror
monsters.description: A formless mass of negative energy, bound to bring terrible torment once the forces holding it together dissolve. The alien presence of intruders to the Abyss is sure to unravel it, yet it seems perversely drawn toward them; still, it seems somehow reluctant to move while being observed.

monsters.name: thrashing horror
monsters.description: A seething mass of yellow flesh. It thrashes erratically, staggering foes beneath the weight of its impacts.

monsters.name: starcursed mass
monsters.description: A mass of stellar detritus that glows with the sickly putrescence of a dying star, forever shrieking soundlessly in a voice beyond mortal grasp. Its form undulates constantly, dividing spontaneously and then withdrawing when threatened. When divided, its deafening chorus of screams can overwhelm the minds of even the bravest warriors, leaving them stunned and helpless.

monsters.name: ancient zyme
monsters.description: A nexus of sentient cancer and disease, borne aloft perhaps by malice alone. Its nature inflicts withering illness on all living beings in its presence.

monsters.name: wretched star
monsters.description: A conflux of unearthly light and energy, awash in unnatural colours and strange forms no normal being was meant to perceive. It fills all those in its presence with the disorder of the Abyss.

monsters.name: eldritch tentacle
monsters.description: An immense, squamous appendage of some unseen creature, dripping with ichor and tipped with a single, terrible-looking claw.

monsters.name: tentacled monstrosity
monsters.description: A writhing mass of tentacles, all covered in putrid mucus.

monsters.name: small abomination
monsters.description: A hideous mass of body parts. Each varies in speed, strength, or resilience by the nature of whatever unfortunates were used to make it.

monsters.name: large abomination
monsters.description: A hideous conglomeration of mangled body parts, possessed and altered in ways that challenge sanity. Each varies in speed, strength, or resilience by the nature of whatever unfortunates were used to make it.

monsters.name: necrophage
monsters.description: A vile undead creation of the most unholy necromancy, made from the decaying corpses of humanoid creatures. It exists to spread disease and decay.

monsters.name: ghoul
monsters.description: A decayed cadaver, reanimated and accursed with a terrible hunger. It desires nothing but to feed on the flesh of the living, and will fell its victims with its vicious claws.

monsters.name: mummy
monsters.description: An undead figure covered in bandages and embalming fluids, compelled to walk by an ancient curse. It radiates a malign aura.

monsters.name: bog body
monsters.description: An undead figure preserved by the brackish waters of a bog, and reanimated by some unknown magic.

monsters.name: guardian mummy
monsters.description: An ancient warrior, embalmed and cursed to walk in undeath for eternity.

monsters.name: royal mummy
monsters.description: An ancient pharaoh, embalmed and cursed to undeath, now capable of great and terrifying feats of magic.

monsters.name: mummy priest
monsters.description: An ancient servant of a long forgotten god, embalmed and cursed to walk in undeath for all eternity.

monsters.name: vampire
monsters.description: A human cursed with vampirism, drifting in a state between life and undeath, perpetually hungry for the blood of the living.

monsters.name: vampire knight
monsters.description: A powerful vampire noble who complements its combat prowess with dark magic.

monsters.name: vampire mage
monsters.description: A sorcerer who, by accident or design, has been afflicted with the curse of the vampire. Regardless, through undeath, it has finally mastered the art of dark magic.

monsters.name: ghost
monsters.description: The remains of a monster that existed in an older version, but has since been removed.

monsters.name: phantom
monsters.description: A nearly-transparent undead spirit, suspected by some sages to be a degenerate form of ghost, with no memories of its former life. It rarely stays in one place for long.

monsters.name: shadowghast
monsters.description: A skulking apparition that disguises itself as a harmless shadow. Attuned to the dim light of the dungeon, it can slip in and out of sight at will, moving swiftly from one pool of shade to the next before striking unerringly at the blind spots of those who cannot see it.

monsters.name: flayed ghost
monsters.description: A hideous floating undead creature, the anguished spirit of a tortured victim, with torn skin hanging from an emaciated body. It restlessly stalks the dungeon, inflicting the anguish it felt in life upon those still living.

monsters.name: wight
monsters.description: An ancient warrior, kept in a state of perpetual undeath by its desire to die with honour in battle.

monsters.name: wraith
monsters.description: A cloud of black mist surrounding an insubstantial skeletal form. Its eyes burn bright with unholy malevolence and hunger for life essence, on which it feeds.

monsters.name: freezing wraith
monsters.description: An incorporeal skeletal form surrounded by a cloud of freezing air, likely the remains of some unfortunate adventurer. It now floats slowly through the dungeon, seeking to share its fate with others.

monsters.name: shadow wraith
monsters.description: A mist-wreathed skeletal shadow, hanging in mid-air. It drains away the life force of living beings.

monsters.name: silent spectre
monsters.description: A terrible spirit which brings an unearthly silence to the area around it, making it impossible to recite the magical incantations involved with casting spells or reading scrolls.

monsters.name: eidolon
monsters.description: An ancient skeletal apparition, sheathed in a cloud of mist. Its form glows white-hot with debilitating energy.

monsters.name: laughing skull
monsters.description: A blazing swift skull that cackles with the bleak malice of the dead. Fond of swarming, its laughter grows more spiteful and powerful for each nearby member of its own kind.

monsters.name: skeletal warrior
monsters.description: A vicious and heavily armed humanoid skeleton, animated by unholy power.

monsters.name: phantasmal warrior
monsters.description: A hideous translucent green spirit of a warrior fallen in battle but recalled to this plane by unholy magic. The blade it wields is ethereal, rendering those it strikes weak-willed and vulnerable to dark magic.

monsters.name: lich
monsters.description: A powerful wizard who has learned to cheat death itself, now existing as a skeletal, desiccated corpse kept intact by a mighty exercise of dark magic.

monsters.name: ancient lich
monsters.description: A lich who, having existed for countless centuries, has grown almost unimaginably powerful through the study of dark magic.

monsters.name: death cob
monsters.description: A dreadful undead cob of maize. Look, this one was probably a mistake. We're sorry.

monsters.name: curse toe
monsters.description: A disembodied toe, hanging in the air and radiating an intense field of negative energy.

monsters.name: curse skull
monsters.description: A charred skull floating in the air and rotating slowly. Mystic symbols are carved into its blackened surface.

monsters.name: profane servitor
monsters.description: A blasphemous being that was once an angel of the Shining One. It now stands as unliving proof that not even the holiest of beings are beyond Yredelemnul's grasp.

monsters.name: spectral thing
monsters.description: A hideous glowing apparition.

monsters.name: angel
monsters.description: A divine warrior of the Shining One. It is a towering winged figure of unnatural beauty surrounded by an aura of brilliant white light.

monsters.name: daeva
monsters.description: A towering winged figure radiating an aura of brilliant golden light. It is a divine agent of the Shining One.

monsters.name: cherub
monsters.description: A throne-bearer of the gods, whose head is beset by four faces: one of a man, one of an ox, one of a lion, one of an eagle. It is one of the angelic beings who stand before the good gods, singing eternal hymns of praise to their glory and greatness.

monsters.name: seraph
monsters.description: A six-winged servant of the good gods, of the highest rank of the angelic hosts. Its eyes burn with divine fire.

monsters.name: silver star
monsters.description: A radiant orb of living silver light that drifts silently through the halls of Zot. It unleashes blinding beams of searing silver radiance and fracturing bolts of pure energy against any who trespass.

monsters.name: ophan
monsters.description: A creature from the heavenly realms. It consists of a wheel within a wheel, and both of these are covered in eyes; strange flames of holy fire flicker all over it. To be seen by its countless eyes is to be highlighted and branded as both dissident and quarry for its allies to hunt down.

monsters.name: apis
monsters.description: A placid, sacred bull of Elyvilon. Its status as an exalted envoy of the Healer lets its very presence double the health of its allies.

monsters.name: Geryon
monsters.description: A huge, three-headed, winged arch-demon, guardian of the four Hells. Legends say that his silver horn can summon terrible beasts to aid him in battle.

monsters.name: Dispater
monsters.description: Greatest and most ruthless of the Lords of Hell, Dispater was born when first an iron sword drank mortal blood. They despise mortal vanities, the pursuit of ‘reason’ and ‘beauty’ - the only art they enjoy is the art of war.

monsters.name: Asmodeus
monsters.description: Greatest and most cunning of the Lords of Hell, Asmodeus was born when the twin fires of greed and treachery first sparked to life within a mortal's heart. His hideous body is perpetually wreathed in flame.

monsters.name: Antaeus
monsters.description: Once a hero among the titans, Antaeus grew jealous of the titan queen. In single combat he challenged and slew her, and for this crime he was exiled and descended into the Hells. Finding the inhabitants of that place no match for his might, Antaeus tore from its substance a fourth Hell, Cocytus, a realm born of frozen spite.

monsters.name: Ereshkigal
monsters.description: Greatest and most inexorable of the Lords of Hell, Ereshkigal was born when first a mortal breathed her last. Noiselessly she laughs at lives cut short and loved ones separated by untimely death, enwreathed in the silence of the grave.

monsters.name: Royal Jelly
monsters.description: A particularly rich and golden gelatinous thing. Smaller jellies swim and pulse just below its surface, ready to burst forth at the slightest touch.

monsters.name: Enchantress
monsters.description: First and most fearful of her kind, the Enchantress rules over the spriggans of the dungeon. She wears an opalescent outfit made of dragon skin that shimmers with many colours.

monsters.name: Mnoleg
monsters.description: A weirdly glowing figure, dancing through the twisted air of Pandemonium.

monsters.name: Lom Lobon
monsters.description: Stoic and inscrutable, Lom Lobon is an ancient demon infamous for their mastery of magic. Rumoured to be the most learned being in the halls of Pandemonium, they are at times sought out by mortal wizards who offer their souls in exchange for the secrets of the arcane. Lacking the terrible wrath present in most demons, Lom Lobon's single eye instead hides a cold, impartial cruelty.

monsters.name: Cerebov
monsters.description: A violent and wrathful demon, Cerebov appears as a giant humanoid covered in shining golden armour and wielding a huge twisted sword.

monsters.name: Gloorx Vloq
monsters.description: A shadowy figure clothed in profound darkness.

monsters.name: Ijyb
monsters.description: A small and shrewd goblin inventor, wearing blue rags coated in soot. She claims dominion over this level of the dungeon; trespassers will find themselves on the business end of a homemade wand.

monsters.name: Jessica
monsters.description: An evil apprentice sorceress. She entered the dungeon hoping to find a quiet, secluded place where she could study the darker arts without being disturbed.

monsters.name: Sigmund
monsters.description: The elder of a pair of brothers who came for the Orb. No one knows what Sigmund saw in the dungeon to drive him mad, but his shrewd magical tactics and wicked scythe now leave little time for his victims to wonder. Despite his reputation as a vicious murderer, his grandiose and dramatic ways have earned him the admiration of many denizens of the dungeon.

monsters.name: Terence
monsters.description: A veteran of a war against the armataurs' elephant-riders. He has recently retired to make a new home in the dungeon.

monsters.name: Blorkula the orcula
monsters.description:
Once a gangly and bedraggled vampire with a strange obsession with colour, Blorkula was offered succour by a missionary of Beogh and became a portly and vigorous orc with a strange obsession with colour instead.

He wields magic tinged with every hue of the rainbow, and has mastered the art of dividing his own form among its many colours to avoid killing blows - though even he must rest a while before doing so a second time.

monsters.name: Edmund
monsters.description: A jealous sibling of Sigmund (indeed, the youngest of nine brothers). He has none of Sigmund's skills in magic, but makes up for it with his skills in fighting and a canny head for money. He is eager to prove his superiority by killing hapless adventurers with his expensive flail and quick wit.

monsters.name: Erolcha
monsters.description: An especially cunning ogre-mage.

monsters.name: Donald
monsters.description: {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:4: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

monsters.name: Urug
monsters.description: A coarse and lanky orc. Urug lost her eye in a fight with a harpy, and has sworn to slay every last one of them. Unfortunately, the vision in her remaining eye is not very good, and she has mistaken you for one. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

monsters.name: Joseph
monsters.description: Looks like a mercenary in a stupid-looking hat.

monsters.name: Snorg
monsters.description: A particularly corpulent troll with a short temper and a sizable gut. Uninterested in the Orb, Snorg delights in the endless parade of adventurers – that is, easy meals — it attracts.

monsters.name: Erica
monsters.description: A wild-tempered adventuress. She's quite prideful for an octopode, and brandishes their venomous capacity and camouflage talents with cruel force.

monsters.name: Josephine
monsters.description: A formidable necromancer, committed to her craft even after it left her aged, decaying, and half-undead herself.

monsters.name: Harold
monsters.description: A middle-aged bounty hunter, anxious to retire after one final job. He hopes to settle down somewhere and live a quiet life with his family, using the money from his final bounty: you.

monsters.name: Agnes
monsters.description: This spriggan is aged and weathered from years of travel away from the forests and swamps that are home to her kin. Her choice of weapon and astonishing speed both speak to the training she underwent. Underestimate her at your peril!

monsters.name: Louise
monsters.description: A mighty sorceress, clad from head to toe in heavy armour. Once an adventurer looking for the fabled Orb of Zot, she was cast into the Abyss and got hopelessly lost there. Toyed with by some greater power, she was stuck on the hostile plane for nearly a decade. When she finally emerged from the Abyss, Louise had become powerful indeed, but had also gone fully insane. She now wanders the halls of the dungeon, seeking other adventurers to share her fate.

monsters.name: Frances
monsters.description: A stout warrior who once bested a powerful lord of Pandemonium in combat, gaining control over the demon's realm and thanes. The battle left her with a deep facial scar, one that she carries as a badge of honour rather than a symbol of shame.

monsters.name: Rupert
monsters.description: Rippling muscles, glistening pecs, incredible glutes - Rupert is the peak of physical perfection. Even so, his roars seem louder than even his fantastic form can explain. Perhaps he holds some talisman that lends supernatural force to his bellows?

monsters.name: Wiglaf
monsters.description: A cantankerous dwarf wearing a stupid-looking hat. He eyes you sourly, as if deciding exactly how much offence he should take to the way you're staring at it.

monsters.name: Xtahua
monsters.description: An ancient and mighty dragon.

monsters.name: Norris
monsters.description: A relaxed water cultist with a healthy tan and a soothing voice. He doesn't really care if it is you or he who dies — “both” would probably be the best option.

monsters.name: Frederick
monsters.description: A svelte fighter-mage with a gold-rimmed monocle, a keen sense of tradition, and the blood of the gods running through his veins. He's here looking for a worthy opponent, but he's yet to find one.

monsters.name: Margery
monsters.description: A lithe spellcaster in service to the powers of Hell; it is her duty to ensure that the inhabitants of the Dungeon never forget their place. She personally slew the ancient dragon from whose hide her strange armour is crafted.

monsters.name: Boris
monsters.description: An ancient and powerful lich. Like all true liches, Boris is immortal, and will regenerate his desiccated skeletal remains even if completely disintegrated. The same cannot be said for his many victims over his many centuries, from which he collects and channels their dying woes and regrets.

monsters.name: Polyphemus
monsters.description: A cyclops shepherd, he is very protective of his charges, whom he watches with an undying fervor through his single massive eye. Nevertheless, he won't hesitate to use them as projectiles in a pinch; after all, the best defence is a good offence.

monsters.name: Murray
monsters.description: A demonic skull rolling along the ground.

monsters.name: Tiamat
monsters.description: The earthly avatar of Tiamat, deity of dragonkind, here incarnated as a mighty draconian warrior. Her scales seem to shimmer and change colour as you watch.

monsters.name: Roxanne
monsters.description: A strikingly realistic sapphire statue of a famous earth mage who disappeared after a catastrophic mishap with a magical talisman.

monsters.name: Sonja
monsters.description: A graceful kobold assassin. Admire her graceful pirouettes, thrill at her daring leaps! But watch out for her knives!

monsters.name: Eustachio
monsters.description: An apprentice summoner with a flowing moustache. He has funny ideas about honour.

monsters.name: Azrael
monsters.description: A powerful, belligerent efreet. (Is there any other kind?)

monsters.name: Ilsuiw
monsters.description: A deadly merfolk water-witch, who uses her dominion over the tides to draw unwitting adventurers to their deaths.

monsters.name: Prince Ribbit
monsters.description: A frog of unusual size, with a tiny crown perched incongruously atop his head.

monsters.name: Nergalle
monsters.description:
A shrewd and wizened orc who has devoted her life to chronicling the bloody history of her people. She claims to know the names and deeds of every last orc who lost their life in their great exodus into the Dungeon, and even if this is a lie, she nonetheless seems to be on a first-name basis with many of them.

More than any other orc still breathing, she knows the blood and sacrifice it took to make this place a refuge for her kind. She will not brook its being intruded upon by anyone - least of all you.

monsters.name: Saint Roka
monsters.description: A mighty warlord. Some orcs even say they are the Chosen One of Beogh.

monsters.name: Nessos
monsters.description: A centaur warrior, skilled at warfare and deceit. They slew a mighty hydra, and now its deadly blood drips, still-fuming, from their arrows.

monsters.name: Lernaean hydra
monsters.description: A huge beast, mightiest of hydras, infamous in myth and legend. It flows through the water faster than a human can run, swatting aside trees as though they were matchsticks. Its many heads slaver and gnash constantly as it hunts for prey to slake its bottomless appetite.

monsters.name: Dissolution
monsters.description: The Pits of Slime used to be a thriving civilisation, and Dissolution was the prophet of their god. When the city was overtaken by its current residents, only Dissolution survived, for they alone turned faithfully to the Slime God. Dissolution became a tremendous mass of acidic ooze, yet retained their intelligence. They are filled with hatred for anything that can hold a form.

monsters.name: Kirke
monsters.description: A master of transformation and treachery. Beware, or you may be the next swine to join her herd!

monsters.name: Grum
monsters.description: A tough-looking gnoll, wearing the pelt of one of his former war dogs.

monsters.name: Pargi
monsters.description: An unusually weak troll.

monsters.name: Menkaure
monsters.description: A fair and noble ruler of an ancient and mighty kingdom, mummified after an early death. His faithful priests subsequently infused him with great and powerful magic, seeking to grant him eternal life. Now he is forgotten and reduced to mouldering bandages and dry, brittle bones.

monsters.name: Duvessa
monsters.description: A plain-looking deep elven fighter who is technically brilliant in many forms of combat, but over-confident because of it. She is complemented by the magical skills of her twin brother, Dowan. She journeys to the surface to challenge its greatest champions.

monsters.name: Dowan
monsters.description: A beautiful but vain deep elf with an aptitude for magic and little else. His skills are the perfect complement of his twin sister Duvessa's fighting prowess. In search of more powerful spells, he journeys to the surface with his sister.

monsters.name: Gastronok
monsters.description: A voracious and surprisingly intelligent slug, devoted to eating everything and everyone he comes across, with a pointed hat perched rakishly atop his head. He acquired the hat the same way he acquired his intelligence and his knowledge of spells: by consuming their former owner, a powerful wizard.

monsters.name: Maurice
monsters.description: A sly, conniving thief. A self-proclaimed legend, he was one of the most skilled and crafty of the thieves and rogues lured by the Orb. The magical parasitic vines that have claimed his body still wish to continue his life's work, with a back-up plan of both a vicious magic-drinking maw and potent wands.

monsters.name: Khufu
monsters.description: An incredibly powerful emperor on the way to godhood. He died quite some time ago, but he sees no reason why that should stop him.

monsters.name: Nikola
monsters.description: A brilliant scientist obsessed with electricity. In his attempts to perfect his electric golem, he was involved in a terrible accident, and now phases in and out of reality.

monsters.name: Aizul
monsters.description: Once the primary guardian serpent of a legendary treasure hoard, she was disgraced after thieves looted it while she slept. She seeks to make up for her failure by protecting the only treasure the villains overlooked, a single precious talisman.

monsters.name: Pikel
monsters.description: A wise kobold would fear the forces of Hell, and certainly would not set up a highly lucrative transdimensional trade in damned souls. But Pikel is better known for his whip than his wisdom, mercilessly tormenting his piteous charges as he ferries them to their buyers.

monsters.name: Crazy Yiuf
monsters.description: A withered old gnoll with a long silver beard, wielding a quarterstaff and wearing a cloak. He looks like a figure from mythology! Wait, is his beard held on to his ears with hooks?

monsters.name: Mennas
monsters.description:
There was once a human priest named Mennas. He travelled far and wide as a missionary of Zin, often venturing even into Orcish lands. He beseeched the orcs to abandon their false tribes and return to the peoples of their birth; only Zin's light could truly cleanse the weight of sin that had twisted their bodies.

By all accounts the orcs were not happy with Mennas. Eventually, a group of them demanded he recant his words and when Mennas remained silent, they cut out his tongue.

Whether or not this angel is that same Mennas is something of a mystery, as he seems to have difficulty speaking.

monsters.name: Mara
monsters.description: This tall and powerful demon is Mara, Lord of Illusions, mighty among dreamers. He is capable of creating intricately detailed illusions, so real that they are almost as deadly as the creatures they impersonate.

monsters.name: Grinder
monsters.description: An inefficient shadow imp previously employed as a torturer in one of the lower circles of Hell. She has a tendency to complain and make inane statements.

monsters.name: Jory
monsters.description: Once a simple village peasant, Jory found himself transformed in undeath into a powerful creature. Through the countless centuries unlived since then, he has honed his skills in combat and magic, and amassed great wealth and many possessions.

monsters.name: Ignacio
monsters.description:
While a mortal cannot turn into a demon aside from divine intervention, this is what happened to Ignacio after Makhleb saw his love for his job and smiled upon him. He is now slated to continue the joy of his life for all eternity.

Although his new form includes a number of large razor-sharp blades growing from his demonic appendages, he kept his favourite axe and is eager to let you test its edge.

monsters.name: Arachne
monsters.description:
Once a talented human weaver, Arachne was transformed into a monstrous half-spider by a jealous rival's curse. Driven out of her village, she found sanctuary for a time among the jorogumo before a bitter feud forced her to flee once more.

Now she wanders other corners of the dungeon with a small retinue of loyal students in tow, seeking a new domain in which they can spin their peerless tapestries in peace.

monsters.name: Chuck
monsters.description: Chuck the stone giant loves rocks, the bigger the better! Over the years, he has managed to amass quite the collection, including some rare, enchanted ones.

monsters.name: iron giant
monsters.description: A huge, rusting monolith, larger than any other species of giant. It packs an incredible punch.

monsters.name: Nellie
monsters.description: A highly intelligent elephant who travelled as part of a circus. One dark night, she slipped out of her chain and disappeared into Pandemonium, never to be seen again.

monsters.name: iron elemental
monsters.description: A rare and powerful spirit from the elemental plane of earth, it exists in this world by inhabiting a hulking mass of iron.

monsters.name: player ghost
monsters.description: The apparition of an unfortunate adventurer, retaining many of the skills and abilities the adventurer had in life. It is condemned to haunt this particular level of the dungeons, lashing out violently at the next adventurer to cross its path.

monsters.name: ball lightning
monsters.description: A swift sphere of coruscating electrical energy. It will explode at the slightest disturbance.

monsters.name: orb of destruction
monsters.description: A conjured globe of pure magic that homes onto a designated target, albeit with massive inertia. A smart and agile person may move out of its path, causing it to miss its target. It cannot be avoided by Dodging skill, and is able to make sharp turns to hit adjacent targets.

monsters.name: pillar of salt
monsters.description: A pillar of salt shaped like a statue, but worked by no living hands.

monsters.name: sensed monster
monsters.description: A hostile monster whose presence has been detected.

monsters.name: trivial sensed monster
monsters.description: A trivially weak monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.

monsters.name: easy sensed monster
monsters.description: A weak monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.

monsters.name: tough sensed monster
monsters.description: A somewhat dangerous monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.

monsters.name: nasty sensed monster
monsters.description: A very dangerous monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.

monsters.name: friendly sensed monster
monsters.description: A friendly monster whose presence has been {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}.

monsters.name: Hellbinder
monsters.description: A mighty spellcaster wreathed in arcane energies, muttering profane incantations.

monsters.name: Cloud Mage
monsters.description: A strange wizard who has attained mastery over clouds, making deft and foreboding mystic gestures.

monsters.name: Fannar
monsters.description: A cold-hearted elven sorcerer, draped in robes of high office. They whisper grimly to themself as they stalk the dungeon, trailing ice crystals through the air behind them.

monsters.name: apocalypse crab
monsters.description: An opalescent crab with jet black eyes, and chaotic mists effusing from its mandibles. Rumours claim that this species is waiting for the end of time.

monsters.name: starspawn tentacle
monsters.description: The writhing appendage of a tentacled starspawn, capable of grasping nearly any prey and dragging it back to be devoured. Any damage dealt to it hurts the whole creature.

monsters.name: spatial maelstrom
monsters.description: A malevolent rift in reality, dissolving all terrain it passes by into swirling vortices.

monsters.name: Jorgrun
monsters.description: A dwarven magician, particularly well-attuned to the dungeon around him. He wields powerful earth magic in combat.

monsters.name: fulminant prism
monsters.description: A slender prism of unstable, soft gold that crackles with barely-contained destructive energy. Any blow which cracks its fragile surface is likely to result in a violent explosion.

monsters.name: battlesphere
monsters.description: A small globe of destructive energy. Each time its creator casts an offensive spell, it will launch a magical barrage at the most injured nearby foe it can reach.

monsters.name: shadow
monsters.description: A featureless silhouette of your own body, moving independently through the divine power of Dithmenos. No matter how many times it is struck down, it will reform itself, for a shadow is inextinguishable so long as whatever cast it remains.

monsters.name: deep troll earth mage
monsters.description: A particularly intelligent deep troll. It uses its magic to tunnel through the earth and ambush foes.

monsters.name: deep troll shaman
monsters.description: A deep troll blessed with divine power to strengthen and hasten its kin.

monsters.name: diamond obelisk
monsters.description: A towering obelisk surrounded by a powerful storm.

monsters.name: vault sentinel
monsters.description: A vigilant scout, quick to alert its fellows to the presence of intruders. It marks such intruders with powerful magic, making them unable to hide from pursuit no matter where they flee.

monsters.name: vault warden
monsters.description: A veteran commander, able to seal nearby doorways and staircases to prevent intruders from either trespassing further or escaping alive.

monsters.name: ironbound convoker
monsters.description: A guardian mage clad in pattern-etched armour. It can recite words of power to summon distant allies and imbue them with unnatural might.

monsters.name: ironbound preserver
monsters.description: A towering, muscular figure, capable of safeguarding its allies by selflessly accepting a portion of the injuries inflicted upon them.

monsters.name: zombie
monsters.description: A corpse raised to undeath by necromancy.

monsters.name: draugr
monsters.description: A territorial gnarl of driftwood and shattered bones. Its resentment of the living has slowly twisted its remains into a monstrous form, capable of brandishing weapons and spreading terrible curses.

monsters.name: simulacrum
monsters.description: An icy replica of a monster, animated by heretical magics.

monsters.name: ancient champion
monsters.description: An unfathomably ancient skeleton. It has hundreds of golden sigils etched onto its bones, and pulses with terrible, unholy power.

monsters.name: revenant soulmonger
monsters.description: A timeworn revenant whose flames dance with the silhouettes of long-forgotten atrocities. Cursed with a hunger they can never satisfy, they unleash these long-dead echoes to reenact violence upon any soul they deem worthy of adding to their eternal collection.

monsters.name: lost soul
monsters.description: The echo of an unmourned soul. Though the memories of its living self are long-faded, it is drawn to the moment of death by some lingering instinct. It seizes upon the passage of other souls, losing the last vestiges of its being in the memories of another's life.

monsters.name: jiangshi
