monsters.description: A vampiric thrall bound into servitude by esoteric rituals. Though its rigid limbs give it an awkward gait, it moves with surprising speed, leaping upon its victims and leeching away their life essence with its vicious claws.

monsters.name: djinni
monsters.description: An elemental spirit formed from smokeless fire.

monsters.name: dryad
monsters.description: A spirit of nature, bound to the forest in which it resides. It is capable of calling upon the trees to defend against incursions.

monsters.name: wind drake
monsters.description: A small but powerful dragon, particularly adept amongst its kin at manipulating the currents of air that surround it. It can exhale powerful blasts of wind.

monsters.name: faun
monsters.description: A hybrid with the torso of a human atop the forelegs of a goat. It is fabled for its ability to play with the minds of those who intrude into its domain.

monsters.name: satyr
monsters.description: A more intelligent relative of the faun, often found in their company, and far more unforgiving of — and dangerous to — interlopers.

monsters.name: tengu warrior
monsters.description: A particularly bloodthirsty tengu who has opted to hone its skill in airborne fighting and weaponry instead of spellcasting.

monsters.name: tengu conjurer
monsters.description: A tengu with a talent for the destructive magical arts.

monsters.name: tengu reaver
monsters.description: An elite, ferocious tengu highly skilled with both steel and spells.

monsters.name: Sojobo
monsters.description: Queen of the tengu, with legendary skill in swordsmanship, tactics, and magic. Storytellers claim she once trapped a raging tempest in a bottle and kept it as a talisman.

monsters.name: snaplasher vine
monsters.description: A swift and sinuous vine brought alive by a dryad's magic. It can quickly bind and entangle the dryad's foes, dragging them back to the forest from which it surges.

monsters.name: thorn hunter
monsters.description:
A predatory marsh plant, possessed of motility and a rudimentary intelligence. It ensnares its prey in rings of spiny brambles and then skewers the trapped creatures with its razor-sharp thorns.

When injured or approached by enemies, it can even raise these brambles as a barricade around itself.

monsters.name: briar patch
monsters.description: A tangled cluster of thorny briars, sharp enough to pierce thick hide and armour. Although stationary, its branches are possessed with a will of their own. They move to allow magic and missiles fired by those friendly to this plant to pass through unaffected.

monsters.name: water nymph
monsters.description: A capricious nature spirit, deeply bonded with the waters in which it lives. Wherever they flow, so may it, and ponds and rivers surge and leap at its whim.

monsters.name: shambling mangrove
monsters.description: A gnarled mangrove, possessed of sapience and a cantankerous disposition. Its roots run deep through the water and soil of its marshy home and can make footing very difficult for those who provoke its ire. Marsh fauna are often found nesting within its branches, and may not take kindly to being disturbed.

monsters.name: spectral weapon
monsters.description: A spirit drawn from a weapon — it never strikes on its own. Damage done to it will be partially mirrored onto the caster.

monsters.name: elemental wellspring
monsters.description: A swirling conflux of elemental water streaming from the elemental plane into this one, with powerful spirits and mighty floods flowing from it.

monsters.name: deathcap
monsters.description: A noxious and deadly fungus suffused with negative energy. While parasitic in life, undeath has granted it the ability to absorb its nutrients directly from the life force of others.

monsters.name: formicid
monsters.description: A sentient ant that walks upright and is competent at digging.

monsters.name: raiju
monsters.description: A profoundly unnatural hound, crackling with electricity. It travels in packs, and covers great distances by bursting into living lightning.

monsters.name: demonspawn blood saint
monsters.description: A half-mortal, half-demonic creature, radiating an intense heat. It weaves powerful and unpredictable spells of devastation.

monsters.name: demonspawn warmonger
monsters.description: A half-mortal, half-demonic creature, now more beast than whatever species it is descended from. It is devoted to martial combat, disrupting the magic of its foes as it feasts off of endless conflict.

monsters.name: demonspawn corrupter
monsters.description: A half-mortal, half-demonic creature, oozing with dark energies. It twists space around itself, and can corrupt weapons, armour and even the very flesh of its opponents.

monsters.name: demonspawn soul scholar
monsters.description: A half-mortal, half-demonic creature, covered in icy blue scales. Its devotion to the deities of death grants it great insight into the vulnerabilities and applications of mortal souls.

monsters.name: worldbinder
monsters.description: A cloud of thick fog, with faint, feeble claws constantly reaching out and then fading back into the fog. When threatened, it calls forth creatures banished to the void between realities, using them to defend itself.

monsters.name: vine stalker
monsters.description: A bizarre symbiotic creature, made up of a carnivorous vine magically combined with a humanoid.

monsters.name: drowned soul
monsters.description: A cold and hollow apparition of the drowned dead, chained by some lingering attachment to the depths in which it perished. It rushes to embrace the living, sharing the last moments of its watery fate with whatever it touches.

monsters.name: shock serpent
monsters.description: A sinuous serpent whose body crackles with volatile electricity. Its electric shroud can discharge when struck, inflicting a painful shock on any nearby foes.

monsters.name: mana viper
monsters.description: A violet-scaled serpent with faintly glowing eyes. It thirsts for magic as well as flesh, and its bite can drink dry the magical reservoirs of even a powerful mage in no time.

monsters.name: naga ritualist
monsters.description: An esoteric mystic draped in talismans. It venerates poison as a sacred gift and means of spiritual purification.

monsters.name: naga sharpshooter
monsters.description: A naga with exceptionally keen eyesight, adept in the use of ranged weaponry and simple magics which allows it to snipe at targets across nearly any obstruction.

monsters.name: salamander mystic
monsters.description: A member of the salamander's scholarly caste, possessed of lesser size and strength, but wise in the ways of magic.

monsters.name: Asterion
monsters.description: Once a king infamous for waging bloodthirsty campaigns, Asterion was exiled to the depths of the dungeon for his crimes. Here he lurks in his tattered finery, dreaming of a new kingdom. In his lust for power, the minotaur king turned to the worship of Makhleb, and Makhleb has rewarded him with horrifying destructive might.

monsters.name: Natasha
monsters.description:
A fast-moving magical cat. Once a powerful wizard's familiar, Natasha was abandoned after her master was consumed by the very necromantic forces he sought to control. Now she patrols the dungeon, taking a bloody vengeance with spell and claw upon any adventurer who crosses her path.

This cat doesn't have nine lives, but just one death isn't going to be enough to put her down for good.

monsters.name: Vashnia
monsters.description: An elite marksnaga who leads a skilled team of sharpshooters. She is particularly skilled in translocation magic.

monsters.name: block of ice
monsters.description: A block of ice shaped like a statue, but worked by no living hands.

monsters.name: blazeheart golem
monsters.description: A volatile elemental spark encased in a shell of slag iron. If destroyed while its fires still blaze, the exposed core will violently detonate a moment later.

monsters.name: spellspark servitor
monsters.description: A magical construct forged around a spark of its creator's own arcane power, allowing it to wield some of their destructive magics directly.

monsters.name: ghost crab
monsters.description: A crab twisted by proximity to negative energy. Apparitions of the dead swirl around it, only barely visible.

monsters.name: torpor snail
monsters.description: A ponderous gastropod with a rock-hard shell. It is said to be in some way connected with the god Cheibriados; its very presence slows the movements of unwary adventurers, leaving them easy prey for its terrifying, ever-gnashing radulae.

monsters.name: bennu
monsters.description: A sacred, self-created sunbird, representative of rebirth. It has ascended past the cycles of life and death, and calls upon aspects of both, rising forth from death in a burst of unholy flame.

monsters.name: ushabti
monsters.description: A funerary stone figurine kept in tombs to serve the deceased as they pass through the afterlife. It is inscribed with spells to protect the interred for eternity.

monsters.name: death scarab
monsters.description: A hideous swarming undead insect, exuding death and decay and feeding on the life energies of those unfortunate enough to encounter it.

monsters.name: caustic shrike
monsters.description: A swift, nightmarish bird whose razor-sharp metallic feathers drip with corrosive acid.

monsters.name: Robin
monsters.description: A mountain hobgoblin, recently come in search of the legendary Orb. Not foolhardy or reckless enough to delve into the depths of the Dungeon alone, Robin has built a small army of minions. Potential competitors will quickly find a stream of screaming goblins flying toward them!

monsters.name: shard shrike
monsters.description: An incredibly fast-moving bird, known for impaling its prey on shards of ice before tearing them to pieces. It has acclimated to the desolate wastes of Cocytus, and is enveloped with an accursed chill.

monsters.name: entropy weaver
monsters.description: A gaunt humanoid with flaking, pale chitin. Its spindly limbs are capable of startlingly quick movement and end in razor-sharp talons.

monsters.name: moon troll
monsters.description: A bizarre breed of intelligent troll, glowing with mysterious power from beyond this world which shields it from damage except at close range.

monsters.name: mutant beast
monsters.description: A bizarre creature, twisted and warped by overexposure to magical radiation. Each has a different set of traits.

monsters.name: juggernaut
monsters.description: A gigantic humanoid with thick iron plates welded to its skin. It moves with alarming speed and deals incredible damage with its immense fists, but must rest between blows.

monsters.name: spark wasp
monsters.description: A profoundly unnatural insect covered in vaguely metallic plates. Its stinger crackles with electricity, capable of delivering a powerful shock to unwary victims, and is capable of closing the distance with them at shockingly lethal speed.

monsters.name: oblivion hound
monsters.description: A demon lapdog of the queen of Tartarus, bound to hunt her enemies. The first time a foe hears its howl, it will echo in their mind, calling nightmarish creatures to hunt them. Those who survive have the small consolation of being inoculated against that particular hound's howl.

monsters.name: deep elf elementalist
monsters.description: A deep elf commanding the primal forces of the universe. It is renowned for its ability to pin down even the most elusive foes with powerful, unavoidable magic.

monsters.name: deep elf archer
monsters.description: An experienced deep elf fighter with a penchant for ranged combat.

monsters.name: demonic plant
monsters.description: A demonic mockery of a plant, covered with mysterious appendages and writhing tentacles. It appears to be harmless.

monsters.name: withered plant
monsters.description: A plant whose life has been drained away, but with its physical form still intact. It looks like it died many {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:1: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}} ago.

monsters.name: dart slug
monsters.description: A small invertebrate. It hunts prey considerably larger than itself by firing chitinous darts, using a concealed air bladder to launch them with remarkable range and power.

monsters.name: howler monkey
monsters.description: An aggressively territorial primate, known for the astonishing variety and volume of noise it can produce.

monsters.name: ancestor
monsters.description: A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still they seem somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past. The memory and the memorialist fight in concert, each able to fire past the other.

monsters.name: knight
monsters.description: A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still it seems somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past, well equipped with arms and armour both.

monsters.name: elementalist
monsters.description: A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still it seems somehow to resemble a mage from the distantly remembered past, skilled with destructive elemental magic.

monsters.name: hexer
monsters.description: A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still it seems somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past, ready with debilitating spells and deadly knifework.

monsters.name: meliai
monsters.description: A nymphal hybrid, with a winged torso of a human atop the stinging abdomen of a bee. The meliai serve under many roles: priestesses of nature, nurses to the divine, and warrior-champions for their hives.

monsters.name: Bai Suzhen
monsters.description: A weary draconian with foreign and watery scales. She has come to the Dungeon in hopes of resurrecting her mortal husband; a noble cause, for a being once known for quarrelling with saints and flooding unfortunate temples. If pressed to her limits, she will reveal her true form, the mere sight of which struck her husband dead. Adventurers may wish they were so lucky!

monsters.name: Bai Suzhen
monsters.description: A weary draconian with foreign and watery scales. She has come to the Dungeon in hopes of resurrecting her mortal husband; a noble cause, for a being once known for quarrelling with saints and flooding unfortunate temples. If pressed to her limits, she will reveal her true form, the mere sight of which struck her husband dead. Adventurers may wish they were so lucky!

monsters.name: saltling
monsters.description: A small, human-shaped agglomeration of salt. It was created by the last fugitive loyalists of the fallen eastern empire, forced in desperation to construct golems from local resources to defend themselves.

monsters.name: imperial myrmidon
monsters.description: A warrior initiated in the mysteries of a dying cult, dedicated to serve thrones long-fallen. Its blows strip away magical defences, leaving its foes vulnerable to even the simplest hexes.

monsters.name: servant of whispers
monsters.description: A member of an order of monks who abandoned their former faith. It now serves a minor god of wind and whispers, who allows it to calm the air and, when in great need, to break the stillness with divine thunder.

monsters.name: peacekeeper
monsters.description: A four-legged humanoid construct, tasked with recapturing escaped prisoners and punishing heretics. Long after the fall of the empire it once served, it continues to enforce imperial law, knowing no jurisdiction.

monsters.name: ragged hierophant
monsters.description: A bedraggled priest, once-fine robes now lined with salt and dust. Forsaken by the gods, it now relies on constructs to protect itself.

monsters.name: halazid warlock
monsters.description: An ancient undead sorcerer, exhumed by the living divines Sheza and Sargol and forced to labour night and day to anchor them to the world. Even after the fall of the divine twins, it works to resurrect its fallen masters.

monsters.name: dream sheep
monsters.description: A drowsy, fluffy ovine whose coat sparkles with motes of dream dust. It gathers in herds and fills the air with dream dust, overwhelming its victims and putting them to sleep.

monsters.name: barachi
monsters.description: An amphibious humanoid with a very ugly attitude.

monsters.name: foxfire
monsters.description: A thin wisp of flaming swamp gas. It will burn the first hostile thing it touches and then dissipate.

monsters.name: Maggie
monsters.description: In a distant time, Maggie was apprenticed to the dreaded Hell Knights - but she grew impatient. In search of a shortcut to fame and fortune (and somewhat short on imagination), she entered the Dungeon and set out to slay a dragon. Now having slain one, Maggie sees no reason to stop.

monsters.name: nameless horror
monsters.description: A malign force from the space between planes. It is hostile to the magic forces that removed it from its home. These horrors are often the result of mistaken summoning spells and have slain many aspiring wizards.

monsters.name: bloated husk
monsters.description: A decaying undead corpse. When it reaches a victim (or if it's destroyed first), the gases trapped inside it are released and create a large, violent concussive blast.

monsters.name: bunyip
monsters.description: A flesh-eating beast that uses its limbs and tail interchangeably. It moves with alarming speed, but must pause to reorganise itself after each attack. Its distinctive screams carry far and wide.

monsters.name: goliath frog
monsters.description: A frog of exceptional size, for a frog. It lashes its prey with its tongue from a distance to coat them in its acidic stomach juices.

monsters.name: eleionoma
monsters.description: Spirits of marshes and bogs. From the cypresses and willows of the fens stems the power of these fierce protective spirits. With the boughs and branches they flow, emerging from trees near their foes to strike.

monsters.name: fenstrider witch
monsters.description: Followers of the ancient swamp ways, these witches rise above the muck and mire on a pair of stilt-like chicken legs. They are masters of pain and poison.

monsters.name: will-o-the-wisp
monsters.description: A green-glowing gaseous entity, flickering and pulsing irregularly as it hovers through the air. Travelers have been known to confuse these for distant lanterns - a mistake rarely made twice.

monsters.name: dread lich
monsters.description: A lich who has made terrible pacts with demonic forces to augment its dark magic.

monsters.name: deep elf zephyrmancer
monsters.description: An elf with a singular focus on the magic of the air, leaving little time to study anything else.

monsters.name: armour echo
monsters.description: The sweat and toil of the armourer working leather and steel infuses an intention into their creation, a unique spark within every cuirass, pauldron and vambrace. A skilled forgewright can manifest these intentions in physical form, allowing their armour to protect its wearer in a more aggressive fashion than armour customarily does.

monsters.name: rockslime
monsters.description: An oozing avalanche, scouring the ground beneath it as it rumbles forward. It consumes only the metal and bone from its victims, using them to reinforce itself even further.

monsters.name: void ooze
monsters.description: The viscous detritus of a thousand failed spells, surging forward with unnerving speed. Its very substance is a hole in the fabric of magic; enchantments find no purchase there and even momentary contact with it can leave one's spells greatly diminished.

monsters.name: ironbound frostheart
monsters.description: An emaciated warrior-mage, bound to guard long-coveted treasures. It calls forth deadly frost from its surrounds, freezing foes that are next to walls.

monsters.name: ironbound thunderhulk
monsters.description: A brutish figure, hastily armoured in scraps of leather and metal to combat a fearsome intruder. On its back is an antique, arcane 'lightning rod', which calls down thunder on distant foes, although it cannot hit nearby targets.

monsters.name: ironbound beastmaster
monsters.description: A cruel and unruly brute who growls in the language of the untamed. Its very presence provokes and overworks non-sapient, living beasts and slimes alike into a rapid fervour.

monsters.name: salamander tyrant
monsters.description: An intimidating volcano lord. It commands the magma of its realm as an extension of its body, and the majesty of its gaze can weaken even the proudest challenger.

monsters.name: Mlioglotl
monsters.description: A demon prince once possessed a hunger for power that was exceptional even by the standards of his kind. He betrayed his realm to Lugonu, and his reward was to become this twisted mass of corruption, now known only as Mlioglotl.

monsters.name: cactus giant
monsters.description: A green-skinned, spiny colossus, with a hearty barrel chest and a thirst for battle. Any foe that strikes it in melee will be lucky to live to regret it.

monsters.name: creeping inferno
monsters.description: A formless mass of ancient fire, bound by heat and malevolence. It longs to unleash itself as a wild fire storm, yet must first patiently burn towards its victims with implaceable inevitability.

monsters.name: searing wretch
monsters.description: An animated corpse alight with terrible fire. The flames are fueled by its regenerating flesh, which bubbles and melts as it grows.

monsters.name: stoker
monsters.description: A mortal who made an unholy pact in life, now chained to tend the fires of hell in undeath as payment.

monsters.name: quicksilver elemental
monsters.description: A mercurial spirit drawn from the elemental plane of earth. It exists in this world by inhabiting a shimmering body of liquid metal.

monsters.name: crystal echidna
monsters.description: A spiny, long snouted rodent grown out of pure living crystal. It is immune to most forms of magic and hurls both crystallising shots and painful barbs.

monsters.name: putrid mouth
monsters.description: A starved spirit whose mouth is a pit of rot, emitting vile fumes. Its putrid maw cannot eat the food it finds, so it moans with rage and desparate hunger.

monsters.name: tainted leviathan
monsters.description: Before even the oldest of ancient liches mastered life and death, a group of titans attempted to pull themselves free of mortality through brute strength. They almost succeeded before rot dragged them to Ereshkigal. A glimmer of their former beauty remains, alluring despite the stench.

monsters.name: wendigo
monsters.description: A gaunt spirit of frozen hunger, so ravenous it will consume friend and foe alike. According to legend, if one cuts off its legs, it will feast upon its own marrow. It stalks those lost wandering in the cold and hunts with the force of blizzards.

monsters.name: nargun
monsters.description: An ancient stone creature that has lived among these frozen caves since before Antaeus rent Cocytus into being. It tolerates its new neighbors begrudgingly, preferring the company of its petrified enemies. Veins of ice permeate its frozen stone flesh.

monsters.name: Head Instructor
monsters.description: A powerful warrior-mage who instructs aspiring students in physical, magical, and anti-magical combat.

monsters.name: living spell
monsters.description: A spell, waiting to cast itself at the first foe that enters its range. Once it does, it'll dissipate into the ether.

monsters.name: walking tome
monsters.description: A spellbook that has gone too long without being read. It overflows with magic, forming thick armour from its binding, legs from its pages, and periodically erupting in flurries of free-floating, self-casting spells.

monsters.name: walking earthen tome
monsters.description:
A spellbook that has gone too long without being read. It overflows with magic, forming thick armour from its binding, legs from its pages, and periodically erupting in flurries of free-floating, self-casting spells.

It is coated with impossibly ancient dust.

monsters.name: walking crystal tome
monsters.description:
A spellbook that has gone too long without being read. It overflows with magic, forming thick armour from its binding, legs from its pages, and periodically erupting in flurries of free-floating, self-casting spells.

It is encrusted with long, sharp, deadly-looking crystals.

monsters.name: walking divine tome
monsters.description:
A spellbook that has gone too long without being read. It overflows with magic, forming thick armour from its binding, legs from its pages, and periodically erupting in flurries of free-floating, self-casting spells.

Its cover bears the icon of a long-forgotten god, still fully possessed of wrath.

monsters.name: walking frostbound tome
monsters.description:
A spellbook that has gone too long without being read. It overflows with magic, forming thick armour from its binding, legs from its pages, and periodically erupting in flurries of free-floating, self-casting spells.

It glistens with a thick layer of unmelting ice.

monsters.name: strange machine
monsters.description: A strange mechanical contraption, all hisses and pops. Shadows seem to dance across its reflective surface.

monsters.name: spectator
monsters.description: A follower of Okawaru, granted the honour of spectating a duel to the death.

monsters.name: bound soul
monsters.description: The soul of a living, holy, or demonic creature, captured by a dark sacrifice to Yredelemnul. The bound soul will follow its captor through stairs and come when recalled from a different level.

monsters.name: pharaoh ant
monsters.description: A royal ant returned to unlife through strange, probably horrifying means. It binds the souls of its allies when slain, allowing them to fight on after death as simulacra.

monsters.name: steelbarb worm
monsters.description: A large worm covered with hard, spiky metal plates. Despite the apparent heaviness of its outer armour, it is rather fast.

monsters.name: jorogumo
monsters.description: A spider spirit that takes the appearance of a human. It weaves deadly magics to incapacitate and kill its prey.

monsters.name: broodmother
monsters.description: A giant spider swollen with eggs. Its innumerable offspring are always at its call.

monsters.name: culicivora
monsters.description: A small spider with rudimentary healing abilities. Though not undead, it packs a nasty vampiric bite.

monsters.name: sun moth
monsters.description: A moth of transcendent beauty, coated in pyrophoric scales. Tiny cinders dance and twirl in its wake and whenever it beats its wings, they ignite in such spectacular displays of incandescence that one could almost forget how far away the sun is from this place.

monsters.name: radroach
monsters.description: A giant cockroach that has been exposed to high amounts of mutagenic energy. It is horrifyingly mutated, but this has only made it stronger.

monsters.name: Parghit
monsters.description: An unusually strong troll, his thick frame scarred by many against-the-odds victories. He has been wounded so many times that his body has adapted, and now heals almost instantly. His necklace of troll claws is a memento of those who underestimated him.

monsters.name: Josephina
monsters.description: A fearsome necromancer who followed her craft beyond the limits of flesh and life. Her pursuit of demonic knowledge left her body ruined, but the powers she gained allowed her to rebuild her missing limbs from glittering ice.

monsters.name: Amaemon
monsters.description: Amaemon always knew he was different, but it was still a horrific surprise when his demonic heritage manifested. As his body twisted, Amaemon was forced to flee far from the surface. The passage of time has only left him more obsessed with what he has lost - consumed by poison both physical and spiritual.

monsters.name: Lodul
monsters.description: An ogre emissary of the Ironbound Order, sent to find and stop intruders before they enter the Vaults. Fiercely charismatic, he's rallied a small army of his kin, overawing them with the long-range lightning array he wears on his back. (The large coin purse he took from the Vaults is also quite persuasive.)

monsters.name: Vv
monsters.description: One of the Stoneborn, formed untold aeons ago with supreme command over rock. Her people shelter deep within the living earth, so whatever has forced Vv into the oppressive openness of the Dungeon must be dire indeed. But whatever it is, she's not talking...

monsters.name: Zenata
monsters.description: A master weaponsmith, her flesh melding into steel so smoothly that it's hard to tell where one ends and the other begins. She entered the Dungeon to search for the secrets of an ancient, long-suppressed cult, said to have exalted metal over flesh. The price of knowledge was her humanity - a price she paid eagerly.

monsters.name: Grunn
monsters.description: A brutally twisted undead gnoll in the eternal service of Ereshkigal, lord of Tartarus. Legend has it that he sold his soul to return his most beloved hunting dog to life. Whether that hound is a member of his current pack, none can say.

monsters.name: starflower
monsters.description: A mass of lashing vines and tentacles growing out of the husk of a dead star. Space itself runs through the xylem and phloem of its branches, which appear to be in many places at once.

monsters.name: sickly merfolk siren
monsters.description: A young merfolk that looks quite sick, but still has the power to mesmerise its victims.

monsters.name: malarious merfolk avatar
monsters.description: A young merfolk that looks deeply ill, but is still capable of bespelling its audience.

monsters.name: skyshark
monsters.description: Skysharks cut through the air with a thoughtless ease. Just a taste of blood gives them an enraged strength, and further morsels drive them into a frenzy.

monsters.name: sleepcap
monsters.description: A surprisingly ambulatory mushroom. It wafts its spores over prey to send them into a deep sleep, making it simple for the fungus to kill and devour them. It can take months for its mycelia to fully infiltrate and digest victims.

monsters.name: cerulean imp
monsters.description: A small, wilful minor demon. Its wings, far larger than its scrawny body, were made to soar, and it lands only rarely and with the greatest reluctance.

monsters.name: formless jellyfish
monsters.description: A gelatinous assemblage of tentacles and venom, leaving a glistening trail as it slides along. Surely such a mockery of life could not be natural..?

monsters.name: Jeremiah
monsters.description: Jeremiah was a peaceful dreamer, prone to impromptu naps. They slipped into slumber while gazing into a magical orb, and dreamed of an old and hateful power binding them into service. Now Jeremiah stumbles through the dungeon, searching for the precious dreamshard that will restore their master’s power, unsure whether they wake or slumber still. Their dreams leak into reality in the form of a constant stream of butterflies.

monsters.name: boulder
monsters.description: A mass of fast-rolling stone, crushing everything in its path.

monsters.name: arcanist
monsters.description: A wizard fond of spectacle and destruction. They scorn the cowardice of other magicians, who hide from their foes rather than simply blasting them out of existence.

monsters.name: antique champion
monsters.description: An unfathomably expensive skeleton. It has countless sigils engraved into its bones, and pulses with a ghostly presence.

monsters.name: kobold blastminer
monsters.description: A kobold, ready with multiple armaments to defend itself from the many dangers of the depths. The blastmote-packed cannon on its shoulder bears its maker's mark, and is fiercely loyal; it will fire for none other.

monsters.name: inugami
monsters.description:
A mystical canine, frequently bound into the service of wizards and sorcerers. Its eyes flicker with remarkable intelligence, but its bite is no less sharp than its wilder cousins.

They are difficult to truly kill - when gravely wounded, they instead return to spiritual form to lick their wounds until ready to be summoned again.

monsters.name: protean progenitor
monsters.description: A gargantuan humanoid of fractured shape from the aeons when the seas were but primordial soup. The many shapeshifters of the dungeon once sloughed off from these unfathomably ancient beings, and when they themselves finally cease, even their remains will give birth one last time to furious monsters.

monsters.name: aspiring flesh
monsters.description: The divided and churning remains of a protean progenitor, striving desperately for form. Whatever they become, the last of their progenitor's power ensure it will be stronger and swifter than any such creature found elsewhere in the dungeon.

monsters.name: oni
monsters.description: A large, rowdy, and drink-loving creature. When they're not busy with their duties serving any number of gods, oni mostly love a good fight.

monsters.name: bombardier beetle
monsters.description: An unassuming beetle filled with an incredible amount of hypergolic fluid. The sticky spray it fires is capable of igniting predators and unwary adventurers alike, though more experienced ones know to keep moving if they wish to avoid a fiery grave.

monsters.name: weeping skull
monsters.description: An undead skull kept aloft by unholy clouds of collective misery, which slowly drift out in its wake. It mourns without end for the living, the dead, and its own former life all alike.

monsters.name: burial acolyte
monsters.description: A masked priest in the service of Kikubaaqudgha, well-versed in choral rituals to both rouse the dead and send them to eternal rest.

monsters.name: blazeheart core
monsters.description: The exposed elemental core of a blazeheart golem. Far too unstable to remain without its shell, it is in the process of violently exploding.

monsters.name: martyred shade
monsters.description: The wandering shade of a long-dead soul who died for a forgotten cause. Though their memories have turned to mist, something deep within still compels them to serve and sacrifice - no matter the cost.

monsters.name: orc apostle
monsters.description:
An orcish wayfarer who has been touched by the hand of Beogh. Whether out of religious devotion or personal jealousy, they have come to bar your path.

Hold nothing back - for neither they nor their followers will do so.

Glory to Beogh!

monsters.name: sacred lotus
monsters.description: A large and vivid bloom drifting placidly upon the surface of the water. The cradle of the lotus's petals shine with eternity and elegance - while it is entirely harmless, it would take immense effort to destroy it.

monsters.name: thermic dynamo
monsters.description: A clashing tempest of boundless energy, channelling into capacitor jewels. Its whirls of fire and ice occasionally escape and ricochet wildly off of walls.

monsters.name: obsidian bat
monsters.description: A faceless stone bat unearthed from infernal chasms. Devilish beasts hunt in its wake.

monsters.name: pile of debris
monsters.description: A heavily ruptured stonework, surrounded by rubble.

monsters.name: pillar of rime
monsters.description: A spire of strangely tenebrous ice, its brittle tendrils reaching skyward like the fingers of an outstretched hand. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'spells')}}

monsters.name: hoarfrost cannon
monsters.description: An elegant siege weapon, magically sculpted from crystalline ice. As ephemeral as a summer snowstorm, every salvo it fires consumes a portion of itself until nothing is left behind but water.

monsters.name: polterguardian
monsters.description: Many poltergeists are fiercely territorial over the domains they choose to haunt, but these have extended that protection even to the people who share their domain with them. Some say they must be the lingering souls of those who guarded the Vaults in life; others suggest the Ironbound Order simply recruited them in common cause. Whichever is true, their very presence shelters other creatures from missiles, causing sling and spell alike to veer off-course at the last moment.

monsters.name: marrowcuda
monsters.description:
The flame-wreathed skeleton of a carnivorous fish, darting through air as easily as it once parted water. It burns with a hunger it could not satisfy in life and is singularly driven by in death.

While a single one may be only a nuisance, the swarm is never far behind, and every bite it lands will summon more and more of them until every scrap of flesh on its prey has been devoured.

monsters.name: undying armoury
monsters.description: A swirling tempest of souls and steel: knights and blacksmiths and weaponmasters, all bound to weapons they once held in life. To fight one is like fighting an entire army.

monsters.name: Xak'krixis
monsters.description:
It has been centuries since outsiders were last allowed access to the cavernous libraries of the formicids, but their emissaries are still seen from time to time - surveying other lands for resources or scientific discoveries that might aid the colony.

This one's study of the magical fibres excreted by orb spiders has already led to an alchemical breakthrough, allowing them to shape fulminant prisms such that their explosions are directed at enemies alone. Alas, their enthusiasm to conduct a field test bodes poorly for your health.

monsters.name: hellfire mortar
monsters.description: A terrifying weapon hewn from molten rock. It rains fiery destruction down upon its creators' enemies.

monsters.name: shadow puppet
monsters.description:
A minor servant of living shadow whose form wavers perpetually on the edge of recognition - as if an unseen light were flickering behind something almost familiar.

The strength of its attacks increases in proportion with the power of the spell which summoned it.

monsters.name: shadow prism
monsters.description: A prism-like silhouette which wavers with barely-contained destructive energy. Any blow which disrupts its form will result in a violent blast of shadow.

monsters.name: soul wisp
monsters.description: A tiny fragment of a living soul, splintered from the body in which it belongs. Too mindless to be fully controlled, it seeks nothing but to reunite with its greater self once more - unfortunately, this process tends to be more violent than the magic which created it.

monsters.name: globe of annihilation
monsters.description: A roiling sphere of intense destructive energies, drawn from the fabric of the Hells themselves. It pursues a designated target inexorably, growing in size as it travels. If it collides with either a creature or wall, it will explode violently - though its creator is protected from the wild destruction unleashed as it does so.

monsters.name: fravashi
monsters.description: A beneficent remnant of the countless mortal knights who serve the Shining One. Their hosts' role in the divine hierarchy is to guide and direct their legions in righteous moral warfare, though they may also call upon those mortals to defend themselves.

monsters.name: nekomata
monsters.description: An upright feliform trickster of an elderly demon, with a forked tail ablaze with a shimmering haze. It holds a deep disdain for mortal humanoids, a patronising pity for mortal cats, and enough mystic might to subjugate both.

monsters.name: clockwork bee
monsters.description: A mechanical insect powered by an intricate array of gears and springs. It is vicious and resilient to damage, but its clockwork naturally winds down as it attacks, eventually leaving it unable to move until its creator winds it again.

monsters.name: dormant clockwork bee
monsters.description: A mechanical insect powered by an intricate array of gears and springs. It has run out of power and can only be rewound by its creator moving into it.

monsters.name: diamond sawblade
monsters.description: A serrated disc forged of razor-sharp material. It spins in place at high velocity, shredding through flesh and metal alike.

monsters.name: platinum paragon
monsters.description: A gleaming warrior, wrought from precious metals and the very pinnacle of forgecraft techniques. Its every motion flows with a deadly, fluid grace that belies its artifical nature.

monsters.name: walking alembic
monsters.description: A mobile and combat-capable alchemical manufactory that uses the friction of melee combat to brew a variety of useful potions. When it has built up enough heat to complete its synthesis, it will automatically dispense the finished potions to nearby allies and fall apart.

monsters.name: monarch bomb
monsters.description: A flying munitions factory, held aloft on jets of fiery exhaust and packed to the brim with explosives. It can rapidly fill an area with bomblets, and when commanded by its creator, will explode them all (and itself) to devastating effect.

monsters.name: bomblet
monsters.description: A small metal sphere surrounding a core of dormant fire magic. When given the proper command, it will detonate in a blast of metal and flame that is only partially affected by fire resistance.

monsters.name: splinterfrost barricade
monsters.description: A durable barricade made of ice reinforced with forgecraft magic. A lattice of precise hairline cracks are visible just beneath its surface which allow it to fracture into a barrage of razor-sharp projectiles whenever it sustains critical damage.

monsters.name: seismosaurus
monsters.description: A stubborn and fiercely territorial lizard with the strength of a mountain. Its thunderous footfalls herald violent tremors.

monsters.name: seismosaurus egg
monsters.description: A lizard egg the size of a small boulder and nearly as hard. Perhaps as a defence mechanism, they hatch rapidly in the presence of predators and even a newborn can give all but the most ambitious of monsters a reason to consider an easier meal.

monsters.name: phalanx beetle
monsters.description:
An intricate mechanical beetle covered in reinforced metal plates that resemble a shield. It projects a kinetic barrier around its creator while adjacent to them, increasing their armour class.

It will never voluntarily leave its creator's side, and if forcibly separated, will prioritise returning to them over any other concerns.

monsters.name: rending blade
monsters.description: A crackling weapon formed of condensed magical energy. It can cut through entire rows of adversaries whenever its creator lands a melee attack.

monsters.name: shadow turret
monsters.description: A strangely static silhouette whose form suggests a large cannon. Though it uses no gunpowder, the depths of its bore flickers angrily with every shot, as if remembering the fiery light of its ignition.

monsters.name: alderking
monsters.description: A self-styled monarch of a shambling black alder, half respected and half ridiculed by other fae. It backs up its aspirations to sovereignty with unearthly vile magic quite close to a touch of death.

monsters.name: oni incarcerator
monsters.description: An infamous, dutiful retainer of Gehenna. These immense and indomitable oni weave their weapons through reality itself to reach and capture the innumerable damned souls owed to the hells upon their deaths.

monsters.name: wyrmhole
monsters.description: A small and strangely serpentine fold in space and time. Scholars once theorised the Dungeon's easy access to manifold unholy realms is due to the tunneling of yet-undiscovered translocations dragons. Whether or not this is true, distant stars mottle this drake's endless lengths, and dimensions bend to its writhing whim.

monsters.name: sphinx marauder
monsters.description: A wicked youthful hybrid with a woman's head, a lion's body, and the wings of an eagle. It gleefully wreaks havoc with both the violent turbulence of high winds and the frustration of bewildering magics.

monsters.name: haunted armour
monsters.description: An ordinary piece of armour, held in your haunting grip. It can attack nearby enemies, but must return to your side if you ever stray too far from it.

monsters.name: poltergeist
monsters.description: A ghostly trickster that is fond of possessing small objects and making them fly noisily through the air.

monsters.name: vampire bloodprince
monsters.description: A scornful scion to whom even other vampires bend the knee. Their command over blood magic allows them to feed upon the lifeforce of entire armies at once.

monsters.name: revenant
monsters.description: The skeletal remains of someone who died unmourned and forgotten. It burns with an unquenchable hunger to be remembered.

monsters.name: Nobody
monsters.description:
A time-lost revenant, risen not from the death of a single individual but of many - its bones fused together from the young and the elderly and different species altogether. Whether they were all the victims of a single massacre or a thousand souls discarded over a thousand years is impossible to say now; history does not remember them.

But one thing is clear: they will fight to change that until every last memory they have left burns away.

monsters.name: petrified flower
monsters.description: A sizeable and statuesque flower, fossilised either by bitter grief or the cruel grace of divinity, standing in its own eternal vigil.

monsters.name: solar ember
monsters.description:
A mote of intense light and heat manifested by a sun scarab. It is linked to their essence and will never leave their side, being reconstituted time and time again whenever it is extinguished.

Some myths even claim that the sun which shines down upon the outside world was once carried around by such a scarab.

monsters.name: goblin rider
monsters.description: Goblin clans fractured over the advent of steel exoskeletons long ago, prompting an experimental arms race for goblin hegemony. Some volunteered to join forces with other species, an alliance that has enabled capturing and taming wyverns. From uptop their majestic dragon-like mounts, these goblins swiftly soar about and skewer those who intrude upon their allies' domain.

monsters.name: ironbound mechanist
monsters.description: A well-armoured coglin whose talents with machinery have been harnessed by the Ironbound order to repair and augment the many constructs that help guard the Vaults.

monsters.name: Sprozz
monsters.description: A former beekeeper's apprentice with an ambitious dream: to modernise the whole world's beekeeping industry with the smooth certainty of disease-proof metal. His methods may be questionable and his goals dubious, but his prototype's stinger still looks awfully sharp...

monsters.name: crawling flesh cage
monsters.description: A modern breakthrough in arcane experimentation, this mobile prison cell weaponises the living fragments of once-escaped ugly things, extending the reach of their tendrils to thrash multiple foes at once from a distance.

monsters.name: cognitogaunt
monsters.description: A wizened, headless corpse, animated not by conventional necromancy but by the mournful malice of dead stars. Its psychic eyes, floating disjointedly from its body's movements, relentlessly burrow through its victims' minds.

monsters.name: chonchon
monsters.description: Some sorcerers care little for unholy realms or undead forms, seeking power instead in the whims of cruel chaos. This ominous owl-winged head is all that remains of a former archmage: it delights in spreading misfortune and drinking blood in its new airborne form.

monsters.name: kobold fleshcrafter
monsters.description: A skull-masked kobold, its body mutated by forbidden magics. It conducts vile experiments in the service of demonic powers, formulating ever more terrible monstrosities as vessels for devilish minds.

monsters.name: pile of flesh
monsters.description: A leftover mess of broken bones, inert grasping organs, and scattered skin. While some highly-specialised sorcerers might be capable of bringing it to life, it is otherwise harmless - the possible leftovers of some departed or absent-minded magus.

monsters.name: zykzyl
monsters.description: A demon born of mortal envy, its flesh undulating with a sickening wetness whenever it moves. It is driven by a singular desire to reduce all beauty to a form as hideous as its own.

monsters.name: boundless tesseract
monsters.description:
An impossible shape that scintillates with unearthly colour. The power of Zot flows heavily through it, overlaying this reality with countless others where its domain remains pristine.

Each tesseract is inextricably linked to the other, and destroying one will destroy both (and expel all the creatures they have beckoned to this reality, as well as dazing even those which they have not). But so long as they are allowed to exist, there will be no end to the forces which seek to keep you from the Orb.

monsters.name: orb of entropy
monsters.description: A globe of profound nothingness and the oblivion that awaits all things - flesh, souls, and even time itself. When the universe ends, only these will remain.

monsters.name: orb of winter
monsters.description: A globe of deepest cold, still lingering from a time before the stars lit the heavens. It can shroud the soul in a chill so intense that even the gods cannot reach it.

monsters.name: screaming refraction
monsters.description: A deeply unfortunate soul mostly processed into crystal by some malevolent tear in reality. Ethereal reflections of its past and future suffering are cast upon nearby surfaces and foes.

monsters.name: shooting star
monsters.description:
A glimmering spark of magical energy. It seeks out nearby enemies to expend itself upon, dealing damage and pushing them backwards.

It does not block its allies' line of fire.

monsters.name: Cassandra
monsters.description:
As a young woman, Cassandra bound herself in service to Ashenzari and was blessed and cursed in equal measure - granted the ability to foresee disasters, but only those she was powerless to prevent.

Eventually driven from her homeland as a harbinger of the very plagues she'd spent a lifetime warning against, she has come to the dungeon in her final days in hope of averting one last catastrophe.

monsters.name: bes kemwar
monsters.description: A minor hairy maggot spirit, phasing in and out of this plane. Each regional variant inflicts different minor ailments: the ones found in the Dungeon cause one's magic to grow weak.

monsters.name: rock fish
monsters.description: A strange stone-scaled fish that swims through solid rock with the same ease that most fish do through water.

monsters.name: clockroach
monsters.description:
A common dungeon pest that combines the worst features of a scavenging insect and a looming deadline.

Time flows strangely around it, rewinding any injuries inflicted upon it unless the source of them is near enough to be caught up in its timestream.

monsters.name: kobold geomancer
monsters.description: A wily kobold who has learned to weaponise every crack and crevice that lines the walls of its domain.

monsters.name: mountainshell
monsters.description: An enormous land tortoise whose shell is so thick and rock-encrusted that sleeping ones are frequently mistaken for geological formations. And like a mountain, its exterior is nearly impervious to any destructive force; only at close range can one properly aim for the narrow gaps between its plates to strike the tender flesh within.

monsters.name: undertaker
monsters.description: The Dungeon's vast repositories of the dead and the unholy realms thereafter both require regular restocking and reorganisation, far beyond the coordination of the restless dead. These corpse-collecting constructs burrow through the earth and command divisions of zombified hands to assist them in stealing away carrion, and may also violently create new corpses for such purposes.

monsters.name: erythrospite
monsters.description:
A churning mass of flowing blood that throbs to the beat of an absent heart.

Does it wish to bury itself in your arteries because it recognises, on some primordial level, that this is where it belongs? Alas, all it is capable of in this fleeing moment of sentience is violence.

monsters.name: morphogenic ooze
monsters.description: A multihued mire of roiling flesh and fluctuating sludge, striving and failing for more coherence than any other slime. As a fresh carrier of the ruinous contagion that overtook the Slime Pits, it can impart unto others the same horrible fate. While it may not be a permanent transformation for you, the melding of weapons and armour, as well as the severe weakening of spells, may make it a lethal one regardless.

monsters.name: slymdra
monsters.description:
A quivering amalgam of viscous slime, its many pseudopods gnashing at the air like a throng of reptilian maws. It rapidly absorbs nearby slime creatures into itself, growing a new 'head' for each one and becoming even more resilient.

Whether through convergent evolution or genetic memory, it also shares the hydra's most infamous trait: lopping off a head with a bladed weapon will just make it grow two more unless the wound is cauterised by a flaming weapon.

When not stalking prey, its constituent slimes may separate from it again, perhaps to seek new food sources on their own.

monsters.name: creeping plasmodium
monsters.description: An enormous and unnervingly motile slime mold colony. It creeps along the crevices of the walls in search of nutrients and can spread itself to new locations by launching enormous sporangia.

monsters.name: caustic sporangium
monsters.description: A balloon-like sac of slime mold spores, suspended in a nutrient slurry to sustain them on their search for a new home. To the great misfortune of any adventurers in the vicinity, this slurry is also a highly potent acid.

monsters.name: nascent plasmodium
monsters.description: A slime mold colony in an early phase of its life cycle. Not yet mature enough to reproduce, it can still defend itself by firing globs of potent acid.

monsters.name: star jelly
monsters.description: A white gelatinous mound that pulses with a strange iridescence. Its body absorbs magical energy like a sponge, and when sufficiently injured, will unleash this energy as a flurry of shooting stars.

monsters.name: burstshroom
monsters.description: A rapidly-growing mushroom whose life-cycle culminates in an explosive release of spores. These spores have a mild psychoactive effect and can sometimes daze creatures who breathe them in.

monsters.name: stack of scrap
monsters.description: A tarnished towering mess of half-assembled constructs and spare broken parts.

monsters.name: mongrel wurm
monsters.description: A serpentine crossbreed, blending traits of lesser dragons and countless other creatures that nature never intended to interbreed. Its many stunted limbs struggle to propel its grime-coated body, while its oversized scaleless head wheezes with the pressure of clashing breath weapons.

monsters.name: rusted inspector
monsters.description: A slithering metal construct, once built to monitor for mutated entities encroaching upon the Vaults and long-since abandoned. While it can still dampen most unwanted magic, a lack of proper maintenance has led to its becoming coated with a highly corrosive mystic rust.

monsters.name: fungal shambler
monsters.description: Through considerable effort, certain strains of fungi may be cultivated and mutated to ravenously parasitise living tissue. This particular variety has consumed the flesh and possessions of whatever intruder was fed to it and now serves as a roving guard, wielding scavenged armaments and its own explosive spores.

monsters.name: roaming sludgefish
monsters.description: A mutant sewer fish whose continuous exposure to wild magic has given it an appetite for magic itself. It swims through the air in a telekinetic bubble of the very sludge that gave birth to it, seeking out exotic prey from which to siphon novel magic.

monsters.name: telencephalon
monsters.description:
An abandoned arcane experiment, its original purpose more inscrutable than most. Made of magical crystal fused with mutant brain tissue, it bobs about autonomously and erratically, sparking all the while.

When badly damaged, it will unleash a staggering telekinetic shockwave, knocking back those in its surroundings and inflicting irresistible confusion on any who might harm it.

monsters.name: sewage sovereign
monsters.description: A hulking mutant swine who feasts like a king upon the abundant fungus of its realm and lords over its other denizens with brute force and unstoppable bulk.

monsters.name: scrapshell chimera
monsters.description: A living engine of aquatic animal flesh fused with a colossal mass of bewitched metal scrap. Such hybrid terrors are perhaps the most successful experiments conducted in these tainted waters: its necromantically-attuned shell and a diet of furious drowned thieves has granted even this thrashing beast the ability to control the sunken souls of its countless victims.

monsters.name: glowmurk ghast
monsters.description: A shuddering, shimmering apparition borne from the drowned dead, repeatedly called to this plane by some cruel mystic experiment. It will share its memories and experiences of drowning in tainted waters with whatever it first touches, then dissipate.

monsters.name: Goji
monsters.description:
An intrepid goblin who has somehow managed to tame a ghost moth as his mount. While the elaborate snarl of ropes he is using to remain upright on it surely undermines the moth's own mobility, even a hobbled ghost moth can be a deadly adversary.

And Goji? Well. He's also here.

monsters.name: Goji
monsters.description:
An intrepid goblin who has somehow managed to tame a ghost moth as his mount. While the elaborate snarl of ropes he is using to remain upright on it surely undermines the moth's own mobility, even a hobbled ghost moth can be a deadly adversary.

And Goji? Well. He's also here.

monsters.name: herald of the Abyss
monsters.description: A mutated devotee of Lugonu, warped by years of living in the Abyss. It has ascended into an exalted representative of Lugonu's spite against the rest of all existence and solemnly tears apart reality in Lugonu's name.

monsters.name: abyssal acolyte
monsters.description: A missionary in the service of Lugonu, with remnants of its headless body spilling from a roaming spatial rift. It seeks to teach others the joy and strength of slowly decoupling from this particular plane of reality.

monsters.name: airy jade
monsters.description: A floating shard of crystaline jade which resonates with your air magic.

monsters.name: earthen jade
monsters.description: A floating shard of crystaline jade which resonates with your earth magic.

monsters.name: fiery jade
monsters.description: A floating shard of crystaline jade which resonates with your fire magic.

monsters.name: icy jade
monsters.description: A floating shard of crystaline jade which resonates with your ice magic.

monsters.name: hypnotail
monsters.description: The shed tail of a hypnogecko, still pulsing with mesmerising colours and compelling any nearby predators to focus their attention on it instead of the unfortunate lizard it once belonged to.

monsters.name: chain-warden
monsters.description: A hulking ironbound jailer forged to hunt bands of trespassers together. It hurls heavy iron harpoons to drag distant quarry into its reach and binds groups of adventurers with resonant chains.

monsters.name: void-tether stalker
monsters.description: A predatory entity of hungry dimensional static that stalks separated companions across the fractures of reality. It warps space to isolate its prey and drains their magical reserves with every strike.

weapons.name: club
weapons.description: A heavy piece of wood. While clubs are rather primitive weapons, bashing someone's skull in with one remains a very popular and effective means of dispute resolution.

weapons.name: whip
weapons.description: A long plaited strip of leather. Originally developed for use in disagreements with cattle, this simple weapon is now widely used to settle differences between all sorts of creatures.

weapons.name: hammer
weapons.description: A blunt striking weapon, essentially equivalent to a mace.

weapons.name: mace
weapons.description: A short club with a metal head.

weapons.name: flail
weapons.description: A mace with a short chain connecting the head to the haft.

weapons.name: morningstar
weapons.description: A mace with a head covered in short spikes.

weapons.name: dire flail
weapons.description: A flail with long spikes and a heavy head.

weapons.name: eveningstar
weapons.description: The opposite of a morningstar. A balanced mace with a long shaft and a metal head covered in lethal spikes.

weapons.name: great mace
weapons.description: An enormous metal war club, of great cumbrousness.

weapons.name: dagger
weapons.description: A double-edged fighting knife with a sharp point.

weapons.name: quick blade
weapons.description: A dagger with an uncanny enchantment upon it, allowing it to strike twice for every blow its wielder makes. It takes great skill to use to its full potential.

weapons.name: short sword
weapons.description: A personal stabbing weapon with a short grip.

weapons.name: rapier
weapons.description: A slender, sharply pointed sword, with an uncommonly elegant design.

weapons.name: falchion
weapons.description: A long single-edged sword with a slightly curved blade.

weapons.name: long sword
weapons.description: A sword with a long, slashing blade.

weapons.name: scimitar
weapons.description: A long sword with a wide, curved blade.

weapons.name: great sword
weapons.description: A sword with a very long, heavy blade and a long handle.

weapons.name: hand axe
weapons.description: A small axe.

weapons.name: war axe
weapons.description: A military axe with a long haft and a single-bladed head.

weapons.name: broad axe
weapons.description: An axe with langets, spikes, a lengthed haft and a single-bladed crescent head.

weapons.name: battleaxe
weapons.description: A large war axe with a formidable double-sided head.

weapons.name: executioner's axe
weapons.description: A fearsome weapon covered in dried blood and crude engravings of torture and death, bearing an enormous axehead.

weapons.name: spear
weapons.description: A hunting weapon consisting of a wooden shaft with a pointed metal head fastened on one end.

weapons.name: trident
weapons.description: A fishing spear improved with a longer shaft and a three-pronged metal head.

weapons.name: halberd
weapons.description: A polearm consisting of an axe blade topped with a spike, mounted on a long shaft.

weapons.name: glaive
weapons.description: A pole with a large, heavy blade on one end.

weapons.name: bardiche
weapons.description: A long pole with an enormous, cleaving blade on one end.

weapons.name: arbalest
weapons.description: A large piece of machinery used for firing bolts, braced with steel and cranked with a windlass. It takes some time to load and fire.

weapons.name: shortbow
weapons.description: A curved piece of wood and string, for shooting arrows.

weapons.name: longbow
weapons.description: A long, strong bow made of yew.

weapons.name: demon whip
weapons.description: A terrible weapon, woven in the depths of the inferno.

weapons.name: giant club
weapons.description: A giant lump of wood.

weapons.name: giant spiked club
weapons.description: A giant lump of wood with sharp spikes at one end.

weapons.name: demon blade
weapons.description: A terrible weapon, forged in the fires of Hell.

weapons.name: double sword
weapons.description: A fearsome weapon with a forked, razor-sharp blade.

weapons.name: triple sword
weapons.description: A formidable weapon created by a master craftsman. The blade of the sword forks into three great razor-sharp edges.

weapons.name: demon trident
weapons.description: A terrible three-pronged weapon, moulded by fire and brimstone.

weapons.name: scythe
weapons.description: A farm implement, usually only used by untrained mobs in combat. In practice, it's quite similar to a halberd.

weapons.name: staff
weapons.description: A staff improved with arcane powers of unknown nature.

weapons.name: quarterstaff
weapons.description: A sturdy wooden pole, meant for fighting.

weapons.name: lajatang
weapons.description: A very rare and extremely effective weapon, featuring a pole with half-moon blades at both ends.

weapons.name: sling
weapons.description: A piece of cloth and leather for launching stones, adequate for hunting small game like rabbits or goblins.

weapons.name: eudemon blade
weapons.description: A sacred blade from the forges of Heaven, inhabited by a good spirit. It is a favoured weapon of the Shining One's servants.

weapons.name: sacred scourge
weapons.description: A blessed weapon, woven by the saints in Heaven and hated by the unholy. It is a favoured weapon of the Shining One's servants.

weapons.name: trishula
weapons.description: A blessed trident moulded by cleansing flame, with three points symbolising the combined might of the three holy gods. It is a favoured weapon of the Shining One's servants.

weapons.name: hand cannon
weapons.description: A machine that fires metal slugs via applied thaumaturgy. Some enchant their projectiles to fall forward instead of down, others bewitch the slugs with a fatal attraction to their targets. All are slow, loud, and blast out thick smoke with each shot.

weapons.name: triple crossbow
weapons.description: A crossbow with three strings arranged in series to provide exceptional power, initially designed as a siege weapon and then scaled down. It takes a considerable amount of time to load and fire.

weapons.name: orcbow
weapons.description: A recurved bow, crudely crafted from troll-bone and warg hair. The cave orcs' use of archery, so unlike their surface-dwelling ancestors, shows the influence of their elvish allies.

weapons.name: partisan
weapons.description: A long polearm with sharp protrusions on either side of the spearhead.

weapons.name: athame
weapons.description: An ornate and bewitched ritual knife. Even just wielding it will cost a small piece of your health, but blows made with it against those suffering negative statuses (other than poison) have increased base damage, up to +4 for two such baleful ailments.

weapons.name: assassin centipede
weapons.description:
A living weapon whose forcipules are dagger-sharp and reach is long. Its sting can deliver crippling toxins to those it strikes and at higher levels of enchantment, can even briefly slow or paralyse foes.

After performing a moderate number of attacks with this, it will separate itself from your body to attack foes independently for a short while before dying.

armour.name: robe
armour.description: A large, loose-fitting, wide-sleeved outer garment made of light cloth. It offers little protection against physical harm, but does not hinder evasion or spellcasting.

armour.name: leather armour
armour.description: A suit made from layers of tanned animal hide. It provides basic protection with almost no hindrance to spellcasting or stealthy movement.

armour.name: ring mail
armour.description: A light leather suit reinforced with a covering of metal rings. It is protective in combat, but slightly uncomfortable due to the added weight.

armour.name: scale mail
armour.description: A leather suit covered with metal plates attached to each other in overlapping rows to provide full protection, but at the cost of reduced freedom of movement.

armour.name: chain mail
armour.description: A suit of armour made entirely out of tiny metal rings.

armour.name: plate armour
armour.description: A full suit of solid metal plate: cuirass, pauldrons, vambraces, waist plate and greaves. It provides excellent protection.

armour.name: cloak
armour.description: A cloth cloak.

armour.name: hat
armour.description: A cloth hat.

armour.name: helmet
armour.description: A piece of metal headgear.

armour.name: gloves
armour.description: A pair of gloves. They are worn on the hands, and cover all but the largest claws.

armour.name: boots
armour.description: A pair of boots. They are worn on the feet, and cover all but the largest hooves and talons.

armour.name: buckler
armour.description: A small piece of wood and metal, to be strapped on one arm for defence.

armour.name: kite shield
armour.description: A piece of wood and metal, to be strapped on one arm for defence.

armour.name: tower shield
armour.description: A large piece of wood and metal, to be strapped on one arm for defence.

armour.name: crystal plate armour
armour.description: An incredibly heavy but extremely effective suit of crystalline armour.

armour.name: animal skin
armour.description: A large piece of thick skin covered in fur, cut from the corpse of an animal and worn as a primitive garment. It offers rudimentary protection against harm, but, having never been tanned, it carries a light stench of rotting flesh.

armour.name: troll leather armour
armour.description: The stiff and knobbly skin of a troll. It magically regenerates its wearer's flesh, once attuned to the wearer's body at full health.

armour.name: fire dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a fire-breathing dragon. It provides great protection from fire, while rendering its wearer more susceptible to cold.

armour.name: ice dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a cold-breathing dragon. It provides great protection from cold, while rendering its wearer more susceptible to fire.

armour.name: steam dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a steam-breathing dragon. Unlike the scales of some larger dragons, it does not provide its wearer with much protection (beyond a resistance to scalding steam), but it is extremely light and supple.

armour.name: acid dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of an acid dragon. Although it does not provide its wearer with as much protection as the armour made from the scales of some larger dragons, it is somewhat lighter and less encumbering. It is also remarkably smooth, letting corrosive slime flow off it like water.

armour.name: storm dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a lightning-breathing dragon. It is heavier than most dragon scale armours, and gives its wearer resistance to electrical discharges.

armour.name: golden dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a golden dragon. It is much heavier than most dragon scale armours, and grants its wearer resistance to poison, fire and cold.

armour.name: swamp dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a swamp dragon. It confers resistance to poison on its wearer.

armour.name: pearl dragon scales
armour.description: The nacreous scales of a pearl dragon. It grants its wearer resistance to negative energies.

armour.name: barding
armour.description: Armour for the scaly midsections of nagas and centaurs.

armour.name: shadow dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a great umbral dragon. It is heavier than most dragon scale armours, but its encumbrance does not penalise the wearer's stealth. It also grants additional stealth to the wearer.

armour.name: quicksilver dragon scales
armour.description: The scales of a quicksilver dragon. Although it does not provide its wearer with as much protection as the scales of some heavier dragons, it is somewhat lighter and less encumbering. The armour repels both attacks on the wearer's willpower and magical modification of itself - it cannot be enchanted.

armour.name: scarf
armour.description: A length of stylish fabric. At its creation, enchantments were woven into it, and as such it cannot accept further enchantment.

armour.name: orb
armour.description: A sphere of crystal, carried in place of a shield. Magic scintillates within its interior.

missiles.name: dart
missiles.description: A thin piece of metal, typically coated in some harmful substance. When thrown it can deliver its toxins into the bloodstream of a living or demonic being.

missiles.name: javelin
missiles.description: A lightweight penetrating spear, designed for throwing. It will pass through the targets it hits, potentially hitting all targets in its path until it reaches maximum range. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

missiles.name: stone
missiles.description: A small chunk of dense but otherwise unremarkable natural mineral. It can be thrown to cause minor damage.

missiles.name: large rock
missiles.description: A very large and very heavy stone. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

missiles.name: throwing net
missiles.description: A mesh of ropes knotted together with weights around the edge, used to entangle and entrap targets. Struggling victims can eventually destroy the net and break free, if they live long enough.

missiles.name: boomerang
missiles.description: A curved, flat, throwing baton designed to return to its user.

wands.name: wand of flame
wands.description: A magical device which throws little puffs of flame.

wands.name: wand of paralysis
wands.description: A magical device which can render a creature immobile, incapable of moving any of its limbs.

wands.name: wand of digging
wands.description: A magical device which drills tunnels through unworked rock.

wands.name: wand of iceblast
wands.description: A magical device which creates a loud explosion of ice shards, bypassing half of victims' resistance to cold.

wands.name: wand of polymorph
wands.description: A magical device which causes a creature to be transmogrified into another form. It is especially effective against shape-changing creatures.

wands.name: wand of charming
wands.description: A magical device which causes a creature to become fiercely, but briefly, loyal to the user.

wands.name: wand of acid
wands.description: A magical device which throws bolts of corrosive acid.

wands.name: wand of mindburst
wands.description: A magical device which launches a psychic attack on a target creature. If it overcomes their willpower, it 'blows their mind' in a violently literal fashion, dealing damage that bypasses their armour entirely. It is useless against mindless creatures.

wands.name: wand of light
wands.description: A magical device which fires a ray of searing light, injuring and blinding those struck. Only living, undead, demonic and angelic monsters can be blinded, and tougher monsters will recover their vision more quickly.

wands.name: wand of quicksilver
wands.description: A magical device which fires a beam of destructive energy, dispelling enchantments on creatures struck.

wands.name: wand of roots
wands.description: A magical device which fires a magical seed, entangling its target and adjacent foes in quick-growing tree roots. Those entangled will be immobilised and take damage over time until they escape or the roots wither away. The roots will only sprout from solid ground.

wands.name: wand of warping
wands.description: A magical device which creates a brief but violent rift in space, damaging everything caught in its wake and sometimes blinking them a short distance away.

staves.name: staff of fire
staves.description: A staff that increases the power of fire spells cast by its wielder, and protects them from the effects of fire. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and Fire Magic, they can burn those struck by it.

staves.name: staff of cold
staves.description: A staff that increases the power of ice spells cast by its wielder, and protects them from the effects of cold. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and Ice Magic, they can freeze those struck by it.

staves.name: staff of alchemy
staves.description: A staff that increases the power of alchemy spells cast by its wielder, and protects them from the effects of poison. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and Alchemy, they can envenom those struck by it.

staves.name: staff of necromancy
staves.description: A staff that increases the power of necromantic spells cast by its wielder, and protects them from negative energy. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and Necromancy, they can inflict great pain on those living souls they strike, dealing negative energy damage which bypasses armour.

staves.name: staff of conjuration
staves.description: A staff that increases the power of conjurations cast by its wielder. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and Conjurations, they can blast those they strike with pure energy.

staves.name: staff of air
staves.description: A staff that increases the power of air spells cast by its wielder, and insulates them from electricity. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and Air Magic, they can shock those struck by it, dealing electrical damage which bypasses half of defenders' armour.

staves.name: staff of earth
staves.description: A staff that increases the power of earth spells cast by its wielder. If the wielder is skilled in Evocations and Earth magic, they can fracture the ground beneath those struck by it, dealing substantial damage - though much less to creatures which fly.

potions.name: potion of curing
potions.description: A potion which restores a small amount of health, and cures poison and confusion.

potions.name: potion of heal wounds
potions.description: A magical healing elixir which causes wounds to close and heal almost instantly.

potions.name: potion of haste
potions.description: An enchanted beverage which speeds the actions of anyone who drinks it.

potions.name: potion of might
potions.description: A potion which greatly increases the power of the drinker's melee attacks.

potions.name: potion of brilliance
potions.description: A potion which increases the power of the drinker's spells and halves their magic cost (rounding up).

potions.name: potion of attraction
potions.description: A potion which makes the drinker attract enemies, translocating them quickly closer for the duration of the effect. The effect is surprisingly subtle, and unwary victims may sleep through it entirely.

potions.name: potion of enlightenment
potions.description: A potion which uplifts both the body and mind of its drinkers, lifting them from the ground and increasing their Will to resist the world's temptations.

potions.name: potion of poison
potions.description: A nasty, poisonous liquid. It can be evaporated to create clouds of poison gas.

potions.name: potion of slowing
potions.description: A potion which slows the actions of anyone who drinks it. It can be evaporated to create clouds of noxious fumes.

potions.name: potion of cancellation
potions.description: A potion which ends most magical effects, good or bad, affecting one who drinks it. It also reduces magical contamination.

potions.name: potion of ambrosia
potions.description: A strange substance, produced by ghost moths. Consuming it causes regeneration of health and magic, along with total befuddlement. The two effects are fundamentally linked – the regeneration ends the moment the confusion does.

potions.name: potion of invisibility
potions.description:
A potion which confers invisibility on one who consumes it.
