While invisible, most monsters have greatly reduced accuracy against you, cannot make attacks of opportunity, and the spells they cast may sometimes be aimed at the wrong location. They may also stumble around and eventually lose track of you, especially if their intelligence is low.

In addition, melee attacks you make against such creatures have a chance (proportional to your stealth and weapon skill) of catching them off-guard and dealing increased damage, especially if performed with a short blade.

Certain creatures can see through this invisibility and it will always be completely ineffective while standing in water.

potions.name: potion of moonshine
potions.description: A potent alcohol, distilled in some dubious corner of the dungeon. Drinking it reduces the imbiber's accuracy, evasion, and spellcasting success for a while.

potions.name: potion of decay
potions.description: A fetid, putrid liquid which causes the drinker's flesh to rot away and drains their life force. It can be evaporated to create clouds of miasma.

potions.name: potion of water
potions.description: A flask of ordinary water. Though unremarkable to drink, it can be evaporated to create clouds of steam.

potions.name: potion of experience
potions.description: A truly wonderful and very rare drink, which grants experience when consumed.

potions.name: potion of magic
potions.description: A valuable potion which grants an infusion of magical energy.

potions.name: potion of strong poison
potions.description: A terribly venomous liquid. It can be evaporated to create clouds of poison gas and noxious fumes.

potions.name: potion of berserk rage
potions.description: A potion which can send one into an incoherent rage, granting them a great but temporary increase to their health, damage, and speed. In exchange, their mind is clouded by anger, only allowing them to move and attack in melee. The rage will wear off quickly if they do not attack monsters, and upon expiry, the imbiber will be fatigued, causing them to slow dramatically and rendering them unable to berserk again for a short duration.

potions.name: potion of mutation
potions.description: A potion which mutates the drinker, removing several mutations then granting a few random mutations, which are likely (but not guaranteed) to be beneficial.

potions.name: potion of resistance
potions.description: A potion which grants temporary resistance to a variety of harmful effects: fire, cold, electricity, poison, and acid.

potions.name: potion of lignification
potions.description:
A potion which transforms the imbiber into an animated banyan tree, with sap for blood and branches capable of holding weapons. Such a tree has minimal evasion but increased health and natural armour, and is resistant to poison, and immune to negative energy, torment, sleep, blinding, and does not need to breathe.

However, it is rooted in place while the transformation lasts, and cannot teleport.

potions.name: potion of mist
potions.description:
A vial of mist which temporarily turns the imbiber's body insubstantial, protecting them from constriction, petrification, barbs, sticky flame, webs, nets, and being caught by bolas.

It will also end most of those effects if they are already afflicted.

potions.name: potion of empathy
potions.description: A warm, rose-tinted draught that weaves a vital tether between the drinker and every living companion on the floor. While bonded, half of any healing received by one bonded party member overflows to the others, and forty percent of heavy blows are dispersed across healthy bonded allies.

potions.name: potion of soul ambrosia
potions.description: A luminous golden nectar distilled for fellowship. Drinking it suffuses the drinker and every living companion in sight with rapid health and magic regeneration without inducing confusion. If any party member is haunting the floor as a downed ghost, the draught's excess life-force immediately restores them to flesh and blood.

potions.name: potion of concord
potions.description: A harmonic elixir that resonates with the presence of comrades-in-arms. It grants the drinker and all visible companions a chorus of martial and arcane harmony, boosting slaying, evasion, and spellcasting power in proportion to the number of living allies within sight.

potions.name: potion of transfusion
potions.description: A volatile crimson-and-azure draught that equalizes the vital and magical reserves of the entire party on the current floor, raising everyone to at least the party's average health and magic percentages before surging with a protective ward and fresh vitality.

scrolls.name: scroll of identify
scrolls.description: A useful magic scroll which identifies the properties of any unknown object.

scrolls.name: scroll of teleportation
scrolls.description: A scroll that translocates the reader to a random position after a short delay. Reading this scroll while waiting for a teleportation will instead cancel it.

scrolls.name: scroll of fear
scrolls.description:
A scroll that causes great fear in nearby foes, causing them to flee until attacked, cornered, or enough time has passed.

Non-living, undead and plant monsters cannot be feared, and berserk or frenzied monsters are also immune.

scrolls.name: scroll of noise
scrolls.description: A prank scroll that creates a loud noise when read.

scrolls.name: scroll of summoning
scrolls.description: A scroll that calls forth several allied creatures woven from shadow into the shapes of those beings found within the reader's immediate vicinity.

scrolls.name: scroll of enchant weapon
scrolls.description: A scroll that places an enchantment on a weapon chosen by the reader, increasing both accuracy and damage. Weapons can be enchanted up to +9. Magical artefacts cannot be enchanted at all.

scrolls.name: scroll of enchant armour
scrolls.description: A scroll that places an enchantment on a piece of armour chosen by the reader. Body armour and bardings can be enchanted up to the same value as their base armour rating. Bucklers, kite shields and tower shields can be enchanted up to +3, +5 or +8 respectively, and other armour can be enchanted up to +2. Magical artefacts cannot be enchanted at all.

scrolls.name: scroll of torment
scrolls.description: A scroll that calls on the powers of darkness to inflict great pain on any nearby creature — including the reader! This halves the resilience of all living creatures and cuts down all holy creature resilence by about a third, although it is never directly fatal.

scrolls.name: scroll of immolation
scrolls.description: A scroll that fills the creatures around the reader with an unstable and powerful inner flame. This fire is released any time the victims are hit, and explosively released upon their death. Giant creatures cause bigger explosions.

scrolls.name: scroll of blinking
scrolls.description: A scroll that allows its reader to teleport a short distance, with precise control.

scrolls.name: scroll of revelation
scrolls.description: A scroll that reveals its reader's surroundings. The layout of the current floor is fully mapped, and everything within a moderate radius, including both visible and invisible monsters, is momentarily shown.

scrolls.name: scroll of fog
scrolls.description: A scroll that surrounds the reader with a dense cloud of fog, which can block vision temporarily. The fog takes a short time to fully spill out.

scrolls.name: scroll of acquirement
scrolls.description: A wonderful scroll which causes the creation of a valuable item, with the reader choosing from a small selection. The items offered will often be a good match for the reader's skills; and if nothing recommends itself, the reader can always choose a heap of gold.

scrolls.name: scroll of brand weapon
scrolls.description:
A scroll that imbues a weapon with a random brand. Any existing brand will be replaced with a different one, and any brand forbidden by your current god will not be chosen. Artefacts cannot be branded in this way.

Melee weapons will commonly be branded with the flaming, freezing, heavy, venom or protection brand (or with the special brand exclusive to the category of weapon being branded), and rarely with the draining, electrocution, spectral, vampiric or chaos brand.

Ranged weapons will commonly be branded with the flaming, freezing, heavy or draining brand, and rarely with the electrocution or chaos brand.

scrolls.name: scroll of vulnerability
scrolls.description: A scroll that briefly halves the willpower of the reader and any nearby beings, rendering them vulnerable to many magical effects. The scroll cannot affect those fully immune to such effects.

scrolls.name: scroll of silence
scrolls.description:
A scroll that eliminates all sound near the reader. This makes reading scrolls, casting spells, invoking divine abilities, or shouting impossible in the reader's vicinity.

Certain monsters have innate magical or special abilities which will still be usable while silenced.

The effect starts out with a large radius, which will then shrink, eventually covering only the reader, before it times out.

scrolls.name: scroll of amnesia
scrolls.description: A scroll that allows its reader to selectively erase one spell from memory to recapture the magical energy bound up with it.

scrolls.name: scroll of poison
scrolls.description: A scroll that fills the air with poison, covering every unoccupied space in sight with toxic fumes.

scrolls.name: scroll of butterflies
scrolls.description: A scroll that surrounds its user with a flight of beautiful butterflies, blowing back other creatures nearby with the flapping of their wings.

scrolls.name: scroll of soul recall
scrolls.description: An ancient parchment inscribed with threads of astral gold. Reading it weaves a lifeline across the threshold of death, immediately resurrecting any downed party ghosts at half health and magic without draining the survivors' vitality. If all companions are already alive, it instead recalls separated allies to the reader's side and envelops the party in a brief sanctuary ward.

scrolls.name: scroll of rallying
scrolls.description: A martial proclamation that rings like a clarion horn when read aloud. All living companions on the floor are freed from constriction, fear, sleep, and mesmerisation, pulled into formation around the reader, and bolstered with temporary might, elemental resistance, and missile deflection.

scrolls.name: scroll of phase swap
scrolls.description: A translocation scroll tuned to sympathetic resonance between allies. Reading it folds space to swap the reader's position with a targeted or most endangered companion on the floor, breaking constriction on both and granting each a brief surge of swiftness and a protective phase shield.

scrolls.name: scroll of shared vigour
scrolls.description: A scroll of vital and arcane communion. Reading it elevates every living party member on the floor to match the highest health and magic percentages in the party, cleanses debilitating ailments, restores drained attributes, and grants sustained regeneration and divine vigour.

jewellery.name: +0 ring of protection
jewellery.description: A ring that protects its wearer from most sources of damage.

jewellery.name: ring of protection from fire
jewellery.description: A ring that protects its wearer from fire.

jewellery.name: ring of poison resistance
jewellery.description: A ring that protects its wearer from poison.

jewellery.name: ring of protection from cold
jewellery.description: A ring that protects its wearer from cold.

jewellery.name: +0 ring of strength
jewellery.description: A ring that increases the strength of its wearer.

jewellery.name: +0 ring of slaying
jewellery.description: A ring that increases the wearer's accuracy and damage with ranged weapons and melee attacks.

jewellery.name: ring of see invisible
jewellery.description: A ring that allows its wearer to see invisible things.

jewellery.name: ring of resist corrosion
jewellery.description: A ring that protects its wearer from the effects of acid and corrosion.

jewellery.name: +0 ring of evasion
jewellery.description: A ring that makes its wearer more capable of avoiding attacks.

jewellery.name: +0 ring of dexterity
jewellery.description: A ring that increases the dexterity of its wearer.

jewellery.name: +0 ring of intelligence
jewellery.description: A ring that increases the intelligence of its wearer.

jewellery.name: ring of wizardry
jewellery.description: A ring that increases the success rate of its wearer's magical spells.

jewellery.name: ring of magical power
jewellery.description: A ring that increases its wearer's reserves of magical power for so long as it is worn.

jewellery.name: ring of flight
jewellery.description: A ring that grants its wearer flight.

jewellery.name: ring of positive energy
jewellery.description: A ring that protects its wearer from the effects of negative energy.

jewellery.name: ring of willpower
jewellery.description: A ring that increases its wearer's willpower, protecting against certain magical effects.

jewellery.name: ring of camaraderie
jewellery.description: A braided band of silver and electrum that rewards fighting side-by-side. It grants the wearer bonus evasion and slaying for each living companion within three paces, and further empowers melee and ranged strikes against foes that are flanked by an ally.

jewellery.name: amulet of the acrobat
jewellery.description: An amulet that allows the user to tumble and roll to evade the blows of their enemies, but only while moving and waiting. While taking other actions (including climbing stairs) the amulet conveys no benefits.

jewellery.name: amulet of magic regeneration
jewellery.description: An amulet that increases the wearer's rate of magic regeneration. In order to function, it must first attune itself to the wearer's body with full reserves of magic.

jewellery.name: amulet of guardian spirit
jewellery.description: An amulet containing a protective spirit which will cause any damage taken to be divided between the wearer's reserves of health and magic.

jewellery.name: amulet of faith
jewellery.description: A charm crafted to call the attention of the gods to its wearer. This divine attention makes it easier to please your god, but your god will also take more notice of your transgressions. The amulet will drain some of your divine favour when removed.

jewellery.name: amulet of reflection
jewellery.description: An amulet which improves its wearer's ability to shield against attacks. If no shield is worn, the force the amulet emits can serve as a weak shield on its own. Regardless, any ranged attacks the wearer blocks will be reflected back toward the attacker.

jewellery.name: amulet of regeneration
jewellery.description: An amulet that increases the wearer's rate of health regeneration. In order to function, it must first attune itself to the wearer's body at full health.

jewellery.name: amulet of wildshape
jewellery.description: An amulet which improves its wearer's skill with Shapeshifting.

jewellery.name: amulet of chemistry
jewellery.description: An amulet which allows the wearer to extract small amounts of magical energy from any potion they drink and also enhances the power of their alchemy spells. The magic restoration effect requires the amulet to attune itself to the wearer's body while their reserves of magic are full.

jewellery.name: amulet of dissipation
jewellery.description: An amulet which causes magic contamination and negative status effects upon the wearer to expire twice as quickly with time.

jewellery.name: amulet of the vanguard
jewellery.description: A heavy gorget-amulet of star-forged iron. While worn in a co-op party, it draws thirty percent of the damage suffered by nearby companions onto the wearer, where it is mitigated by the wearer's own armour class before taking effect.

misc.name: horn of Geryon
misc.description: The horn belonging to Geryon, guardian of the Vestibule of Hell. It has the power to call forth demonic beasts. With high Evocations skill, it will call greater numbers of beasts, with lower chances of those beasts being hostile.

misc.name: box of beasts
misc.description:
A box filled with the bizarre leftovers of a depraved wizard's magical experimentations. Opening it might set loose a friendly mutant beast: bizarre creatures, each with their own combination of traits. Increased skill with Evocations will allow stronger beasts to be released.

There are six known traits:
 * Bat beasts fly and move very quickly, but erratically.
 * Fire beasts resist and breathe fire.
 * Ox beasts resist cold, are armoured with thick fur, and can knock back foes.
 * Shock beasts resist electricity and can transform into living lightning.
 * Sting beasts resist poison and have a reaching poison-tail attack.
 * Weird beasts can see invisible and attack with constricting tentacles.

As far as anyone knows, all beasts have exactly two of these traits.

misc.name: lightning rod (4/4)
misc.description: A rod that allows its wielder to fire unavoidable blasts of lightning. Consecutive evocations cause the discharge to be sustained, which increases the power level up to four times and allows the blast to be redirected to affect an area. The strength of the blast increases with Evocations skill and, for redirected blasts, decreases with the size of the affected area.

misc.name: quad damage
misc.description: A mysterious item resembling a rune of some kind. Once evoked, it will make the user glow blue and add a reverb to all sound... and there may be other effects as well.

misc.name: phial of floods
misc.description: An enchanted vessel of elemental water. Removing the stopper unleashes a torrent of water, smashing the target and flooding the nearby area. If any creatures engulfed by the wave need air to breathe, they'll be unable to cast spells until they recover. The strength of the torrent and the duration of the flooding increase with Evocations skill.

misc.name: sack of spiders
misc.description: A woven silk bag. Opening it will cover the area with webs, spiders, and other skittering things. Evocations skill increases spider quality, quantity and webbing.

misc.name: figurine of a ziggurat
misc.description: A small figurine made of some strange material, shaped like a stepped pyramid. It is remarkably detailed – almost like a real, vast structure, shrunk somehow smaller than a human hand.

misc.name: phantom mirror
misc.description: A hand mirror which can create a reflection of a nearby creature, clouding in the process. The reflection's duration increases with Evocations skill and decreases with the willpower of the target. It is, invariably, slightly weaker than the creature it mirrors.

misc.name: tin of tremorstones (2/2)
misc.description: A set of dormant, magnetic earth elementals in the form of tiny, very heavy pebbles. When released, the elementals are drawn magnetically to the center of nearby monsters, where they literally explode with rage at their rest being disturbed. Tremorstones usually land slightly off-target, and the user is always at risk of being hit. However, armour is extremely effective at repelling the lightweight fragments of rock from a tremorstone's explosion, so a well-armoured wielder has little to fear. Evocations skill increases the number of explosions.

misc.name: condenser vane
misc.description: A magical device that condenses ambient energy into various destructive clouds. When evoked these clouds form around hostile monsters near the user. The quantity and lethality of these clouds increases with Evocations skill. At low power it will create noxious fumes, and as power increases this gives way to roaring flames, freezing vapours, and poisonous gas. At the highest tiers of power storm clouds, acidic fog and clouds of excruciating misery become available.

misc.name: Gell's gravitambourine (2/2)
misc.description:
A copper and tungsten tambourine that vibrates excitedly in your hands, as if eager to be used.

Just as music brings people together, shaking it with the proper rhythm will draw a large group of monsters into a narrow space and hold any hostile ones in place for a short time with inescapable waves of crushing gravity.

The area of effect and duration increases with Evocations skill.

misc.name: shop voucher
misc.description: A coupon good for one item of any price from any store in the dungeon, to be used automatically when you would make a purchase that exceeds your funds. How generous! No refunds. One coupon per purchase per customer. Offer limited by availability. Void if defaced or otherwise altered. Valid only within the dungeon of Zot and its subsidiary branches. Additional purchase not required.

misc.name: aegis standard
misc.description: A battle-scarred iron banner etched with interlocking runes of fellowship. Evoking it plants a radiant standard of valour that rallies the party, granting all living companions in sight heroism, bonus shield protection, and willpower while redirecting a portion of the damage they suffer to the standard-bearer. Recharges with experience.

misc.name: astral beacon
misc.description: A crystal lantern housing a tether of starlight. Evoking it bathes the party in astral radiance, restoring health and magic to all visible companions and calling any downed party ghosts back across the threshold of death. Recharges with experience.

misc.name: twin-spark conduit (2/2)
misc.description: A two-pronged copper resonator that hums in the presence of allies. Evoking it arcs a high-voltage chain of lightning between the evoker and every living companion in sight, electrocuting and dazzling hostile creatures caught along the ley-lines or adjacent to the party. Recharges with experience.

misc.name: horn of the Vanguard
misc.description: A curved war-horn of rune-etched brass and mammoth ivory. Sounding it unleashes a concussive shockwave that batters and dazes adjacent foes while inspiring the evoker and all companions in sight with cleaving strikes and swiftness. Recharges with experience.

talismans.name: quill talisman
talismans.description: A spiny trinket reminiscent of a cactus. Causes sharp quills to grow all over the wearer's body which may cause injury to anyone unwise enough to attack them in melee.

talismans.name: maw talisman
talismans.description: A miniature, desiccated head of some ferocious and hopefully extinct creature. Transforms the wearer's midsection into a giant mouth, gnashing and ready to devour foes. This maw confers a powerful bite attack which scales additionally with the wearer's own strength and can devour slain creatures to temporariy increase one's regeneration. Unfortunately, it also confers such profound hunger that it can be difficult to pull oneself away from particularly appetising foes.

talismans.name: serpent talisman
talismans.description: A jade snake coiled around a fossilised egg. Transforms the wearer into an amphisbaena - a legendary two-headed serpent. It is capable of wearing two pieces of headgear at once and its powerful coils can wind around foes and crush them to death, but its cold blood leaves it susceptible to being slowed by cold attacks.

talismans.name: blade talisman
talismans.description: A jagged cluster of blades, almost impossible to grasp without injury. Causes long, needle-thin blades to grow from the wearer's body, allowing them to perform rapid auxiliary melee attacks and even parry blows. Having so many fragments of metal inside one's body reduces the effectiveness of body armour, but Shapeshifting skill mitigates this effect as well as increases the damage dealt.

talismans.name: granite talisman
talismans.description: A heavy stone icon, bearing the countenance of some long-forgotten king or god. Transforms the wearer into a slow, stone statue. The wearer's stone body is immune to poison and miasma, and gains resistance to electricity, negative energy, and torment. Shapeshifting skill increases armour granted.

talismans.name: dragon-coil talisman
talismans.description: An intricate carving, inlaid with dragon tooth and scale. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:4: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

talismans.name: talisman of death
talismans.description:
A grey-black vessel, infused with dark power through a sickening ritual. Transforms the wearer into an undying offence against life itself.

Foes struck by wearer's melee weapons or hands are weakened, slowed, and drained. The wearer can also heal themself by tormenting living foes nearby; Shapeshifting skill increases the amount healed. Further, the wearer resists cold, has enhanced willpower, and is immune to poison, miasma, negative energy, and torment.

The wearer also gains some of the more dubious benefits of having an undead body. They are vulnerable to holy damage and Dispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.

talismans.name: storm talisman
talismans.description: Lightning trapped, impossibly, in a bottle. Lets the wearer walk through the air as a raging, lightning-filled tempest. The wearer's melee attacks are electrified and strike all adjacent foes. The wearer also flies, gains immunity to poison, miasma, petrification, constriction, and sticky flame, and also resists electricity. They can launch themselves as a lightning bolt, blasting through everything in their way.

talismans.name: protean talisman
talismans.description:
An ever-changing fragment of something primordial; its substance seems to undulate between flesh and bone and perhaps even metal. A sufficiently skilled shapeshifter can stabilise it into a useable - if unpredictable - form.

(If your Shapeshifting skill is at least 6, attempting to put this on will transform it into a random one of: Rimehorn, Scarab, Medusa, or Spore talismans.)

talismans.name: sanguine talisman
talismans.description: A vial of roiling blood that pulses with the beat of an unseen heart. Transforms the wearer into a fearsome vampire - a creature that straddles the border between life and undeath. They can drink the lifeblood of the living to heal themselves, and even turn those they slay stealthily into vampiric thralls, but do not heal in the presence of monsters. Their hypnotic gaze often prevents monsters from shouting when alerted and may even daze them. At great effort, they can also scatter into a swarm of bats - either to flee or to assail their enemies.

talismans.name: rimehorn talisman
talismans.description: A crude ornament carved from the horn of a rare arctic beast - so cold to the touch that ice still clings to it. Transforms the wearer into a rime yak, a hardy ungulate that is highly resistant to cold and whose breath is so frigid that it freezes the walls around itself as it fights. Being so attuned to arctic temperatures also makes it easier for the wearer to cast Ice magic.

talismans.name: spider talisman
talismans.description: A strange charm made from shed arachnid exoskeletons bound together with silk. Transforms the wearer into an agile jumping spider who can move swiftly towards foes and inflict grievous damage on any it catches unaware. It cannot be ensnared by webs, but its attacks can ensnare its enemies in them. It can also leap briskly away from many dangers.

talismans.name: hive talisman
talismans.description: A preserved and decorated hive, still dripping with ambrosial nectar. Transforms the wearer into a living beehive, filled with the buzz of countless insects labouring inside them. The nectar produced within greatly increases the wearer's health and magic regeneration and if they become seriously injured, angry bees will swarm out to defend their hive.

talismans.name: wellspring talisman
talismans.description:
A small amphora from which pours a seemingly unending quantity of water. Transforms the wearer's flesh into elemental water, allowing them to move flexibly and reach to attack from a great distance, though without the precision needed to stab from range. From time to time, they can even cause the water around them to rise up and drown their enemies.

The malleability of this water preserves most other aspects of the wearer's physiology such as their blood and bones, and even allows them to retain the benefits of their physical mutations, but cold attacks can freeze it solid and fire may cause it to erupt with steam.

talismans.name: riddle talisman
talismans.description:
An intricate puzzlebox containing an unknowable prize. Transforms the wearer into a riddle-loving sphinx. In this form, they are {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}, and their melee attacks cause powerful winds to strike their foe which do increased damage for every open space next to them. They are also masterful enchanters, casting Hex spells much more easily and ignoring a portion of their foe's Willpower.

Alas, their love of riddles is so compulsive that even the most hardened adventurer will be unable to resist posing them to new foes they encounter, no matter how unwise this may be.

talismans.name: lupine talisman
talismans.description: A painted eyepatch made from a scrap of wolf pelt. Transforms the wearer into a vicious werewolf, muscles surging with predatory instinct. Killing enemies with melee attacks in this form will give a stacking bonus to your damage and accuracy, and slaying enough of them in a row will cause you to unleash a vicious howl that makes any still alive cower in fear - and leaves them susceptible to a devastating leaping takedown.

talismans.name: inkwell talisman
talismans.description:
A small bottle filled with mystical ink. Transforms the wearer into a walking scroll whose body is tattooed with the knowledge of a hundred mages. Being an omnibus of magical techniques gives them increased skill with all spell schools, which improves with Shapeshifting skill, but the form's ability to channel such magic is limited, and it cannot cast spells above level 4.

Its attacks are also very weak, but have a chance of restoring 1 MP when they hit.

talismans.name: fortress talisman
talismans.description: A miniature battlement, carved from a piece of shell. Transforms the wearer into a heavily armoured crab, fusing whatever body armour they are wearing into the shell and magnifying most of its benefits. In this form, they are slow-moving, but well-defended and even capable of wielding a two-handed weapon in their large main claw. Despite all this bulk, they are well-adapted to the water. They can also breathe clouds of rust at the cost of their own HP, which corrode and weaken enemies.

talismans.name: scarab talisman
talismans.description:
A small golden cameo of a beetle. Transforms the wearer into a sun scarab, a fiery insect that carries around a mote of searing heat and light outside itself, like a tiny sun.

This solar ember burns adjacent enemies whenever the scarab attacks, and can be healed by swapping with it. In addition, the scarab's own mandibles can reduce enemies' fire resistance and Fire spells are easier for the wearer to cast.

talismans.name: medusa talisman
talismans.description: A fossilised jellyfish polyp, inscribed with sigils. Causes a mane of long stinging tendrils to sprout from the wearer's head which lash out at nearby enemies whenever the wearer attacks, poisoning them. When they feel their host's life is in danger, they can even turn these poisoned foes to stone.

talismans.name: eel talisman
talismans.description: A strange sea fossil, adorned with abalone and pearl. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}} to transform into a pair of wriggling electric eels that sometimes discharge arcs of electricity through connected targets when used to strike enemies. When the wearer's health becomes dangerously low, they will discharge an even more violent voltage.

talismans.name: spore talisman
talismans.description: A small charm made from a still-living mushroom. Transforms one of the wearer's arms and parts of their lower body into a vibrant mass of multicoloured fungus. Melee attacks in this form may release spores that weaken their target, as well as cause mushrooms to sprout on the ground behind them which will release their own bursts of dazing spores if allowed to grow. Shapeshifting skill increases the durability of these mushrooms as well as their damage.

talismans.name: vision talisman
talismans.description:
A small charm bearing the likeness of an eye. It gives the wearer supernatural sight, allowing them to perceive the clouds of magical residue left behind whenever beings cast spells. Touching those clouds allows them to convert that leftover magic into unnerring projectiles against nearby foes.

This third eye even allows one to see from further distances than would otherwise be possible{{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

talismans.name: jade talisman
talismans.description:
A small statuette carved out of multi-hued jade which thrums with quiet power. Causes a great mantle of elementally-attuned crystal to grow out of the wearer's head and upper body, increasing their proficiency with fire, ice, earth, and air magic, but impairing all other schools.

Each time the wearer casts a spell from one of those four schools, it will empower the corresponding crystal and unleash a burst of damaging magic. If all four crystals become charged at once, the wearer's resistances and fortitude will be temporarily enhanced.

talismans.name: gecko talisman
talismans.description: The dried remains of a tail shed under duress. Partially transforms the user into a hypnogecko, a reptile with a remarkable degree of metachrosis. Their skin naturally changes colour to blend in with their surroundings, making them stealthy, and when badly injured, they reflexively shed their own tail and make it scintillate with bright colours as a decoy - allowing them to either flee or even strike at their distracted predators from a blind spot.

talismans.name: mist talisman
talismans.description:
A small censer from which pours an endless smoky haze. Transforms the wearer's head into a billowing shroud of mist. Any potions they drink in this form will be rapidly decomposed into gases which they can expel via melee attacks as blasts of harmful clouds. They can also slowly condense the dungeon's air into potions of mist, allowing them to become intangible and blind monsters.

However, the lack of typical mouth parts makes it difficult to pronounce incantations, greatly slowing the speed at which they cast spells.

books.name: book of Minor Magic
books.description: A spellbook containing a variety of simple but useful magical incantations. Many prominent spellcasters used this book to begin their arcane studies.

books.name: book of Conjurations
books.description: A book containing an introduction to the destructive magical arts of Conjurations.

books.name: book of Flames
books.description: The standard text used in arcane academies by students of the elemental magic of Fire. Readers are recommended to wear a pair of insulated gloves.

books.name: book of Frost
books.description: A book of magic spells, often used as an introduction to the elemental magics of Ice. Its pages feel unusually brittle, as if they'd crumble at a touch.

books.name: book of the Wilderness
books.description: A book holding lore ripped from distant and untamed lands, allowing their denizens to be called forth to serve the reader. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

books.name: book of Fire
books.description: A book containing advanced spells in the elemental school of Fire, stolen from the secret college of the djinn.

books.name: book of Ice
books.description: A book of advanced magical spells using the element of Ice. Readers are recommended to wear a pair of warm gloves.

books.name: book of Spatial Translocations
books.description: A basic spellbook on the magical field of Translocations. Many would-be mages have seen it disappear just as they needed it most.

books.name: book of Hexes
books.description: A spellbook containing an assortment of powerful Hexes, which sparkles and shimmers as the pages are flipped.

books.name: Young Poisoner's Handbook
books.description: An introductory book for the magic arts of poison. Readers are recommended to wear a pair of very thick, non-absorbent gloves.

books.name: book of Lightning
books.description: A book that fairly crackles with arcane power.

books.name: book of Death
books.description: A manuscript containing dark spells of Necromancy. Each page is filled with grotesque art depicting scenes of disgusting decay.

books.name: book of Misfortune
books.description: A spellbook dedicated to the art of inflicting creative calamities on one's foes. Superstitious wizards claim that the book itself actually absorbs ill fortune and carry it around as a good-luck charm, but the effects of this seem subtle at best.

books.name: book of Spontaneous Combustion
books.description: A heavy tome written with wildly flammable ink. Care must be taken even opening it, but the power of the spells described therein is undeniable. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

books.name: Fen Folio
books.description: A collection of spells once used by the great swamp civilisations.

books.name: My Sojourns in Swampland
books.description: While purporting itself to be the personal account of a famous naturalist, it becomes clear upon reading that this book was compiled from multiple unrelated sources, including notes from a stagehand of a travelling magical circus. The travelogue may be fictitious, but some of the spell diagrams carefully transcribed in the margins seem quite real.

books.name: book of Necromancy
books.description: A macabre book containing basic Necromancy spells. Readers are recommended to wear a pair of gloves they don't mind disposing of afterward.

books.name: book of Callings
books.description: An introductory text on the magical summoning of beasts and beings from other realms.

books.name: book of Air
books.description: A primer on the elemental magics of Air. The great minotaur hero Vuxhurn, given a copy of this book while trapped atop the tower of a wizard with a particularly perverse sense of humour, used its pages to construct a rudimentary glider and soared to freedom.

books.name: book of the Warp
books.description: A book of advanced Translocations spells, written by a particularly misanthropic mage. After its completion, they were never seen again, which may or may not have been the point.

books.name: book of Unlife
books.description: An unholy book describing a variety of magical methods for the creation and command of undead servants.

books.name: book of Battle
books.description: An astonishingly vain and self-aggrandising work. The author claims credit for a wide swathe of weapon-augmenting magics, but seems to have misunderstood or misrepresented most of them. Only a few of the spells described in the book actually work.

books.name: book of Geomancy
books.description: A book containing basic spells involving the element of Earth. Readers are recommended to wear a pair of gardening gloves.

books.name: book of Power
books.description: A book of powerful and destructive magic spells, rumbling and shuddering with barely-contained energies.

books.name: book of Cantrips
books.description: A book containing a small selection of very basic magic spells, intended for beginners who wish to learn the rudiments of one of the featured magical schools.

books.name: book of Party Tricks
books.description: A book containing a variety of fun spells guaranteed to liven up any wizarding party, as well as a number of toasts, jokes, and party games.

books.name: book of Debilitation
books.description: A spellbook containing spells known for having a particularly unpleasant effect on their victims. It's considered something of a faux pas in the wizarding community to be seen with this book in one's collection.

books.name: book of the Dragon
books.description: A magical book of spells which allow some command over dragons and their aspects.

books.name: book of Burglary
books.description: A book containing spells useful for theft, breaking and entering, and other miscellaneous larceny.

books.name: book of Dreams
books.description: The somniloquent utterings of a famed mystic, using uniquely bizarre imagery and cryptic digressions to describe spells drawn from the mystic's visions.

books.name: book of Transmutation
books.description: A meticulous compendium of research notes, filled with formulae for decomposing and reconstituting all manner of substances. It was written by one of the legendary alchemists among the sludge elves, before that species mysteriously vanished from the world. The author appears to have had a strange obsession with becoming a butterfly, but even if their ultimate aim eluded them, many of the spells detailed therein are nonetheless quite practical.

books.name: book of Beasts
books.description: A book of spells focused on the summoning of beasts. Its pages nip at careless readers' fingers.

books.name: book of Annihilations
books.description: A tome of arcane fury, greatly sought after by sorcerers. It allows the gifted and resourceful to conjure destruction with ease.

books.name: Grand Grimoire
books.description: A book describing how the mighty among summoners can bend to their will the terrible things from betwixt the planes. Many have been the unwary souls, however, who have toyed with this tome and been driven mad by unimaginable eldritch horrors.

books.name: Necronomicon
books.description: An extremely rare book, powerful and sinister. Many foolhardy magicians have tried to study this tome, only to find themselves entangled within necromantic forces they could not hope to control.

weapon_brands.name: flaming
weapon_brands.description: It burns victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces defenders' armour.

weapon_brands.name: freezing
weapon_brands.description: It freezes victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces defenders' armour. It may also slow down cold-blooded creatures.

weapon_brands.name: holy wrath
weapon_brands.description: It has been blessed by the Shining One, dealing an additional three-quarters of any damage that pierces undead and demons' armour. Undead and demons cannot use this.

weapon_brands.name: electrocution
weapon_brands.description: It sometimes electrocutes victims (1/4 chance, 8-20 damage).

weapon_brands.name: venom
weapon_brands.description: It poisons victims.

weapon_brands.name: protection
weapon_brands.description: It grants you temporary protection after it strikes (+7 AC).

weapon_brands.name: draining
weapon_brands.description: It sometimes drains living victims (1/2 chance). This deals an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces defenders' armour as well as a flat 2-4 damage, and also weakens them slightly.

weapon_brands.name: speed
weapon_brands.description: Attacks with it are significantly faster.

weapon_brands.name: heavy
weapon_brands.description: It deals dramatically more damage, but attacks with it are much slower.

weapon_brands.name: vampirism
weapon_brands.description: It occasionally heals you for a portion of the damage dealt when it wounds a living creature.

weapon_brands.name: pain
antimagic
weapon_brands.description: It reduces your magical energy, and disrupts the spells and magical abilities of those it strikes. Natural abilities and divine invocations are not affected.

weapon_brands.name: distortion
weapon_brands.description: It warps and distorts space around it, and may blink, banish, or inflict extra damage upon those it strikes. Unwielding it can teleport you to foes or banish you to the Abyss.

weapon_brands.name: chaos
weapon_brands.description: Each hit from it has a different, random effect.

weapon_brands.name: penetration
weapon_brands.description: Any ammunition fired by it continues flying after striking targets, potentially hitting everything in its path until it leaves sight.

weapon_brands.name: reaping
weapon_brands.description: Any living, holy, or demonic foe damaged by it may be temporarily reanimated upon death as a friendly spectral, with an increasing chance as more damage is dealt.

weapon_brands.name: spectralising
weapon_brands.description: When you attack with it, this weapon's spirit leaps out and launches a second, slightly weaker strike. The spirit shares part of any damage it takes with you.

weapon_brands.name: rebuke
weapon_brands.description: It shields the wearer if their last action was a melee attack (+10 SH) and redirects blocked melee attacks to other nearby enemies.

weapon_brands.name: valour
weapon_brands.description: It fires a beam of energy whenever it strikes an enemy while its wielder has no less than 80% of their maximum hit points remaining. Unwielding it will briefly Weaken its wielder.

weapon_brands.name: entangling
weapon_brands.description: It sometimes constricts those it attacks with vines. (1/2 chance, 2-4 damage).

weapon_brands.name: sundering
weapon_brands.description: After you perform multiple consecutive attacks, its next attack will deal greatly increased damage and also cleave into targets an extra space away.

weapon_brands.name: concussion
weapon_brands.description: It pushes those it hits backwards, briefly stunning them in the process. If it pushes them into a solid feature, they will instead take an additional one-third of any damage that pierces their armour.

weapon_brands.name: devious
weapon_brands.description: It has an increased chance to perform stab attacks against vulnerable targets, and temporarily increases the wielder's EV and slaying each time they do so.

armour_egos.name: fire resistance
armour_egos.description: It protects you from fire.

armour_egos.name: cold resistance
armour_egos.description: It protects you from cold.

armour_egos.name: poison resistance
armour_egos.description: It protects you from poison.

armour_egos.name: see invisible
armour_egos.description: It allows you to see invisible things.

armour_egos.name: invisibility
armour_egos.description: When activated, it grants you temporary invisibility, but also drains your maximum health.

armour_egos.name: strength
armour_egos.description: It increases your strength (Str +3).

armour_egos.name: dexterity
armour_egos.description: It increases your dexterity (Dex +3).

armour_egos.name: intelligence
armour_egos.description: It increases your intelligence (Int +3).

armour_egos.name: ponderousness
armour_egos.description: It is very cumbersome, slowing your movement.

armour_egos.name: flying
armour_egos.description: It grants you flight.

armour_egos.name: willpower
armour_egos.description: It increases your willpower, protecting against certain magical effects.

armour_egos.name: protection
armour_egos.description: It protects you from most sources of damage (AC +3).

armour_egos.name: stealth
armour_egos.description: It enhances your stealth.

armour_egos.name: resistance
armour_egos.description: It protects you from the effects of both fire and cold.

armour_egos.name: positive energy
armour_egos.description: It protects you from the effects of negative energy.

armour_egos.name: the Archmagi
armour_egos.description: It increases the power of your magical spells.

armour_egos.name: corrosion resistance
armour_egos.description: It protects you from the effects of acid and corrosion.

armour_egos.name: reflection
armour_egos.description: It reflects blocked missile attacks.

armour_egos.name: spirit shield
armour_egos.description: It causes incoming damage to be divided between your reserves of health and magic.

armour_egos.name: hurling
armour_egos.description: It improves your accuracy and damage with thrown weapons, such as rocks and javelins (Slay +4).

armour_egos.name: repulsion
armour_egos.description: It helps you evade both magical and non-magical projectiles (EV +15).

armour_egos.name: harm
armour_egos.description: It increases damage dealt and taken.

armour_egos.name: shadows
armour_egos.description: It reduces the distance you can be seen at and can see.

armour_egos.name: rampaging
armour_egos.description: It causes one to take an extra step when moving towards enemies, briefly stunning them if this results in an attack.

armour_egos.name: infusion
armour_egos.description: It empowers each of your melee hits with a small part of your magic.

armour_egos.name: light
armour_egos.description: It surrounds you with a glowing halo, revealing invisible creatures, increasing accuracy against all within it other than you, and reducing your stealth.

armour_egos.name: wrath
armour_egos.description: It berserks you when you make melee attacks (20% chance).

armour_egos.name: mayhem
armour_egos.description: It causes witnesses of your kills to go into a frenzy, attacking everything nearby with great strength and speed.

armour_egos.name: guile
armour_egos.description: It weakens both your willpower and the willpower of everyone you hex, the latter of which is increased by your Evocations skill.

armour_egos.name: energy
armour_egos.description: It may return the magic spent to cast spells, but lowers their success rate. It always returns the magic spent on miscasts. The spell refund chance is increased by your Evocations skill.

armour_egos.name: sniping
armour_egos.description: It increases your damage by an additional 50% with ranged and thrown weapons against incapacitated targets. Incapacitated targets are those that are asleep, paralysed, petrified, confused or caught in a net.

armour_egos.name: ice
armour_egos.description: It enhances your Ice magic.

armour_egos.name: fire
armour_egos.description: It enhances your Fire magic.

armour_egos.name: air
armour_egos.description: It enhances your Air magic.

armour_egos.name: earth
armour_egos.description: It enhances your Earth magic.

armour_egos.name: archery
armour_egos.description: It has one-third the normal encumbrance for the purpose of ranged combat, and slightly increases ranged damage depending on the wearer's armour skill.

armour_egos.name: command
armour_egos.description: It improves the power and success of your Summoning spells in proportion to your Armour skill.

armour_egos.name: death
armour_egos.description: It empowers your Necromancy spells and improves their success rate. When you cast a Necromancy spell, it may drain the life force of susceptible adjacent enemies to heal you; the chance and power of this effect depend on the spell's level.

armour_egos.name: resonance
armour_egos.description: It improves the success rate of your Forgecraft spells, and enhances your melee attacks proportionally to your Forgecraft skill when you melee an enemy that is adjacent to one of your constructs.

armour_egos.name: parrying
armour_egos.description: It shields you if your last action was a melee attack. The shielding is half as effective if your offhand is occupied by an item other than a weapon.

armour_egos.name: glass
armour_egos.description: It may vitrify enemies when you injure them, making them more vulnerable to further damage. Your Evocations skill increases the likelihood and duration of vitrification.

armour_egos.name: pyromania
armour_egos.description: It enhances your Fire magic and may unleash a blast of flames around you whenever you kill an enemy by any means other than an attack. The explosion chance and damage both scale with Evocations and it may trigger no more than once each turn.

armour_egos.name: stardust
armour_egos.description: It conjures a barrage of shooting stars the first time you spend MP to use a spell or ability each battle, recharging only when your MP is restored and no more enemies remain. Your Evocations skill increases the number and damage of the stars and MP spent further increases damage.

armour_egos.name: mesmerism
armour_egos.description:
When you are struck in melee, it briefly dazes all nearby enemies, then must recharge by standing still for a while. Its duration, radius, and recharge speed are improved by your Evocations skill.

It goes briefly dormant whenever you enter a different floor.

armour_egos.name: attunement
armour_egos.description: When worn alongside a magical staff, it doubles the effectiveness of that staff's primary enhancer and causes melee attacks made with it to restore a small amount of MP.

unrands.name: Singing Sword
unrands.description: An enchanted blade which loves nothing more than to sing to its owner, whether they want it to or not.

unrands.name: Wrath of Trog
unrands.description: A bloodstained axe that was the favourite weapon of the old god Trog, before it was lost. It induces a bloodthirsty berserker rage when used in battle, although mere mortals who wield it will find themselves temporarily overwhelmed by Trog's power.

unrands.name: mace of Variability
unrands.description: A large mace said to have appeared when Xom grew bored with the predictability of more ordinary instruments of chaos.

unrands.name: partisan of Prune
unrands.description: The partisan of Prune carries a terrible and insidious curse. Unless its wielder maintains firm self-control, they are doomed to undergo a horrifying (albeit temporary) transformation. This is normally trivial to resist, but incapacitated wielders are certain to succumb, finding themselves nightmarishly purple, squishy, and delicious. They can take comfort in learning that it's surprisingly hard to injure a giant prune.

unrands.name: sword of Power
unrands.description: A legendary great sword that surges with martial vigour when its wielder is in peak fighting condition. In a co-op party, its valorous strikes bolster and mend nearby allies standing shoulder-to-shoulder on the front line.

unrands.name: staff of Olgreb
unrands.description: A staff which was once wielded by the great alchemist Olgreb.

unrands.name: crystal ball of Wucad Mu
unrands.description: A sphere of flawless crystal, shaped by countless mantras. When one focuses upon it, the boundaries between 'self' and 'other' sometimes seem to blur. {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}

unrands.name: Vampire's Tooth
unrands.description: An ivory-like quick blade that looks like it could have been crafted from the tooth of some enormous predatory creature. It is lethally vampiric.

unrands.name: scythe of Curses
unrands.description: A scythe surrounded by an ominous aura of dread. It carries a terrible and ancient curse, which it busily inflicts on both the wielder and their enemies.

unrands.name: sceptre of Torment
unrands.description: An accursed bone sceptre, created by some unknown hellish power. When used in combat, it causes agonising pain in all those unfortunate enough to gaze upon it, save for the wielder.

unrands.name: sword of Zonguldrok
unrands.description: An ancient double sword carved with necromantic runes by the dread lich Zonguldrok. Those slain by its edge are bound into unlife to serve its wielder.

unrands.name: sword of Cerebov
unrands.description: A twisted blade, covered in eerie flames. Its demonic power burns away at the very essence of those it is wielded against.

unrands.name: orb of Dispater
unrands.description: An orb pulsing with unholy energies, granting the power to unleash damnation when held — although not without draining the wielder's vitality in the process. It carries with it some of the corrosive malice of the Iron City of Dis.

unrands.name: sceptre of Asmodeus
unrands.description: A bright ruby sceptre, carrying some of the powers of the arch-fiend Asmodeus. It may call forth fiery demons from their infernal home to do the wielder's bidding.

unrands.name: faerie dragon scales
unrands.description: An enchanted suit of armour created from the scales of a rare breed of dragon, now thought to be extinct. This prized relic is now one of the last proofs that the vividly coloured faerie dragons ever existed.

unrands.name: demon blade "Bloodbane"
unrands.description: A blade forged in Hell by the sacrifice of countless tortured souls. It inflicts the rage and suffering of those souls upon its wielder.

unrands.name: scimitar of Flaming Death
unrands.description: A scimitar with a mysteriously smoking blade. Occasionally its heat leaks out, covering opponents in magical flame.

unrands.name: eveningstar "Brilliance"
unrands.description:
Soon after falling, Yredelemnul attempted to twist holy energy into a dark mockery of itself, turning it against its progenitors and weakening it against undead and demons. It was discovered too late that such a complete perversion was uncontrollable; the foul flame destabilised or destroyed everything it was infused into, except for several demonic test subjects and one stolen holy weapon. A lesser, and more stable, version of the dark energy proved more workable, and became Yredelemnul's umbra.

This is that weapon: an eveningstar with its light long fled, despite its name, and a shadow that repulses those its light used to comfort...

unrands.name: demon blade "Leech"
unrands.description: A blade forged in Hell by the sacrifice of countless tortured souls. It fills its wielder with the rage and suffering of those souls, and gorges itself further on drained life force every time it strikes, leaving behind a mess of blood and gore.

unrands.name: dagger of Chilly Death
unrands.description: A dagger made of one huge shard of sapphire. It covers opponents in ice, slowing down their movement somewhat.

unrands.name: dagger "Morg"
unrands.description: An ugly rusty dagger. Many years ago it was the property of a powerful mage called Boris. He got lost in the Dungeon while seeking the Orb.

unrands.name: scythe "Finisher"
unrands.description:
A long and exceedingly sharp scythe, capable of eviscerating in a single blow. Its extraordinary speed is the work of a mad wizard, who spent years refining it before discarding it in a fit of rage.

The blade looses a low keen as it cuts through the air.

unrands.name: greatsling "Punk"
unrands.description: A sling made of weird green leather, oozing corrosive slime. Originally the weapon of a notorious mischief-maker and general scamp, it's since fallen into less savoury hands.

unrands.name: longbow "Zephyr"
unrands.description: A golden bow, strung with a lock of hair from the West Wind themselves. Tales say it was crafted as a gift to an unrequited love and even centuries after their untimely death, one can still feel longing carried on the gentle breeze that surrounds its wielder.

unrands.name: giant club "Skullcrusher"
unrands.description: A massive enchanted cudgel that augments the already considerable strength of anyone mighty enough to wield it.

unrands.name: glaive of the Guard
unrands.description:
A glaive commissioned several years ago by a wealthy queen fearful for the safety of her vast treasury. No foe, the smith promised, could defeat a guard wielding such a weapon!

It was stolen a few months later, along with the rest of the queen's treasury; the guard, it transpired, had been caught napping. Still, it should serve more than adequately in the hands of a waking user.

unrands.name: zealot's sword
unrands.description: A sword made of one huge piece of crystal. Legend says it was the Shining One's gift to a worshipper. This blade is notorious for inducing bloodthirsty rage in both the wielder and all of their followers.

unrands.name: arbalest "Damnation"
unrands.description: An unholy crossbow, forged in the fires of Gehenna. It imbues the bolts it fires with the raw power of its namesake. Thankfully, the blasts this weapon produces never harm the one firing.

unrands.name: sword of the Dread Knight
unrands.description:
An adamantine great sword. Its first wielder was a worshipper of Yredelemnul who eschewed the use of magic in combat, preferring to destroy her enemies with brute force. Unfortunately for her, not all of her opponents shared her limitations.

It has felled countless great warriors under her grip, and the souls of those who had their lives taken beckon it to take even more under its new owner.

unrands.name: morningstar "Eos"
unrands.description: A jewelled morningstar, glowing brightly with the light of the dawn. It illuminates the dungeon's recesses, revealing the machinations of those who would prefer to stay invisible.

unrands.name: spear of the Botono
unrands.description: A dark and malign artefact. It increases the potency of hexes cast by anyone unwise enough to risk wielding it.

unrands.name: trident of the Octopus King
unrands.description: A trident stolen many years ago from the Octopus King's garden. Luckily, he seems to be in no hurry to get it back.

unrands.name: mithril axe "Arga"
unrands.description: A beautiful mithril axe, probably lost by some dwarven hero.

unrands.name: Elemental Staff
unrands.description: A powerful staff which used to belong to the leader of the Guild of Five Elements. It is imbued with protective and offensive enhancements from all the elemental schools of magic.

unrands.name: heavy crossbow "Sniper"
unrands.description: The sacred weapon of Toth-Mos, first apostle of the god Ashenzari. It grants the wielder a fraction of Ashenzari's own vision, ensuring that every shot will land true.

unrands.name: longbow "Piercer"
unrands.description: An exceptionally large metal longbow.

unrands.name: shortbow of the Assassin
unrands.description: This shadowy shortbow guides its venomous arrows to seek the most lethal point to strike an unaware target, packing a nasty punch.

unrands.name: lance "Wyrmbane"
unrands.description: An enchanted lance deadly to all dragonkind. It grows more powerful every time it inflicts a killing blow on a strong dragon. The more powerful it grows, the harder it will be to find a worthy opponent.

unrands.name: Spriggan's Knife
unrands.description: A dainty little knife which was made by Spriggans, or for Spriggans, or possibly from Spriggans. Anyway, it's in some way associated with those fey folk.

unrands.name: plutonium sword
unrands.description: A triple sword made of weird glowing metal. It irradiates those it strikes, causing a range of unpredictable effects — if they survive the impact of the blade itself, that is.

unrands.name: great mace "Undeadhunter"
unrands.description: A weapon imbued with magic to disrupt and destroy the forces binding undead creatures together. Legends say that, long ago, a lich lord created many such weapons to ensure the loyalty of his undead servants. Sadly, this mace might be the last one left.

unrands.name: whip "Snakebite"
unrands.description: A double-ended whip made from the cured hides of black mambas, and enchanted with toxins ranging from ordinary venoms to asphyxiating curare.

unrands.name: knife of Accuracy
unrands.description: It is almost unerringly accurate.

unrands.name: Lehudib's crystal spear
unrands.description: Presumably this relic led to the invention of the famous spell, or maybe the other way around.

unrands.name: captain's cutlass
unrands.description: An infamous weapon, once used by a vile pirate captain to slaughter countless innocents. He finally met his destiny when a kraken swallowed his ship, and the cutlass was thought to be lost with him.

unrands.name: storm bow
unrands.description: A longbow with the colour of dark rain clouds that fires arrows like lightning.

unrands.name: tower shield of Ignorance
unrands.description:
A shield unearthed from the remains of a ruined city. It bears an inscription written in an ancient language. Scholars and wise men laboured for countless hours to decipher it, and in time, a translation was finally settled on:

"With a shield like this, who needs to think?"

unrands.name: robe of Augmentation
unrands.description: A variegated robe, woven with enchantments to enhance the wearer's physical and mental abilities. Its creators wove in strands of hair from a hundred different animals, each chosen for the unique strengths it could grant the robe's wearer.

unrands.name: cloak of the Thief
unrands.description: A pitch-black cloak which allows its wearer to excel in the arts of thievery. Even the clumsy will find their footsteps softer and the shouts of their adversaries less attention-getting.

unrands.name: tower shield "Bullseye"
unrands.description: Just in case you had trouble getting hit.

unrands.name: crown of Dyrovepreva
unrands.description: A large circlet of dull bronze, set with a dazzling array of gemstones. It was first worn by a prince of the Titans, who sought protection from the incessant warfare between his fellow princes. In practice, the main effect of the artefact was to unite his rivals against him.

unrands.name: hat of the Bear Spirit
unrands.description: A fur hat once owned by Ukta, a powerful ogre shaman. It houses the spirit of an especially mighty bear, whose rages devastated the ogres until it was slain.

unrands.name: robe of Misfortune
unrands.description: A splendid flowing robe of fur and silk whose lucky colour has faded.

unrands.name: cloak of Flash
unrands.description: A cloak that twitches and jerks without any intervention.

unrands.name: hood of the Assassin
unrands.description: A soft hood, enchanted by members of the Assassin's Guild to allow the wearer to sense potential victims nearby, and to easily spot vulnerabilities after closing in on them.

unrands.name: Lear's hauberk
unrands.description: A well-made golden hauberk that covers all of its wearer's body parts. It includes a chainmail coif, chausses and maille gauntlets.

unrands.name: skin of Zhor
unrands.description: The {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}skin of some strange animal, native to cold and distant lands. It radiates the chill of its native habitat.

unrands.name: salamander hide armour
unrands.description: Most salamanders' bodies are consigned to the fiery depths from which they sprang. Rarely, though, salamanders instead preserve the skins of those that passed. The runes and decorations on this hide suggest it once belonged to a respected warrior or priest - perhaps even a king. The fiery spirit remains in the skin, granting its power to the wearer.

unrands.name: gauntlets of War
unrands.description: A pair of thick steel gauntlets. They were Okawaru's reward for a mighty warlord. The owner is destined to die in battle, but what a death it will be!

unrands.name: shield of Resistance
unrands.description: A bronze shield, looking almost exactly like a tortoise's shell. It was built by the adherents of an obscure minor faith, who imbued it with the power of their god. As the god is said to, this shield protects against sword and sling, frost and flame.

unrands.name: robe of Folly
unrands.description: A dull grey robe. It is enchanted to provide mages with immeasurable power, and more than a little overconfidence...

unrands.name: Maxwell's patent armour
unrands.description: A suit of armour created by the famous inventor Maxwell, providing unparalleled protective qualities at a very affordable price. His unorthodox materials left it with certain shortcomings, but he's yet to have anyone come back for a refund.

unrands.name: mask of the Dragon
unrands.description: The mask of the High Priest of ancient Erebora. In ancient times, the gods of the Ereborans ceased to answer their prayers, and in desperation, the people turned to the forbidden worship of dragons. Now, of their works, only this mask remains.

unrands.name: robe of Night
unrands.description: A long black robe made of strange glossy material. It shrouds its wearer in darkness, reducing the range of vision. According to legend, it was the gift of Rutra, a renowned demigoddess of the night, to one of her followers.

unrands.name: scales of the Dragon King
unrands.description: A suit of armour created from the enchanted scales of a once-mighty king of dragons. In his time, titans and lesser dragons struggled with him in vain — but as with all things, even he was eventually cast down and undone. Of his life and deeds, this is all that remains.

unrands.name: hat of the Alchemist
unrands.description: A dirty hat. It bears signs of surviving many weird explosions, which suggests it may have means of protecting the head inside from the risks involved with alchemy experiments.

unrands.name: fencer's gloves
unrands.description: A pair of gloves made of white silk.

unrands.name: cloak of Starlight
unrands.description: A phosphorescent cloak, woven of pure light beams. The ripples of its folds as the wearer leaps and swerves in combat may dazzle those who gaze on it.

unrands.name: ratskin cloak
unrands.description: A cloak stitched from the hides of hundreds of hell rats by an enchantress with far too much time on her hands. Many more rats remain somehow concealed within it, and may scurry out to assist the wearer.

unrands.name: shield of the Gong
unrands.description: A heavy bronze gong that can be worn as a shield. Locked away in a temple for many years, its bearer is shielded by decades of accumulated prayer.

unrands.name: amulet of the Air
unrands.description: A sky-blue amulet, suffused with enchantments that protect the wearer and make their Air spells more powerful. Its creator lacked just one thing: a steady hand.

unrands.name: ring of Shadows
unrands.description: A black ring that can make its wearer one with the shadows.

unrands.name: amulet of Cekugob
unrands.description: A strange-looking piece of crystal on an ordinary-looking string, with an odd selection of powers.

unrands.name: amulet of Tranquillity
unrands.description: A pendant made of purest jade. It grants its wearer immense willpower and mental fortitude.

unrands.name: necklace of Bloodlust
unrands.description: A necklace made of bloodstained human and animal teeth, and something that appears to be a piece of spine.

unrands.name: ring of the Hare
unrands.description: An unadorned malachite ring, half of an ancient pair. Its wearer is exceptionally difficult to catch.

unrands.name: ring of the Tortoise
unrands.description: A rough-hewn aquamarine ring, half of an ancient pair. Its wearer is exceptionally difficult to harm.

unrands.name: ring of the Mage
unrands.description: An enchanted sapphire, inset into a ring. It aids the spellcasting of its wearer.

unrands.name: brooch of Shielding
unrands.description: A brooch with an intricate inlaid design, providing a range of magical protections. Back in the good old days, every adventurer had one of these handy devices. That, and a pony.

unrands.name: robe of Clouds
unrands.description: A robe of a material as nebulous and insubstantial as the clouds. It whips the air around it up into a furious storm as it ripples and swirls.

unrands.name: hat of Pondering
unrands.description: The favourite hat of the slug wizard Gastronok, stained with reddish slime and enchanted to aid in his arcane pondering. It has been specially enchanted to protect against the desiccating effects of salt.

unrands.name: obsidian axe
unrands.description: An axe with a powerful curse placed on it by one of the lords of Pandemonium, so that unsuspecting adventurers would unleash demons into this world. Beware, for it has ways of mesmerising its wielder, no matter how clear and focused their mind...

unrands.name: lightning scales
unrands.description: A set of armoured plates assembled to protect a creature with a long, scaly lower body. Faintly crackling with electricity, they supercharge their wearer's ability to cover distance.

unrands.name: Black Knight's barding
unrands.description: A heavy barding made from pitch-black steel and inlaid with plates of black diamond. It once protected the steed of the Black Knight during their reign of terror. Those who wear it become partially undead, gaining some of the benefits without the unfortunate downsides, although the great weight of metal and stone slows the wearer somewhat.

unrands.name: amulet of Vitality
unrands.description: A jewelled amulet famed for its powers of resilience and recuperation. Its greatest notoriety came from its use by the dread necromancer Borgnjor, who relied upon it to maintain her slender hold on life. After her final demise, the amulet vanished from the pages of history.

unrands.name: autumn katana
unrands.description: An exquisitely crafted sword. Its blade is so sharp that it can cut through space itself.

unrands.name: shillelagh "Devastator"
unrands.description: A wooden cudgel, loaded with more than just lead.

unrands.name: dragonskin cloak
unrands.description: An opalescent cloak gleaming with the colours of all kinds of dragons. It imbues the wearer with draconic resistances, although somewhat unreliably.

unrands.name: ring of the Octopus King
unrands.description: One of the eight rings once worn by the Octopus King and now scattered across the land. Each has its own unique enchantment.

unrands.name: Axe of Woe
unrands.description: As you hold this axe your mind does not feel fully your own. Your body begins to exhibit strength far beyond its capabilities, and your movements become guided by Makhleb.

unrands.name: moon troll leather armour
unrands.description: A suit of armour rumoured to have been created by enchanting the hide of a now-extinct species of troll. Whether the name rings true or is merely appropriated to add mystique is something of a mystery. The armour's innate powers of regeneration and magical protection, however, are hard to dispute.

unrands.name: macabre finger necklace
unrands.description: An ugly dangling finger on a string. Everything about it reeks of malign influences... but it's hard to avoid thinking that it would look better with a ring on it.

unrands.name: boots of the spider
unrands.description: A novel pair of boots invented by a suitor of Arachne.

unrands.name: dark maul
unrands.description: A large, iron-shod maul specialised for dealing massively powerful blows. Such power comes at a price: the maul's head is so heavy it takes a great length of time to lift it up for another swing.

unrands.name: hat of the High Council
unrands.description: A relic of some ancient wizarding war. Centuries later, it still crackles with effects from the residual hexes and magical energies it was once subjected to on a daily basis; spellcasters able to get a handle on its power, however, will find it enhances the power of their spells.

unrands.name: arc blade
unrands.description: A blade somehow crafted from pure electricity. It arcs wildly between the wielder and their foes as it strikes.

unrands.name: demon whip "Spellbinder"
unrands.description: A weapon said to have once been used to keep unruly imprisoned wizards in line; it violently disrupts the flow of magic around it.

unrands.name: lajatang of Order
unrands.description: A silver-bladed lajatang, once bestowed upon a favoured worshipper of Zin. It became the most prized weapon of the many priests of Zin. After their order was destroyed, it fell into disuse and vanished from history.

unrands.name: great mace "Firestarter"
unrands.description: A huge mace imbued with potent fire magic. It fills those it strikes with an inner flame, and offers some protection against the resulting devastation.

unrands.name: orange crystal plate armour
unrands.description: A suit of armour carved from transparent orange crystal. It provides remarkable protection for both mind and body. The wearer can even channel psychic energies through the crystal itself, enhancing their magical abilities. However, it's rather heavy...

unrands.name: Majin-Bo
unrands.description: A staff inhabited by a mighty demon, tricked and trapped in this form long ago. To survive, she now offers great arcane power in a terrible bargain: in exchange for a tiny portion of the caster's life essence, taken every time its wielder casts a spell, she will redirect the life essence of creatures damaged by the spell to the caster.

unrands.name: pair of quick blades "Gyre" and "Gimble"
unrands.description: Two quick blades joined by a chain. Swinging one compels the wielder to swing the other, as if they have minds of their own.

unrands.name: Maxwell's etheric cage
unrands.description: A fine mesh cage designed to capture magical energy. Experimental notes suggest that research was abandoned when the cage began to capture magical contamination almost as effectively. Anyone reckless enough to place it on their head would find their magic regeneration dramatically increased, at the cost of multiplying any magical contamination received.

unrands.name: crown of Eternal Torment
unrands.description: A gold crown set with jet-black gems. It permanently afflicts its wearer with agonising pain, substantially reducing their resilience but rendering them immune to further torments.

unrands.name: robe of Vines
unrands.description: A robe woven of living vines. The vines form a symbiotic relationship with their wearer, greatly increasing their regeneration, but preventing them from being healed by potions.

unrands.name: Kryia's mail coat
unrands.description: A coat of armour said to have been forged for Queen Kryia in her old age. She continued to insist on leading her armies from the front even into her dotage, and as her aging body failed her, this coat helped to enhance the healing draughts that kept her alive.

unrands.name: frozen axe "Frostbite"
unrands.description: A massive axe that looks like it was carved from a glacier, or possibly calved from one. It leaves ice crystals in its wake as it swings through the air.

unrands.name: armour of Talos
unrands.description: A huge and weighty suit of bronze plate armour. Only one with a correspondingly huge body can wear it.

unrands.name: warlock's mirror
unrands.description: A handheld array of hexagonal mirrors, synthesised from a truly exotic substance and polished to a blinding sheen.

unrands.name: amulet of invisibility
unrands.description: An amulet that can be activated to render its wearer invisible.

unrands.name: Maxwell's thermic engine
unrands.description: A strange sword, one blade blistering hot and the other icy cold. When it hits its target the thermal gradient increases. What causes this effect is unknown but it is rumoured that otherworldly forces are involved.

unrands.name: demon trident "Rift"
unrands.description: A small wrinkle in the very fabric of reality, magically bound to a shaft by some mad acolyte of Lugonu. Its attacks can warp through nearby space at the wielder's command.

unrands.name: sphere of Battle
unrands.description: An orb encased in vividly coloured scales, wrought by a long-forgotten wizard. It was the mage Iskenderun's favourite playtoy.

unrands.name: Cigotuvi's embrace
unrands.description: A suit of armour borne of rotten flesh and bone and gristle, held intact by the will of a long-dead sorcerer. The dreadful energies within it call to the bodies of the recently dead, protecting the wearer with a cocoon of carrion.

unrands.name: seven-league boots
unrands.description: An enchanted pair of boots which grant the ability to take strides of incredible length, as long as the wearer is advancing bravely towards their foes.

unrands.name: Mad Mage's Maulers
unrands.description: A pair of gloves designed to carefully control and channel the flow of magic, later misused and mangled by the lunatic murderer-mages of the Fifth Circle. Their influence leaves the wearer utterly unable to cast spells - the wearer's magic is redirected to far bloodier purposes.

unrands.name: dreamshard necklace
