unrands.description: A beautiful rainbow of colour and motion trapped within a delicate crystal on a thin silver chain. Listening carefully, one can hear the distant echo of a thousand dreams from all corners of reality, their melody giving a warm sense of safety.

unrands.name: Delatra's gloves
unrands.description: A pair of long ultramarine gloves, worn by a famed experimental alchemist in an age long past. They channel the energy of discovery, empowering their wearer with the force created by a blind step from ignorance to certainty.

unrands.name: woodcutter's axe
unrands.description: A weapon that chops foes down as steadily and methodically as a forester cutting wood. The unchanging rhythm of its work has settled on it with the force of natural law, and no amount of force or skill can make it swing faster or slower.

unrands.name: Throatcutter
unrands.description: Taken from a paladin of the Shining One by the common cutpurse who murdered her, Throatcutter was used for a long series of increasingly sordid deeds thereafter. Blood, murder and betrayal stain its history and blade both, and little trace now remains of the blade which once stood between danger and the innocent.

unrands.name: staff of the Meek
unrands.description: A sacred relic of the Monks of St. Lee, followers of the renunciate archmage. Just as St. Lee sought to atone for the destruction his spells wrought by protecting others, so his staff protects its wielder.

unrands.name: trishula "Condemnation"
unrands.description: A weapon to bring forth guilt from the guilty. It was first wielded by the archangel Lucriel, who, on seeing the suffering of the first mortals, led them as an army against the cruelty of the gods. The ragged survivors of Lucriel's army took this weapon with them into the wilderness, the sole remnant of an archangel's virtue.

unrands.name: amulet of Elemental Vulnerability
unrands.description: A blue-steel amulet. Its creator, an exceedingly practical woman, designed it to provide powerful protection against mundane jabs, stabs and bites. It's worse than useless against fire and frost, but how often does anyone really need to worry about that?

unrands.name: mountain boots
unrands.description: These sturdy boots were created by an artificer who lived high up on a remote mountain peak, as protection against the mountain's near-constant avalanches, rockslides, and snowstorms. No force short of translocations magic will budge the wearer from their position.

unrands.name: Lochaber axe
unrands.description: This brutal weapon, long thought lost to history, combines the extended reach of a polearm with the cleaving sharpness of an axe. Ghosts of ancient warriors linger about it, draining fickle users.

unrands.name: Hermit's Pendant
unrands.description: An ascetic once took a sacred vow, forswearing use of magical tools and ownership of everything but this pendant. Which god they made this vow to remains a point of bitter contention among the devout, but their pendant's power - and limitations - are irrefutable.

unrands.name: slick slippers
unrands.description: Crafted from the tanned, smooth hide of a Western Skyshark, these slippers are astonishingly comfortable. They lack the protective benefits of a good pair of boots, but they can get their wearers out of almost any bind.

unrands.name: Force Lance
unrands.description: A plain iron lance, imbued with supernatural gravitas via the artifice of the mage Gell. It strikes with a force many times stronger than that imparted by the wielder.

unrands.name: consecrated labrys
unrands.description: An axe with a delicate blessing placed on it by one of the sacred Seraphim, so that worthy adventurers would rid this world of demons. Rejoice, for it has ways of bringing courage to its wielder in even the darkest places...

unrands.name: toga "Victory"
unrands.description: An ancient artefact of Okawaru, these woolen robes were lost when a former champion failed a duel. Its enchantments increase in power when the wearer emerges victorious from threatening combat, but resorting to the use of scrolls or potions for assistance causes them to fade away again.

unrands.name: Storm Queen's Shield
unrands.description: A disc of crackling metal, created by a woman whose cunning artifice and crafty politics once united a continent. Most of her surviving inventions are closely guarded by various royals, ostensible proof of their claim to be her true successor, but this early prototype slipped through their fingers.

unrands.name: dreamdust necklace
unrands.description: A dull dusty mixture trapped within a cracked crystal on a thin silver chain.

unrands.name: hand cannon "Mule"
unrands.description: Hand cannons use magical dust to launch projectiles. The alchemists who craft them boast of their potency, but omit the smoke and noise blasted out with each shot. Filled with powdered blastmotes, Mule packs an especially powerful kick.

unrands.name: gloves of the gadgeteer
unrands.description: A pair of suede gloves covered in a dizzying array of delicate sigils. While originally intended to aid in the crafting of magical devices, they are nonetheless useful for wringing every last drop of power out of someone else's work.

unrands.name: Charlatan's Orb
unrands.description: This orb is the work of a master artificer, contracted to retrieve the orb, who valued their life more than their professional integrity. While this fake faithfully recreates the eerie glow and space-warping properties of the true orb, the power it grants is artificial and only accessible to skilled evokers.

unrands.name: justicar's regalia
unrands.description: A gleaming breastplate with a slot in its centre for a holy symbol or bejewelled coat of arms. Those who hear commands given by its wearer feel filled with the power to carry them out, no matter the adversity.

unrands.name: skull of Zonguldrok
unrands.description: The skull of a legendary necromancer, seemingly parted from the rest of its body. When held, it seems disinclined to explain the precise circumstances of its ending up in this state, but offers no objection to others siphoning what considerable necromantic power still remains in its ancient bones.

unrands.name: fungal fisticloak
unrands.description:
The handiwork of a mad mycologist who once attempted to overcome the genetic anxiety of wandering mushrooms by cultivating a species that could be easily transported without disturbing them. The result is as much a living organism as it is a piece of clothing, every linen fibre twined together with fungal mycelia that draw both nutrients and confidence from whoever wears it. And in exchange for such trifles as blood or peptides, the colony will instinctively lash out to defend its wearer from whatever they perceive as a threat.

It's like wearing a thousand tiny friends at once! And the humming they fill your mind with in the dark is actually quite lulling....

(This item also occupies your helmet slot.)

unrands.name: crown of vainglory
unrands.description: An extravagant crown of gold filigree and glittering jewels that even a king could feel immodest wearing. It grants its wearer a regal aura the match of any in heaven and also a great deal of unearned confidence.

unrands.name: scarf of invisibility
unrands.description: A scarf that can be activated to render its wearer invisible.

unrands.name: swamp witch's dragon scales
unrands.description: A flamboyant suit of ancient armour that has led to many minor schisms between historians, as it is uncertain whether it was made from some renowned witch's pet dragon, or her frequent prey, or from her own non-human body itself. Regardless of its origins, the magic woven into it freely rains toxins all over its bearer's especially misfortunate foes.

unrands.name: athame "Fimbulwinter"
unrands.description:
An instrument of terror crafted by some of Qazlal's most infamous prophets, meant to coax forth a three-year winter preceding the end of time. Those chilled by its wielder will feel fate's icy grip upon their throat.

As with all athames, blows made with it against those suffering baleful negative statuses (other than poison) have increased base damage.

unrands.name: fire dragon occultist's scales
unrands.description: The resonating scales of the great fire-breathing dragon Zmysua, an ancient occultist fond of debilitation and devastation. Her loving rivalry with the elder dragon arcanist Yntzoia was legendarily destructive, and led to the both of them seeking out endless mystic augmentations to triumph over one another- even now, these scales still hum with thirst to confront what remains of their opposite beyond death.

unrands.name: ice dragon arcanist's scales
unrands.description: The thrumming scales of the great frost-breathing dragon Yntzoia, an ancient arcanist fond of spectacle and destruction. Her tumultous relationship with the elder dragon occultist Zmysua was quite infamous, and led to the both of them seeking out endless mystic augmentations seeking more time for reconciliation- even now, these scales still reverberate with hunger to return to what remains of their opposite beyond death.

unrands.name: giant spiked club "Carina at Dusk"
unrands.description: Even the trolls have their share of nature poets, glassy-eyed dreamers, and starving artists. This is the masterwork of one such restless soul, a paean to the heavens far above.

unrands.name: coolibah bardiche
unrands.description: A massive polearm hewn in one piece from a coolibah tree. Its blade is no less sharp for being made of wood, and those caught in its enchanted branches will soon find themselves at home in the bog from which this deadly weapon sprouted.

unrands.name: staff of Five Virtues
unrands.description: The staff of a venerable master monk who drove away her foes as easily as her attachments and (so the legend says) eventually transcended life and death altogether. A worthy wielder may unlock the staff's great potential, provided they follow its former owner's peculiar ideas of balance and comportment.

unrands.name: Stagehand's Sword
unrands.description: An unassuming sword resembling a prop weapon for theatrical use. But behold! A twist here, a press there, and the real blade springs forth; glittering, wicked, murderous. Has it killed before? If so, it left no witnesses. Shall it kill for you? If you're sly enough, it will do just as you like.

unrands.name: Hana's Scimitar
unrands.description: The favored sword of one of the battlemage Yara's most illustrious pupils, an alleged demigoddess who often boasted that one spell and one slash were enough to settle any battle. Indeed, all of her duels ended in just such a fashion, including her last.

unrands.name: arcane splint mail
unrands.description: A truly ancient set of armour designed for maximum protection and flexibility. Evidently intended for use by mounted hexslingers, its magic wards and sigils are in a hopeless state of disrepair. Nevertheless, some traces of their power still remain.

unrands.name: bone scales
unrands.description: The half-stitched, or half-unstitched, torso of a bone dragon, fashioned (if one may call it that) into a truly wretched piece of armour. Its jagged bones seem to pulse with unlife, awaiting the command of some unholy master.

unrands.name: Forgewarden's cuirass
unrands.description: A bronze chestpiece of masterful make. It is etched all over with religious imagery, but the focus of the scene is obscured by a great dark stain {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}of ashes and salt. It seems somehow blasphemous to wear.

unrands.name: ghost crab claws
unrands.description:
A large pair of ghostly claws fashioned into gloves by a fenstrider coven for use in necromantic rites. The magically inclined and pugilistically favoured alike may grasp their connection with the spirits of the dead, but these pincers make grasping anything else an exercise in frustration.

(This item prohibits the use of a weapon or shield while equipped.)

unrands.name: kite shield "Aegis of Fellowship"
unrands.description: Bulwark:   It projects half of its bearer's shielding to adjacent allies, and grants an additional shield block each turn for every adjacent ally.

unrands.name: quarterstaff "Conduit Staff"
unrands.description: Ley-Pulse: Casting spells restores mana to nearby allies within four tiles.

unrands.name: ring of Twin Souls
unrands.description: TwinSoul:  While an ally is in sight within six tiles, both you and your nearest visible ally gain +3 Slaying, +3 AC, and enhanced health and magic regeneration. Melee attacks against foes in your partner's sight unleash a resonant flare and mend your partner's wounds.

unrands.name: broad axe "Dawnforged"
unrands.description: Forged in the heart of a dying sun as the solar half of a legendary twin armoury, this gleaming broad axe radiates relentless heat. When its wielder fights within sight of a companion bearing its lunar twin, Duskweaver, both weapons awaken in an Eclipse Link that bolsters their bearers' armour and prowess while detonating solar-lunar cataclysms on every shared strike.

unrands.name: demon blade "Duskweaver"
unrands.description: Quenched in the frozen abyss between stars as the lunar counterpart to Dawnforged, this crescent-edged demon blade drinks the warmth and magic of those it cuts. When wielded in sight of Dawnforged's bearer, the two blades resonate across the battlefield, weaving frost and solar fire into devastating eclipse bursts.

unrands.name: gauntlets of the Shieldmate
unrands.description: Heavy gold-trimmed gauntlets worn by the sworn bodyguards of ancient dwarven shield-kings. Every blow struck while wearing them channels protective force and vital warmth into companions standing shoulder-to-shoulder with the wearer.

spells.name: Cause Fear
spells.description: Causes fear in those near to the caster, causing those affected to be unable to approach the caster, and to sometimes fail to attack them in melee. Leaving the caster's line of sight will end the effect.

spells.name: Magic Dart
spells.description: Fires a small bolt of magical energy which never misses.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Hurls an explosive ball of fire.

spells.name: Apportation
spells.description:
Pulls all items at a given location on the floor towards the caster.

With low power, items might not be moved all the way to the caster's position.

Extremely powerful magical items, such as the Orb of Zot, may actively resist the pull of this spell.

spells.name: Conjure Flame
spells.description: Conjures a roaring pillar of flame on a targeted open floor tile within range.

spells.name: Dig
spells.description: Digs a tunnel through unworked rock.

spells.name: Bolt of Fire
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of flames.

spells.name: Bolt of Cold
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of frost.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: Fires a mighty penetrating bolt of lightning. Its damage bypasses half of defenders' armour, and it can be bounced off walls to hit targets twice.

spells.name: Bolt of Magma
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of molten rock. Half of its damage bypasses fire resistance.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: Randomly alters the form of a creature. It is especially effective against shape-changing creatures.

spells.name: Slow
spells.description: Slows the actions of a creature.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Speeds the actions of the caster or a targeted ally in line of sight, allowing them to move and act much more rapidly for a short duration, after which the caster is left contaminated with residual magical energy.

spells.name: Paralyse
spells.description: Prevents a creature from taking any action for a short time.

spells.name: Confuse
spells.description: Induces a state of bewilderment and confusion in a creature's mind.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description:
Turns the caster or a targeted ally in line of sight invisible, hiding them from the sight of most monsters and leaving the caster contaminated with residual magical energy.

While an enemy is invisible to you, your accuracy against them is reduced and you suffer a major penalty to your evasion and ability to block any attacks they make against you.

spells.name: Throw Flame
spells.description: Throws a small puff of flame.

spells.name: Throw Frost
spells.description: Throws a small puff of frost.

spells.name: Controlled Blink
spells.description: Teleports the caster directly to a chosen visible square, leaving a brief spatial instability cooldown before it can be cast again.

spells.name: Freezing Cloud
spells.description: Conjures up a large cloud of lethally cold vapour.

spells.name: Mephitic Cloud
spells.description: Conjures a fragile flask that explodes into short-lived clouds of noxious fumes. These clouds may cause confusion in any creature not resistant to poison. Tougher, more experienced creatures are less likely to be affected.

spells.name: Venom Bolt
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of poison.

spells.name: Olgreb's Toxic Radiance
spells.description: Causes the caster to radiate toxic energy, continuously inflicting poison on everything in line of sight for as long as the spell lasts.

spells.name: Teleport Other
spells.description: Attempts to teleport a targeted creature out of the caster's sight, after a short delay.

spells.name: Minor Healing
spells.description: Heals a small amount of damage to the caster's body.

spells.name: Major Healing
spells.description: Heals a large amount of damage to the caster's body.

spells.name: Death's Door
spells.description:
Renders the caster nigh invulnerable to harm for a brief period, but brings them dangerously close to death in the process. So close, in fact, that the body believes itself to be dead — healing effects will do nothing.

The caster will receive one warning shortly before the spell expires. After expiry, the spell cannot immediately be recast, but with high power the caster will be left further from death when the effect ends. It has no effect on those who are already undead.

spells.name: Mass Confusion
spells.description: Causes confusion in all who gaze upon the caster.

spells.name: Smiting
spells.description: Smites any targeted enemy within sight, with no direct line of fire required.

spells.name: Summon Small Mammal
spells.description: Summons a rat, bat, or quokka to the caster's aid. Spell power increases the chance of summoning a quokka.

spells.name: Abjuration
spells.description: Reduces the remaining duration of any nearby hostile summoned creatures.

spells.name: Summon Scorpions
spells.description: Calls forth a swarm of venomous scorpions.

spells.name: Bolt of Draining
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of negative energy which drains any living creature it strikes.

spells.name: Lehudib's Crystal Spear
spells.description: Hurls a lethally sharp shard of crystal.

spells.name: Poisonous Cloud
spells.description: Conjures forth a great cloud of lethal gases.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.description: Calls forth a mighty storm of roaring flame directly onto the target, dealing damage in a large area and leaving behind short-lived fire vortices. Half of its damage bypasses fire resistance.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Randomly translocates the caster a short distance. After translocating in this way, the spell cannot be cast again for a short period of time depending on spell power.

spells.name: Iskenderun's Mystic Blast
spells.description: Detonates a crackling sphere of destructive energy. The explosion will hit all nearby monsters with physical force, knocking them back if damage is done. Spellpower increases damage and knockback distance.

spells.name: Summon Horrible Things
spells.description: Opens a gate to the Abyss and calls through two or more hideous abominations from that dreadful place. While powerful, brushing one's mind against the fabric of the Abyss in this manner invites Doom upon the caster and may eventually cost them greatly.

spells.name: Charm
spells.description: Causes an otherwise hostile creature to fight on the caster's side for a while. Adventurers, set on their quest for the ORB, instead suffer momentary confusion.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.description: For some time after casting this, living creatures killed by the caster will rise as zombies. The chance of reanimating a monster and the duration of the effect increase with spell power. Re-casting this spell will return zombies to dust, as will leaving the floor.

spells.name: Pain
spells.description: Inflicts an extremely painful injury upon one living creature.

spells.name: Vampiric Draining
spells.description: Steals the life force from an adjacent creature and grants it to the caster.

spells.name: Haunt
spells.description: Calls wraiths and ghosts to haunt the caster's target. They will only attack the creature they are haunting, and will dissipate quickly once their target dies. The number of spectres summoned increases with spell power.

spells.name: Borgnjor's Revivification
spells.description:
Instantly heals any and all wounds suffered by the caster and any living allies in sight, and revives any downed co-op teammates at 20% of their maximum health without inflicting frailty. Casting this spell inflicts no permanent maximum health loss, but temporarily leaves the caster weakened and contaminated with residual magical energy.

It is powerful enough to cancel the effects of Death's Door, although doing so will briefly paralyse the caster.

spells.name: Freeze
spells.description: Freezes an adjacent creature, dealing damage that bypasses any armour the target may have. This may temporarily slow cold-blooded creatures.

spells.name: Ozocubu's Refrigeration
spells.description: Turns the air bitterly cold, freezing all other creatures in line of sight. This is less effective against creatures packed tightly together - those adjacent to their allies will be partly insulated from the cold, taking less damage.

spells.name: Sticky Flame
spells.description:
Unleashes a short-ranged spray of incendiary goo that clings to an adjacent creature and deals armour-ignoring fire damage over several turns. If the victim is allowed to move, it will put out the fire prematurely.

If the target is insubstantial, the liquid fire will fail to stick.

spells.name: Summon Ice Beast
spells.description: Calls forth a beast of ice to serve the caster. The strength of the beast depends on spell power.

spells.name: Ozocubu's Armour
spells.description: Envelops the caster's body in a protective layer of thick ice, granting a substantial bonus to armour as long as they remain in their current location. The ice will crack and fall away if the caster moves to a new position. The spell decreases in effectiveness in heavier armour, granting a lower bonus the higher the encumbrance rating of the caster's armour.

spells.name: Call Imp
spells.description: Calls forth a minor demon from the pits of Hell, equipped with a spear with which to jab at the caster's enemies. The quality of the imp's weaponry rises with spell power.

spells.name: Deflect Missiles
spells.description: Envelops the caster in a repulsion field, greatly increasing their evasion against all types of projectile - even while otherwise incapacitated.

spells.name: Berserker Rage
spells.description: Sends the user into a berserk rage. Going berserk temporarily increases health, speed, and damage dealt in melee. It will time out quickly outside of combat, but may be extended by multiple kills. While berserk, almost all actions other than movement and melee combat are prevented. When the rage expires, the user will be slowed and unable to berserk again for a short time.

spells.name: Dispel Undead
spells.description: Harms an adjacent undead creature greatly by interfering with the forces binding it together.

spells.name: Fulsome Distillation
spells.description:
Extracts alchemical humours from a corpse in the caster's line of sight, prioritising any corpse at the caster's feet and otherwise choosing the most potent corpse in view. The distilled potion is identified and drawn directly into the caster's inventory.

Venomous, undead, confusing, cold-blooded, or mutagenic creatures yield correspondingly noxious or volatile potions - ideal fuel for the Evaporate spell - though insufficient spellpower or weak corpses may yield only a flask of water.

spells.name: Poison Arrow
spells.description: Fires a magical arrow coated with the most vile and noxious toxin. Even those resistant to poison will be poisoned by it, and a small portion of its direct damage bypasses poison resistance.

spells.name: Regeneration
spells.description: Greatly accelerates the natural healing rate of the caster and any co-op teammates within a 4-tile radius for a short duration.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: Banishes a creature into the Abyss.

spells.name: Sting
spells.description: Conjures a jagged shard of crystallised toxins. The stinger's impact will always poison a susceptible target. Even resistant targets have a chance to be poisoned and immune monsters will still be damaged by the physical impact of the stinger.

spells.name: Sublimation of Blood
spells.description: Converts some of the caster's blood into magical energy. The process is painful but never directly lethal. The efficiency of the conversion increases with the spell's power.

spells.name: Tukima's Dance
spells.description:
Animates the weapon of a targeted foe, ripping it from their hands and causing it to attack them relentlessly. Once the target dies, the weapon will fall to the ground shortly thereafter.

Certain powerful named artefacts cannot be animated, and any properties that require skill in evocations will not be active.

spells.name: Hurl Damnation
spells.description: Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation. These unholy forces harm the victim and anyone adjacent, and are not affected by any means of protection, such as armour or resistances. However, certain creatures, usually those able to invoke damnation themselves, are entirely unscathed by damnation.

spells.name: Summon Demon
spells.description: Opens a gate to the realm of Pandemonium and draws forth one of its inhabitants to serve the caster for a time.

spells.name: Summon Greater Demon
spells.description: Calls forth one of the greater demons of Pandemonium to serve the caster.

spells.name: Iron Shot
spells.description: Hurls a large and heavy metal shot.

spells.name: Stone Arrow
spells.description: Fires a sharp spine of rock.

spells.name: Shock
spells.description: Throws a bouncing bolt of electricity. It bypasses half of defenders' armour.

spells.name: Swiftness
spells.description: Calls forth winds to greatly increase the caster's movement speed. After the effect ends, the caster's movements will be sluggish for a time.

spells.name: Agonising Touch
spells.description: Cuts the health of an adjacent creature in half. This damage is never directly lethal.

spells.name: Mindburst
spells.description: Launches a psychic attack. If it overcomes the victim's willpower, it 'blows their mind' in a violently literal fashion, dealing damage that bypasses their armour entirely. It is useless against mindless creatures.

spells.name: Death Channel
spells.description: Binds the souls of slain living, demonic and holy creatures, forcing their spectres to remain and fight for the caster for as long as the channel lasts.

spells.name: Symbol of Torment
spells.description: Calls on the powers of darkness to cause agonising injury to any living or holy thing in the caster's vicinity, cutting their health in half (partially resisted by negative energy resistance). This damage is never directly lethal.

spells.name: Throw Icicle
spells.description: Fires a shard of ice. Due to its strong impact and cutting edges, half of its damage bypasses cold resistance.

spells.name: Glaciate
spells.description: Conjures forth a mighty blast of ice. Creatures within its cone-shaped area of effect take damage, with higher damage being dealt to those close to the caster. Those hit by the blast are encased in ice, slowing their movement, and those killed by the blast may be frozen into solid blocks of ice. Half of its damage bypasses cold resistance.

spells.name: Airstrike
spells.description: Causes the air around a creature to twist itself into a whirling vortex of meteorological fury. It does more damage to targets surrounded by empty space.

spells.name: Shadow Creatures
spells.description: Creates replicas of creatures native to the caster's current location, weaving them from shadows and threads of Abyssal matter.

spells.name: Confusing Touch
spells.description: Enchants the caster's dominant hand with magical energy. This energy is released when the caster touches a monster, and may induce a state of confusion in the monster. The caster's attacks do no damage while attempting to touch a monster in this way.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.description: Allows the caster to travel a short distance through an adjacent rock wall and emerge again on the other side. This spell takes an unusally long time to cast, during which the caster will be unable to act, but also gain increased armour from their attunement to the rock.

spells.name: Ignite Poison
spells.description: Converts all nearby poison into liquid flame, burning poisoned creatures from within. It also turns clouds of poison and mephitic gases into flame. The caster is not affected directly.

spells.name: Sticks to Snakes
spells.description: Casts forth sticks and transforms them into snakes. Stronger casters will always create stronger snakes.

spells.name: Call Canine Familiar
spells.description:
Summons an inugami to the caster's aid. These mystical canines form a bond with their summoner, strengthening them in direct proportion with the caster's spellpower.

Recasting this spell while your familiar is nearby will imbue it with additional magic, mending some of its wounds, cleansing it of poison, and causing its next attack to strike more quickly and cleave adjacent foes.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.description: Summons and binds a powerful dragon to perform the caster's bidding. At high power it may summon particularly deadly varieties of dragon, or multiple lesser dragons at once.

spells.name: Ensorcelled Hibernation
spells.description: Lowers its target's metabolic rate, inducing hibernation. After awakening, the target will be unable to be put to sleep again for some time.

spells.name: Metabolic Englaciation
spells.description: Lowers the metabolic rate of every creature in the caster's vicinity, slowing all those who are not resistant to cold. Cold-blooded creatures will be affected much more strongly, and tougher creatures will be slowed for a shorter time.

spells.name: Silence
spells.description:
Eliminates all sound near the caster. This makes reading scrolls, casting spells, invoking divine abilities, or shouting impossible in the caster's vicinity.

Certain monsters have innate magical or special abilities which will still be usable while silenced.

The effect starts out with a radius depending on power, which will then shrink, eventually covering only the caster, before it times out.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: Causes an enormous burst of concussive force around the caster, dealing severe damage to all nearby creatures. It is especially effective against those made from ice, bone, or any wall-like substance (such as rock, metal or crystal), as well as those turned to stone by petrification. It is less effective against flying, gelatinous and insubstantial creatures. It may also destroy nearby walls.

spells.name: Dispersal
spells.description: Teleports away any creatures within a short distance of the caster. Any creature with the Will to resist will still be irresistibly blinked a shorter distance, and any monster it affects at all has a separate Will-based chance of being confused by the warping of space.

spells.name: Static Discharge
spells.description: Releases electrical charges against those next to the caster. These may arc to other adjacent creatures, or back to the caster, before eventually grounding out. It deals reduced damage when arcing to the caster, and the damage dealt bypasses half of defenders' armour.

spells.name: Corona
spells.description: Causes a halo of glowing light to surround and effectively outline a creature. This glow offsets the dark, musty atmosphere of the dungeon, and makes the affected creature appreciably easier to hit.

spells.name: Alistair's Intoxication
spells.description: Converts a small portion of the brain matter of those around you into alcohol, attempting to confuse all intelligent creatures within view (although poison-resistant creatures may resist the effects). The caster will experience vertigo briefly if they successfully make contact with other minds. It is frequently used as an icebreaker at wizard parties.

spells.name: Evaporate
spells.description:
Superheats a potion from the caster's inventory and hurls it at a target, where it shatters and releases a billowing cloud of alchemical fumes. The type of cloud created depends on the potion evaporated:

  * Poison: poison gas
  * Strong poison or cancellation: poison gas or noxious fumes
  * Slowing, moonshine, attraction, or empathy: noxious fumes
  * Decay or soul ambrosia: foul miasma
  * Mutation: mutagenic fog or random alchemical clouds
  * Berserk rage: roaring flames
  * Haste or brilliance: fire or steam
  * Might or enlightenment: freezing clouds or steam
  * Resistance or experience: fire, cold, or toxic clouds
  * Curing, heal wounds, ambrosia, concord, or transfusion: steam or blue smoke
  * Invisibility: opaque black smoke
  * Magic: purple smoke
  * Lignification: rain
  * Water or mist: scalding steam

spells.name: Lee's Rapid Deconstruction
spells.description:
Fragments a wall or a suitably brittle visible monster into an explosion of deadly shrapnel. It can be used on monsters made of ice, bone, or any wall-like substance, as well as those turned to stone by petrification. Its damage is strongly reduced by armour.

Targets made from rock, stone, ice or bone will cause a small explosion. Metal targets will cause a small but more damaging explosion, and targets made from crystal will cause a large and more damaging explosion.

spells.name: Sandblast
spells.description: Blasts a target with high-velocity rock shards. Gathering the rock from ambient grit is slow, making this spell take one-and-a-half times as long to cast as most. Its damage is strongly reduced by armour.

spells.name: Sculpt Simulacrum
spells.description:
Forms icy simulacra of an adjacent living, demonic, or holy creature. These fragile doppelgangers will take shape over a short period of time, eventually gaining the ability to move and attack the caster's enemies.

The good gods frown on this spell, as it works blood and ichor into unnatural facsimiles.

You can maintain up to 5 simulacra simultaneously.

spells.name: Conjure Ball Lightning
spells.description:
Creates a pack of ball lightnings, which seek out the nearest enemy before exploding in a huge blast of electricity. The damage dealt bypasses half of defenders' armour. Casters are advised to use caution; the lightning is not mindful of what it may hit.

The magic which keeps ball lightnings cohesive has limited range, so they may dissipate harmlessly if allowed to drift too far away from their caster before exploding.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Releases a massive electrical discharge that arcs to the creature nearest the caster and then outward from it. The further it travels, the less damage it does. Secondary arcs have limited range and do little damage to the caster. The spell bypasses half of defenders' armour and resistance to electricity.

spells.name: Portal Projectile
spells.description: Teleports a fired or thrown missile at a targeted enemy.

spells.name: Monstrous Menagerie
spells.description: Summons a powerful exotic creature to the caster's aid: either a manticore, a lindwurm, or a sphinx marauder.

spells.name: Petrify
spells.description: Petrifies a targeted creature and up to two other foes in a chain. Those which do not muster the Will to resist are briefly slowed, and then turned to stone. Until they return to flesh, they are unable to act, but also take half damage. The spell's power is lessened against secondary targets.

spells.name: Passage of Golubria
spells.description: Opens two gateways (one always near the caster), which allow instantaneous transport to random other open gateways to any creature entering them. There is no limit to the number of gateways that can be open at one time. However, gateways close a short time after being opened, or immediately once entered.

spells.name: Call Down Damnation
spells.description: Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation, with no direct line of fire required. These unholy forces harm the victim and anyone adjacent, and are not affected by any means of protection, such as armour or resistances. However, certain creatures, usually those able to invoke damnation themselves, are entirely unscathed by damnation.

spells.name: Brain Bite
spells.description: Drains a small amount of a visible enemy's mind and a proportion of their magic, with no direct line of fire required. If the enemy has near-emptied magic reserves, they will take doubled damage.

spells.name: Steam Ball
spells.description: Throws a ball of hot steam towards a targeted creature.

spells.name: Ufetubi Swarm
spells.description: Summons a group of berserk ufetubi; irksome minor demons who will rapidly swarm and surround the caster's enemies.

spells.name: Summon Sin Beast
spells.description: Summons a deadly sin beast.

spells.name: Bolt of Devastation
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of grief and heartache that cuts its victims' willpower in half.

spells.name: Spit Poison
spells.description: Spits poison at a targeted creature.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.description: Summons multiple undead monsters, creating various ghosts, vampires, wraiths and other lesser undead.

spells.name: Cantrip
spells.description: Casts one of a number of minor spells, aimed at trying to bolster the caster's morale. They have no noticeable effect.

spells.name: Quicksilver Bolt
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of dispelling energy at a targeted creature, possibly removing some of its enchantments.

spells.name: Metal Splinters
spells.description: Fires a burst of metal splinters. Its damage is strongly reduced by armour.

spells.name: Miasma Breath
spells.description: Creates a large cloud of foul pestilence, poisoning and sometimes slowing any living creatures it touches.

spells.name: Summon Drakes
spells.description: Summons multiple drakes and lindwurms.

spells.name: Blink Other
spells.description: Randomly translocates a targeted enemy a short distance. It cannot be resisted by willpower.

spells.name: Summon Mushrooms
spells.description: Summons wandering mushrooms and deathcaps next to a targeted creature.

spells.name: Spit Acid
spells.description: Spits acid at a targeted creature.

spells.name: Caustic Breath
spells.description: Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any unoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.

spells.name: Fire Breath
spells.description: Breathes a blast of fire at a targeted creature.

spells.name: Cold Breath
spells.description: Exhales a focused blast of icy-cold air.

spells.name: Summon Water Elementals
spells.description: Summons one or more water elementals.

spells.name: Porkalator
spells.description: Transforms the target into a pig. The target moves swiftly but cannot cast spells. The caster's demise will cause the transformation to end.

spells.name: Spawn Tentacles
spells.description: Extends large tentacles to attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Summon Eyeballs
spells.description: Summons multiple floating eyeballs that may be able to vitrify, polymorph, confuse, mutate or disintegrate.

spells.name: Haste Other
spells.description: Speeds the actions of a nearby ally.

spells.name: Summon Fire Elementals
spells.description: Summons one or more fire elementals.

spells.name: Summon Earth Elementals
spells.description: Summons one or more earth elementals.

spells.name: Summon Air Elementals
spells.description: Summons one or more air elementals.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Puts a targeted creature to sleep. Taking damage will typically wake the target, and loud sounds can potentially do so as well.

spells.name: Blink Other Close
spells.description: Translocates a targeted enemy a short distance towards the caster. It cannot be resisted by willpower.

spells.name: Blink Close
spells.description: Translocates the caster a short distance towards a targeted enemy.

spells.name: Blink Range
spells.description: Translocates the caster to a location further away from a targeted enemy, but still within sight of the target.

spells.name: Blink Away
spells.description: Translocates the caster to a location further away from a targeted enemy.

spells.name: Mara Summon
spells.description: Weaves illusions of the caster. Such illusions have the same physical prowess as the original, and can cast the same spells.

spells.name: Summon Illusion
spells.description: Summons a temporary mirror image of an enemy. Such a copy has the same physical prowess as the original, and can cast the same spells.

spells.name: Primal Wave
spells.description: Conjures a torrent of water that may knock back the target, and creates a pool of shallow water for a short duration.

spells.name: Call Tide
spells.description: Allows the caster to affect the tidal phase of all water within a large distance. Soon after calling it, the waters on the whole level will reach high tide. Waters near the caster will reach even higher levels than they would normally.

spells.name: Orb of Destruction
spells.description:
Conjures an orb made of pure destructive magic. Compared to most other projectiles, these orbs travel at a relatively slow pace. The orbs home onto their targets, yet because of their huge inertia, especially agile opponents may be able to outmanoeuvre them. The orbs need some time to stabilise, and a nascent orb will deal reduced damage.

Residents of the dungeon are able to maintain the orb until it impacts a target, but when cast by you the orb will dissipate upon leaving your line of sight.

spells.name: Ink Cloud
spells.description: Releases a thick cloud of ink to obscure vision.

spells.name: Might
spells.description: Significantly increases the caster's damage in melee.

spells.name: Awaken Forest
spells.description: Gives some limited motility to nearby trees, allowing them to sway their branches and shift their roots. Such enchanted trees will lash at any adjacent enemy.

spells.name: Druid's Call
spells.description: Recalls woodland creatures from elsewhere on the same level.

spells.name: Vanquished Vanguard
spells.description:
Calls out to the lingering souls of orcs who died in earlier ages, and, for a brief moment, gives them purpose in battle once again.

More anchored to their past lives than most spectrals, they wield polearms with living skill, and will encircle their quarry with cold efficiency.

spells.name: Summon Holies
spells.description: Calls forth divine warriors to aid the caster.

spells.name: Heal Other
spells.description: Heals a nearby ally.

spells.name: Holy Flames
spells.description: Traps an enemy in a ring of blessed flame. These flames are especially dangerous to undead and demonic creatures, and have no effect on holy creatures.

spells.name: Holy Breath
spells.description: Exhales a large cloud of blessed flame, shining with the glory of the good gods. These flames are especially dangerous to undead and demonic creatures, and have no effect on holy creatures.

spells.name: Trog's Hand
spells.description: Invokes a powerful regeneration ability which stacks with all other sources and is effective even on those who would not otherwise be able to regenerate. It also fortifies the user's willpower, protecting against many magical effects.

spells.name: Brothers in Arms
spells.description:
Summons huge angry allies to wreak havoc.

The strength of the summoned allies increases with the user's experience level.

spells.name: Injury Mirror
spells.description: Reflects damage taken for a short duration, hurting attackers whenever the caster takes any damage. After the duration wears off, the caster cannot cast this spell again for a short while.

spells.name: Drain Life
spells.description: Drains the life force from all nearby enemies, healing the user proportional to the damage dealt.

spells.name: Malign Gateway
spells.description: Tears a gash in reality, creating a self-sustained but temporary portal to an unknown, tainted otherworld. It requires open space to succeed. After a short time, a powerful clawed tentacle will reach through the portal, remaining bound to the caster's will for a duration depending on power. With the portal's expiry, the tentacle will be severed and turn on the caster. The duration of the portal increases with spell power.

spells.name: Noxious Cloud
spells.description: Creates a large cloud of noxious fumes, which may cause confusion.

spells.name: Polar Vortex
spells.description: Turns the air around the caster into a freezing vortex, doing tremendous damage to everyone caught in it that can only be half-mitigated by resistance to cold. Those affected will also be swept up into the air and tossed around. Only the eye of the storm is a safe place, and it follows the caster. The spell's effectiveness is greatly diminished in closed areas. After the vortex fades, it cannot be called forth again for a short time.

spells.name: Pyre Arrow
spells.description:
Launches a glob of liquid fire that clings to a targeted creature, dealing armour-ignoring fire damage over multiple turns. The victim can put the fire out much more quickly by moving.

If the target is insubstantial, the liquid fire will fail to stick.

spells.name: Leda's Liquefaction
spells.description:
Liquefies the ground around the caster, making it difficult to move through. Any movement through liquefied ground will be slowed, and creatures stuck in the liquefied ground will be unable to fly. Attempts to attack the caster in melee may fail.

The effect starts out with a radius depending on power, which will then shrink, eventually covering only the caster, before it times out. Maintaining the connection to the ground slows the caster's movement, even if they are flying.

spells.name: Summon Hydra
spells.description: Summons a many-headed hydra to fight alongside the caster for a short time. Spell power determines the number of heads.

spells.name: Mesmerise
spells.description:
Attempts to entrance all enemies in sight. Adventurers who fail to resist will become unable to move away from the caster, while other creatures will become dazed outright.

Leaving the caster's line of sight will end the movement-controlling effect.

spells.name: Hellfire Court
spells.description: Summons demons of flame and damnation.

spells.name: Shroud of Golubria
spells.description: Wraps the caster and any adjacent co-op teammates in a tenuous distortion of space that deflects a portion of incoming melee and ranged attacks before unravelling.

spells.name: Inner Flame
spells.description: Fills an enemy with an intense fire. This fire is released any time the target is hit, and explosively released upon death. The size of the explosion caused is dependent on the size of the target.

spells.name: Petrifying Cloud
spells.description: Exhales calcifying dust, which petrifies anyone affected for longer than a brief moment.

spells.name: Ensnare
spells.description: Shoots a stream of webbing at a creature, ensnaring the target in a sticky web.

spells.name: Thunderbolt
spells.description: Creates a penetrating arc of electricity.

spells.name: Summon Minor Demon
spells.description: Summons between one and three minor (rank 5) demons.

spells.name: Disjunction
spells.description: Destabilises the space in a sphere around the caster for a while, causing anyone nearby to blink away from the caster. The chance of blinking depends on the distance from the caster, being nearly certain when directly adjacent.

spells.name: Chaos Breath
spells.description: Exhales a large cloud of fumes filled with the very essence of chaos.

spells.name: Iskenderun's Battlesphere
spells.description:
Conjures a small globe of destructive energy. Each time its creator casts a offensive spell, the battlesphere will also fire an unerring volley of energy at the most injured nearby foe it can reach.

The battlesphere's creator can freely fire through its position without harming it.

spells.name: Fulminant Prism
spells.description: Conjures a shining prism of an unstable soft gold alloy. This is useless as legal tender, however, as it will unfortunately violently explode with arcane force after a short duration. If destroyed prematurely, its blast will be much weaker.

spells.name: Gloom
spells.description:
Emits a wave of pernicious gloom which attempts to smother the light around nearby creatures. Any living, demonic or holy creature caught in the effect may briefly lose their eyesight and be left stumbling blindly.

Willpower is useless against this spell, but stronger creatures may still shrug off its effects.

spells.name: Force Lance
spells.description: Fires a shaft of concussive force. If the impact deals damage, it may knock the target back. If this knockback causes the target to hit a wall or another creature, both will take additional damage.

spells.name: Malmutate
spells.description: Bestows a mutation on a target. The mutation is almost always harmful. It cannot affect artificial beings, and the undead will decompose if affected.

spells.name: Might Other
spells.description: Significantly increases a nearby ally's damage dealt in melee.

spells.name: Sentinel's Mark
spells.description: Bestows a strong beacon upon a targeted creature. It announces the presence and location of the marked creature to everyone on the same level.

spells.name: Word of Recall
spells.description: Recalls intelligent allies from elsewhere on the same level to the caster, after a short delay.

spells.name: Injury Bond
spells.description: Binds the caster to nearby allies, reducing all damage they take by half in exchange for suffering half of the prevented damage themselves.

spells.name: Spectral Cloud
spells.description: Creates a cloud of spectral mist, dealing minor damage to all creatures other than the undead. Dangerous but short-lived spectral undead creatures will coalesce from the mist over time.

spells.name: Ghostly Fireball
spells.description: Hurls an exploding ball of negative energy which drains any living creature it engulfs.

spells.name: Call Lost Souls
spells.description: Summons some necromantic spectres. These lost souls can enter the bodies of more powerful undead to bring them back from brink of demise, or turn dying living creatures into ghostly versions of themselves.

spells.name: Dimension Anchor
spells.description: Blocks any translocations attempted by the affected target, be they voluntary or not. This includes even some cross-plane effects, although notably not Banishment.

spells.name: Blink Allies Encircling
spells.description: Translocates a number of allies in the caster's sight to surround a targeted enemy.

spells.name: Awaken Vines
spells.description: Causes vines to grow from the ground. The vines will reach out and grab interlopers, dragging them towards any nearby trees.

spells.name: Volley of Thorns
spells.description: Launches a small hail of sharp thorns.

spells.name: Cage of Brambles
spells.description: Causes walls of thorny brambles to grow rapidly in a ring around all nearby enemies. The caster's allies may fire projectiles through these briars without hinderance, but anyone else may find removing them rather painful.

spells.name: Waterstrike
spells.description: Causes the water around or under the target to violently swirl, dealing damage. It can affect targets standing in or flying above water.

spells.name: Wind Blast
spells.description: Causes a strong gust of wind, pushing away creatures and clouds in a cone. If this causes a creature to collide with something, it will take damage.

spells.name: Strip Willpower
spells.description: Greatly reduces the target's willpower, making them more vulnerable to a variety of magical effects.

spells.name: Fugue of the Fallen
spells.description:
Calls out to the lingering remnants of the long dead. While active, each non-summoned enemy the caster or their allies slays attracts more vengeful souls into the weapons of the caster and any co-op teammates in sight, temporarily enhancing their melee and ranged effectiveness. When this bonus reaches its maximum, every hit will unleash a glimmer of the dead's suffering, causing pain damage to each other foe adjacent to your target.

Recasting this spell will release your grip on the souls you've attracted, resetting any bonus you've accumulated, and the cacophonous wailing of the dead may attract unwanted attention even while you maintain it.

spells.name: Song of Slaying
spells.description: Chants a bloody battle-hymn that empowers the caster and any co-op teammates in sight. Each enemy slain while the song is active increases the accuracy and damage of their melee and ranged attacks (up to +9), at the cost of continual noise.

spells.name: Summon Vermin
spells.description: Summons multiple rats, spiders, worms, and frogs.

spells.name: Malign Offering
spells.description: Drains life from an enemy, healing nearby allies in the process.

spells.name: Searing Ray
spells.description: Fires a continuous piercing ray of arcane energy from the caster's hands. So long as the caster maintains focus upon the spell and supplies it with magical power (by waiting in place and not taking any other actions), the ray will follow the caster's target if it should move.

spells.name: Discord
spells.description: Drives nearby creatures into an wild frenzy, causing them to mercilessly attack anything and everything nearby with great strength and speed.

spells.name: Blinkbolt
spells.description: Transforms the caster into a penetrating lightning bolt, and translocates the caster to the bolt's destination.

spells.name: Invisibility Other
spells.description: Turns a nearby ally invisible.

spells.name: Virulence
spells.description: Makes a targeted creature more vulnerable to poison.

spells.name: Orb of Electricity
spells.description: Hurls a crackling orb of electrical energy, creating a huge explosion on impact. Its damage bypasses half of defenders' armour.

spells.name: Flash Freeze
spells.description: Freezes the air around a target, causing significant harm and slowing the target's movement for a short time. Half of its damage bypasses cold resistance.

spells.name: Legendary Destruction
spells.description: Conjures two explosive magical effects in instant succession. The effects can be any mix of Fireball, Iceblast, and Ghostly Fireball.

spells.name: Forceful Invitation
spells.description: Summons some creatures from one of the Snake Pit, the Spider Nest, the Swamp, the Shoals, the Elven Halls, the Vaults, or the Crypt; the specific branch varies with the caster.

spells.name: Plane Rend
spells.description: Summons some of the greater threats from one of the Pits of Slime, the Elven Halls, the Vaults, the Crypt, the Tomb of Ancients, or the Realm of Zot; the specific branch varies with each cast of the spell.

spells.name: Chain of Chaos
spells.description: Creates an arc of pure chaos, striking nearby creatures with unpredictable effects. The arc can touch upon the caster without harming them.

spells.name: Call of Chaos
spells.description: Calls upon the powers of chaos to empower nearby allies, granting them haste, might, doubled vigour, or improved resistances. The chaotic magic may occasionally backfire and cause allies to instead lose their willpower or be berserked, polymorphed, or filled with inner flame.

spells.name: Sign of Ruin
spells.description: Inflicts the sign of ruin upon a group of enemies, condemning their bodies to inexorable decay and collapse. Whenever anything bearing this sign receives damage from a melee attack, they will suffer heavy draining and may additionally become either slow, weak, or blind.

spells.name: Sap Magic
spells.description: Taints a targeted creature's ability to cast spells. Casting a spell while afflicted with this condition causes the target to lose access to their magic, briefly preventing them from casting any further spells.

spells.name: Major Destruction
spells.description: Shoots a random harmful beam or explosion at the targeted creature.

spells.name: Blink Allies Away
spells.description: Blinks allies in sight of the caster away from a nearby enemy.

spells.name: Shadow Shard
spells.description: Fires a shard of hardened shadow at a single enemy.

spells.name: Shadow Beam
spells.description: Fires a penetrating beam of shadow.

spells.name: Rebounding Chill
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of energetic cold that can bounce off walls to hit targets twice.

spells.name: Summon Forest
spells.description: Forcefully intersects a forested plane with this world. It requires open space to succeed. While the spell holds, a spirit of the forest will be called forth, and the trees of the forest will be awakened to deal damage to nearby enemies. Spell power increases the duration, size, and thickness of the intersected plane; as well as the strength of the spirit.

spells.name: Forge Lightning Spire
spells.description: Constructs an immobile lightning spire at a nearby location. This spire irregularly discharges bolts of electricity at the caster's foes, prioritizing whichever of them is most distant from it.

spells.name: Forge Blazeheart Golem
spells.description:
Constructs a shell of slag iron around a volatile elemental spark. It is capable of raining down powerful blows on its creator's adversaries - so powerful that the golem itself is often damaged by their impact.

Only tenuously independent of its creator's magic, the flames within it will rapidly go dormant if the two ever leave each other's side. If its shell is destroyed while the golem is still active, its exposed core will violently detonate a moment later.

It gains greater explosive damage at higher power.

spells.name: Cloud Cone
spells.description: Conjures a wide cone of dense, hazardous clouds at a targeted distance.

spells.name: Dragon's Call
spells.description: Issues a powerful call to a draconic realm, beckoning forth dragon after dragon to engage the summoner's enemies. The spell is taxing to maintain, and each new dragon which answers the call will further drain the summoner's magical reserves. After the call ends, it cannot be issued again for a short time. The duration of the call and the species of dragons called depend on spell power.

spells.name: Spellspark Servitor
spells.description:
Constructs a metallic servant with a spark of the caster's own arcane knowledge at its core. This spark allows the servitor to unleash some of the destructive spells known to its creator, though the strongest and most volatile of magics cannot be imbued in this fashion. The strength of the servitor increases with spell power.

(While you know this spell, you may choose which of your eligible spells it will cast with the Imbue Servitor ability.)

spells.name: Summon Mana Viper
spells.description: Summons a violet-scaled serpent whose bite can swiftly drain the magical reserves of nearly any foe. At higher power, the antimagic properties of the viper's bite grow even stronger.

spells.name: Phantom Mirror
spells.description: Creates a phantom copy of a creature. The copy will be somewhat fragile, but otherwise almost indistinguishable from the original.

spells.name: Corrosive Bolt
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of highly-corrosive acid.

spells.name: Summon Emperor Scorpions
spells.description: Summons multiple noble and monstrous emperor scorpions.

spells.name: Irradiate
spells.description: Transmutes an ultra-thin layer of the caster's skin (or equivalent) directly into pure magical energy, blasting adjacent creatures. It may heavily deform its victims, weakening them and reducing their armour. The caster is not left entirely unaffected; some of the magic lingers, enough to leave them dangerously contaminated after a few castings.

spells.name: Spit Lava
spells.description: Spits lava at a targeted creature. Half of its damage bypasses fire resistance.

spells.name: Electrical Bolt
spells.description: Throws a penetrating bolt of electricity at the target, with high accuracy.

spells.name: Flaming Cloud
spells.description: Conjures up a large cloud of roaring flames.

spells.name: Throw Barbs
spells.description: Fires a volley of barbs at the target, skewering them and making movement painful.

spells.name: Battlecry
spells.description: Inspires nearby allies of the caster to fight more aggressively, increasing the strength of their blows.

spells.name: Warning Cry
spells.description: Generates a loud noise, alerting nearby enemies.

spells.name: Seal Doors
spells.description: Imparts seals on nearby doors and stairs, preventing those not allied with the caster from traversing them.

spells.name: Flay
spells.description: Opens painful illusionary wounds on the target's body, which disappear after a short time or on the death of the caster. This cannot kill directly, and is ineffective against unnatural targets.

spells.name: Berserk Other
spells.description: Causes a nearby ally to fly into a berserk rage. Going berserk temporarily increases health, speed, and damage dealt in melee.

spells.name: Corrupting Pulse
spells.description: Instills a corruption within all visible targets, temporarily mutating their bodies in an adverse fashion. It cannot affect artificial beings, and the undead will decompose if affected.

spells.name: Siren Song
spells.description:
Sings a haunting song that mesmerises nearby listeners. Adventurers who fail to resist will become unable to move away from the singer, while other creatures will become dazed outright.

Leaving the caster's line of sight will end the movement-controlling effect.

spells.name: Avatar Song
spells.description:
Sings a powerfully haunting song. Adventurers who fail to resist will become unable to move away from the singer (and will sometimes be drawn closer involuntarily), while other creatures will become dazed outright.

In addition, it may call forth drowned souls from any nearby bodies of deep water.

Leaving the caster's line of sight will end the movement-controlling effect.

spells.name: Paralysis Gaze
spells.description: Irresistibly prevents a creature from taking any action for a short time, requiring multiple charges but not line of fire.

spells.name: Confusion Gaze
spells.description: Induces a state of bewilderment and confusion in a creature's mind, with no direct line of fire required.

spells.name: Antimagic Gaze
spells.description: Causes the target's magic to leak into the air, as though they were hit by an antimagic weapon, with no direct line of fire required.

spells.name: Death Rattle
spells.description: Exhales the essence of the dying, creating clouds of noxious miasma.

spells.name: Summon Scarabs
spells.description: Calls forth a swarm of death scarabs.

spells.name: Searing Breath
spells.description: Breathes a blast of fire at a targeted creature, leaving a cloud of flames at the endpoint.

spells.name: Glacial Breath
spells.description: Exhales a powerful wave of frost which encases anything it kills in a solid block of durable ice.

spells.name: Scattershot
spells.description: Blasts a wide cone of metallic shrapnel at close range, tearing through foes with devastating physical force.

spells.name: Cleansing Flame
spells.description: Invokes a huge blast of divine fury centered on the user, severely damaging undead and demons and dealing damage to all other hostile creatures.

spells.name: Throw Ally
spells.description: Throws a nearby ally at the monster's foe, doing minimal damage and landing the thrown monster nearby.

spells.name: Entropic Weave
spells.description: Corrodes the target, with no direct line of fire required.

spells.name: Summon Executioners
spells.description: Summons multiple Executioners to tear apart foes of the caster.

spells.name: Yara's Violent Unravelling
spells.description: If cast upon a creature already blessed (or cursed) with magical enchantments, those enchantments will be torn apart, transforming into a spray of destructive mutagenic radiation. The victim and anyone adjacent will be blasted and heavily deformed, weakening them and reducing their armour. Summoned creatures are particularly vulnerable, as the enchantments binding them to this plane will unravel and cause them to be dismissed immediately.

spells.name: Oblivion Howl
spells.description: Unleashes a piercing howl that catches and echoes in victims' minds. While those echoes linger, nightmarish creatures will hear and track them to their source. It can only be used once by a given creature.

spells.name: Prayer of Brilliance
spells.description: Empowers the magic of nearby wizard allies of the caster, allowing them to cast their magic more powerfully and more often.

spells.name: Iceblast
spells.description: Fires a large mass of ice, which explodes on impact. Half of its damage bypasses cold resistance.

spells.name: Slug Dart
spells.description: Fires a sharp dart of hardened chitin.

spells.name: Fleetfoot
spells.description: Calls forth winds to increase the caster's movement speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Infernal Servant
spells.description: Summons a major demon.

spells.name: Bind Souls
spells.description: Bestows an enchantment on other nearby living creatures that causes them to rise as simulacra after being slain.

spells.name: Infestation
spells.description: Calls forth a plague of scarabs, infesting affected creatures for a duration depending on power and causing death scarabs to grow and burst from them upon death.

spells.name: Still Winds
spells.description: Brings the air into unnatural stillness across a huge area, preventing anything short of a polar vortex from breaking the calm. The effect takes concentration to maintain, and only lasts a short time; if the caster is killed, clouds will begin to form again as normal.

spells.name: Resonance Strike
spells.description: Calls a surge of power from the earth, striking an enemy within the caster's sight. The spell cascades through nearby constructs, growing in strength with each one standing near the target.

spells.name: Ghostly Sacrifice
spells.description: Uses an ally's motivating essence to create a blast of negative energy, draining any living creature it engulfs. The being used to fuel the spell, no matter whether living or construct, is consumed and unmade in the process.

spells.name: Dream Dust
spells.description: Overwhelms the target with soporific dream dust, putting them to sleep with an enchanting visual display. Additional dream sheep will increase the strength and duration of this effect.

spells.name: Lesser Beckoning
spells.description: Beckons the target forward, attempting to place them adjacent to the caster.

spells.name: Upheaval
spells.description: Calls on the forces of nature to blast a small area with magma, ice, wind, or rubble.

spells.name: Mercury Arrow
spells.description:
Conjures an arrow of elemental mercury which deals direct poison damage to whatever it hits and may also weaken their melee attacks for a short while.

The physical force of the arrow inflicts a small amount of damage even to those immune to poison, and the weakening effect can splash to adjacent targets and ignores poison resistance altogether.

spells.name: Ignition
spells.description: All foes in the caster's surroundings are engulfed in balls of fire. The caster and their allies are protected from the fire and will never be harmed by this spell.

spells.name: Borgnjor's Vile Clutch
spells.description: Calls forth hands from corpses interred beneath the dungeon floor long ago. Enemies caught in the area will be held in place and constricted until they break free.

spells.name: Harpoon Shot
spells.description: Fires a long and flexible barbed mass. The ensnared victim will either be pulled adjacent to the caster or collide with anything blocking the way.

spells.name: Grasping Roots
spells.description: Calls giant grasping roots from deep underground that hold and constrict their victim. The roots will retreat if the victim breaks free or if the caller moves out of view.

spells.name: Throw Klown Pie
spells.description: Throws a harmful yet strangely delicious pie that can inflict its victim with a number of irresistible and debilitating temporary effects. These include inducing vertigo, silence, fire vulnerability, fragility, blindness, or an aversion to drinking potions.

spells.name: Sporulate
spells.description: Releases a fast, gas-filled floating spore. After seeking out its foe, the spore will explode, damaging anything caught in the blast and further confusing living creatures.

spells.name: Starburst
spells.description: Releases penetrating bolts of fire from the caster in every direction.

spells.name: Foxfire
spells.description: Conjures two balls of burning swamp gas adjacent to the caster. The balls will rapidly seek the nearest monster and burn them. They will dissipate harmlessly if unable to reach a target or if the caster swaps places with them.

spells.name: Hailstorm
spells.description: Conjures a cannonade of hail, battering nearby creatures that fail to dodge. The eye of the storm is wide enough that monsters adjacent to the caster are unaffected. Due to the strong impact and cutting edges, half of its damage bypasses cold resistance.

spells.name: Eringya's Noxious Bog
spells.description: Causes the caster to release a torrent of sludge that transforms nearby areas into a toxic bog. The sludge damages and poisons all monsters, even those resistant to poison. The bog cannot form on areas adjacent to multiple solid features, nor on areas that lack solid floor, like deep water or lava. The transformation is temporary and cannot be sustained out of the caster's sight. Spellpower will increase how long the bog lingers.

spells.name: Agony
spells.description: Cuts the health of a target creature in half. This damage is never directly lethal.

spells.name: Dispel Undead Range
spells.description: Harms an undead creature greatly by interfering with the forces binding it together.

spells.name: Frozen Ramparts
spells.description:
Encases surrounding walls with ice for a short time. Foes that wander near the icy walls will be damaged, and this may temporarily slow cold-blooded creatures. Each victim is only ever affected by one icy wall at a time.

The ice will crack and fall away if the caster moves to a new position.

spells.name: Maxwell's Capacitive Coupling
spells.description: Gradually builds up electric charge in the caster, so long as they maintain focus (by waiting in place and not taking any other actions). When a threshold is reached, the charge couples with the nearest visible foe, vaporising them instantly. Higher spell power will allow the caster to accumulate charge more rapidly. The spell requires a visible target to begin accumulating charge, though a different foe may be affected when the charge is released.

spells.name: Roll
spells.description: Roll into a ball, granting the boulder beetle tremendous speed as well as double melee damage. The roll may only be performed when at distance from a foe, and the beetle will always unroll after an attempted roll attack.

spells.name: Splinterspray
spells.description: Fires a burst of wooden splinters. Its damage is strongly reduced by armour.

spells.name: Woodweal
spells.description: Draws on the vitality of leaf and bark to heal a large amount of damage. Cannot be cast without a tree adjacent.

spells.name: Hurl Sludge
spells.description: Conjures a focused blast of highly toxic sludge, poisoning the victim and drenching their surroundings. The sludge damages and poisons all monsters, even those resistant to poison.

spells.name: Marshlight
spells.description: Conjures two balls of burning swamp gas adjacent to the caster. The balls will rapidly seek the nearest monster and burn them. Wizards attempted to copy this with the spell 'Foxfire', but their version is much less powerful.

spells.name: Summon Tzitzimitl
spells.description: Summons a tzitzimitl, a demon of disease and despair.

spells.name: Summon Hell Sentinel
spells.description: Summons a Hell Sentinel, a nightmarish edifice of animated hate.

spells.name: Awaken Armour
spells.description:
Draws upon the memory of your worn armour to manifest an echo of it that fights alongside you. This echo moves slowly, but the power of its blows increases dramatically with the weight of the armour used to form it. It possesses all the defensive properties of the armour itself.

Spellpower increases its durability.

spells.name: Manifold Assault
spells.description:
Warps space into paradoxical configurations to strike many visible foes with one melee attack. Power increases the number of foes attacked with one cast, though unarmed attacks strike only half as many targets at once, as additional care must be taken when warping one's own limbs.

The time taken for the attack is exactly the same as a normal melee attack. Attacks performed this way never miss, but the exact spot struck cannot be controlled precisely, making them unable to do extra damage against unsuspecting foes.

spells.name: Creeping Frost
spells.description: Calls forth freezing cold from the walls. Any enemies of the caster standing next to the walls will be frozen and will find their movements slowed. Cold resistance will reduce damage, but not prevent the freezing effect.

spells.name: Call Down Lightning
spells.description: Blasts a targeted enemy with lightning, with no direct line of fire required. The targeting magics need distance to function, so enemies that are adjacent or nearly adjacent cannot be struck by this.

spells.name: Concentrate Venom
spells.description: Intensifies the natural venom of the target monster. Poisonous bites and spit become intense enough to slow and asphyxiate.

spells.name: Eruption
spells.description: Splits the earth to draw up a localised, short-lived volcano under the target.

spells.name: Pyroclastic Surge
spells.description: Draws searing flames from lava. Any enemies of the caster standing next to or above lava will be burned.

spells.name: Weakening Gaze
spells.description: Irresistibly weakens a creature's melee attacks for a period of time, requiring line of sight but not line of fire.

spells.name: Stunning Burst
spells.description: Fires a weak electrical burst which, on impact, causes very brief paralysis. Willpower is of no use against this effect, but resistance to electricity can sometimes prevent it.

spells.name: Corrupt
spells.description: Unleashes Abyssal energies in the immediate vicinity. This changes the appearance of the affected area and temporarily summons creatures from the Abyss. This cannot be used in the Abyss itself.

spells.name: Summon Cactus Giant
spells.description: Summons a warrior from a particularly prickly tribe. Foes that strike these giants in melee are in for a painful surprise! When cast at a higher power, older, more robust warriors will answer the call.

spells.name: Stoke Flames
spells.description: Adds malice to hellish fires, binding it with flame into a creeping inferno.

spells.name: Seracfall
spells.description: Violently collapses a nearby simulacrum into a large mass of ice, which explodes on impact. The ice affects even cold-resistant creatures somewhat, due to the strong impact and cutting edges.

spells.name: Scorch
spells.description: Scorches a random visible foe. Those injured by this have their resistance to fire burned away for a short time.

spells.name: Flame Wave
spells.description: Blasts the caster's surroundings with a wave of fire. If the caster maintains focus and supplies the spell with magical power (by waiting in place and not taking any other actions), more and larger flame waves will radiate outward.

spells.name: Conjure Living Spells
spells.description: Creates several living, autonomous spells, which cast themselves at the first foe to enter their range. Once cast, they dissipate.

spells.name: Enfeeble
spells.description: Overwhelms an enemy with malignant energies, irresistibly weakening their melee attacks and reducing the power of their spells. It will additionally daze and blind any foe that fails to resist the full force of the curse - even those without visual senses!

spells.name: Summon Spiders
spells.description: Summons one or more spiders.

spells.name: Anguish
spells.description: Afflicts nearby foes with supernatural anguish, causing all damage they deal to rebound on them for the duration of the effect. Strong-willed foes can resist the necromantic visions of pain and suffering, and mindless creatures are unaffected.

spells.name: Sheza's Dance
spells.description: Summons weapons from far and wide - a dagger newly forged, a sword long-rusted in a moldering tomb, an axe still steaming with the blood of its victim - animating them and sending them out to attack.

spells.name: Soul Splinter
spells.description:
Attempts to force a tiny fragment of a living, holy, or demonic being's soul to take leave of their body and manifest as a soul wisp. This wisp is nominally under the necromancer's control, but will focus its attacks foremost on the creature it was created from, instinctually trying to return to its proper home once more. The victim will be weakened until the wisp reverts to where it belongs.

Wisps created from more powerful souls have more damaging attacks, but are always fragile.

spells.name: Bolt of Light
spells.description: Fires a pentrating ray of searing light, which may blind any living, demonic, or holy creature it strikes.

spells.name: Hunting Call
spells.description: Inspires nearby allies to quicken their movement.

spells.name: Fastroot
spells.description: Fires a magical seed, entangling victims in quick-growing tree roots. Those entangled will be painfully constricted until they escape or the roots wither away. The roots will only sprout from solid ground.

spells.name: Volatile Blastmotes
spells.description: Brings forth a cloud of volatile blastmotes around the caster. These explode on contact with open flame or with creatures - including any caster foolish enough to linger in them! The explosion is concussive, knocking adjacent creatures away. Damage done rises with the spell's power.

spells.name: Cigotuvi's Putrefaction
spells.description:
Magically accelerates the decay of damaged living tissue, causing great clouds of miasma to billow forth from a targeted victim's wounds over several turns which may slow and heavily poison any living creature who stands in them. Air currents will prevent this pestilence from forming wherever the caster is standing, but they are not otherwise protected from its effects.
