This spell may only be cast on a living creature who is at least heavily wounded, and channelling such necrotic energies will leave the caster's own health temporarily drained (though spellpower will reduce the intensity of this side-effect).

spells.name: Arcjolt
spells.description: Sends a wave of electricity through everything adjacent or near-adjacent to the caster. The electricity continues to arc through everything in a connected chain, though the caster themself is unaffected. The damage dealt bypasses half of defenders' armour.

spells.name: Kiss of Death
spells.description: Conjures forth a fragment of the caster's essence and twists it into a fragment of death, painfully draining the victim. The caster, too, will find their health reduced, until they gain enough experience to recover.

spells.name: Momentum Strike
spells.description: Blasts a target with energy borrowed from the caster's own future movement. For a short time afterward, the caster will be left immotile - unable to walk, fly around, slither, etc. Only motile creatures can cast this spell.

spells.name: Vhi's Electric Charge
spells.description: Sends the caster hurtling at a chosen nearby enemy, launching a high-accuracy melee attack on arrival. Additional electric damage will be dealt based on the length of the charge, the power of the spell, and the physical damage of the attack. The caster is wrapped in an envelope of twisted space, allowing them to safely pass through creatures, traps, and harmful terrain, and to displace creatures at their destination. The time taken by the spell is the greater of the time normally needed to cast a spell or that needed to launch one melee attack.

spells.name: Noxious Breath
spells.description: Breathes a line of noxious vapour which can confuse anything standing in it which does not resist poison. At higher levels, the clouds can cover a larger area and last longer.

spells.name: Plasma Beam
spells.description: Fires a penetrating beam of plasma at one of the caster's most distant visible foes. The ionised beam bypasses half of defenders' armour, and a second beam of fire follows in its wake.

spells.name: Bombard
spells.description: Blasts an iron ball toward a target. The force of the blast often sends the caster staggering backwards.

spells.name: Jinxbite
spells.description:
Calls the attention of trickster spirits. While it holds, the spirits will follow up on the caster's attacks. If the spell overcomes victims' willpower, they will suffer minor damage and be drained by the sprites' playful malice.

Fae assistance is fickle, however; they cannot be beckoned unless a susceptible victim is visible, and will depart rapidly once no more remain. Calling on the fae also reduces the caster's own willpower for a time.

spells.name: Sigil of Binding
spells.description:
Creates two sigils nearby. Anyone who passes over them will be bound, able to act and dodge normally but unable to move away. For bound creatures other than the caster, their movement speed will rebound when the effect wears off, giving them temporary swiftness. Swiftness from any source grants immunity to binding.

Only one set of sigils can be maintained at a time, and they will expire prematurely if they leave your sight.

spells.name: Dimensional Bullseye
spells.description: Weaves a link between the caster's weaponry and a chosen target. Whenever the caster fires or throws something at a *different* enemy, a matching projectile will be teleported at the target. Spellpower increases their accuracy.

spells.name: Brom's Barrelling Boulder
spells.description:
Unleashes a massive rolling boulder in a given compass direction. This boulder damages any creature it hits, rolling over those who perish beneath it and pushing any others helplessly backwards (along with anyone else unfortunate enough to be standing behind them).

Its size and reckless locomotion make it difficult to use in confined areas; if launched down narrow passages, it will rapidly abrade against the walls and fall apart. It will also crumble if it leaves the caster's sight or strikes a wall or otherwise unmoveable creature.

spells.name: Vitrify
spells.description: Renders a creature's body structure as brittle and fragile as glass, increasing the damage they take from all sources.

spells.name: Vitrifying Gaze
spells.description: Irresistibly renders a creature's body structure as brittle and fragile as glass, increasing the damage they take from all sources. It requires line of sight but not line of fire.

spells.name: Mourning Wail
spells.description: Exhales a stream of forgotten grief, leaving clouds of excruciating misery in its wake but skipping past creatures that would be vulnerable to it. These clouds of negative energy will rapidly drain the living of small fractions of their maximum health.

spells.name: Funeral Dirge
spells.description: A ritual chant that briefly rouses several nearby undead allies to move more swiftly and strike with greater might.

spells.name: March of Sorrows
spells.description: Conjures a stream of stolen suffering, leaving clouds of excruciating misery in its wake and around its targets. These clouds of negative energy will rapidly drain the living of small fractions of their maximum health.

spells.name: Martyr's Knell
spells.description:
Beckons forth the soul of a long-dead martyr to shield your allies for a time. This soul suffers a portion of the damage your allies would otherwise receive.

If it is slain (again!), it will transform into a flayed ghost, inflicting illusory wounds on foes. Such wounds are fleeting, and will disappear when the ghost departs - unless you kill its victims first.

spells.name: Curse of Agony
spells.description: Curses a foe, halving their remaining health after each of the next two times that the caster strikes them in melee.

spells.name: Vhi's Electrolunge
spells.description: Sends the caster hurtling at a chosen nearby enemy, launching a high-accuracy melee attack on arrival, with additional electrical damage based on spellpower. The caster is wrapped in an envelope of twisted space, allowing them to safely pass through creatures, traps, and harmful terrain, and to displace creatures at their destination.

spells.name: Regenerate Other
spells.description: Causes another creature to rapidly regenerate over a short period of time. This regeneration is proportional to that creature's maximum health.

spells.name: Divine Armament
spells.description:
Manifests the caster's faith as a spiritual weapon, which will fight and slay the caster's enemies under its own power.

As it is a direct reflection of the caster's unique zeal, the weapon they receive from their god will be the same each time.

spells.name: Hurl Torchlight
spells.description:
Hurls a gout of umbral torchlight which deals irresistible damage to living, demonic, and holy beings. The torchlight will also briefly empower any friendly undead caught in its blast, increasing their melee damage and granting them one free action.

It is harmless to those who worship Yredelemnul.

spells.name: Crystallising Shot
spells.description: Hurls a large and heavy shard of crystal. It may render a creature's body structure as brittle and fragile as shattered and unrefined crystal, increasing the damage they take from all sources.

spells.name: Rebounding Blaze
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of energetic flames that can bounce off walls to hit targets twice.

spells.name: Warp Space
spells.description: Creates a brief but violent rift in space, damaging everything caught in its wake and sometimes blinking them a short distance away.

spells.name: Combustion Breath
spells.description: Breathes a blast of volatile embers that explode violently around each creature they touch. It is harmless to its user.

spells.name: Nullifying Breath
spells.description: Breathes a large blast of pure antimagic that dispels magical effects from every creature it hits and also significantly interferes with their ability to cast spells for a while. It is harmless to its user.

spells.name: Steam Breath
spells.description: Breathes a powerful blast of steam, scalding a target and leaving sight-obscuring steam clouds in its wake.

spells.name: Mud Breath
spells.description: Spits an enormous ball of mud that knocks back whatever it hits and drenches the surrounding area in a mud slick which impedes enemy movement and causes them to sometimes fumble their attacks.

spells.name: Galvanic Breath
spells.description: Exhales a charged burst of electricity that will arc through a target and every other creature that is connected to it.

spells.name: Permafrost Eruption
spells.description:
Calls on the ancient cold lurking within the earth to emerge - violently. The force of its emergence blasts rock from the ceiling, smashing into the target with unavoidable force. The cold itself is brief but unbearably bitter, bypassing armour entirely as it freezes the target and their neighbours.

It will always attempt to blast the largest concentration of foes in sight, and never explodes next to the caster.

spells.name: Maxwell's Portable Piledriver
spells.description: Compresses an envelope of space around the caster and an adjacent enemy (or a contiguous line of enemies), then allows it to decompress abruptly, propelling everyone forward until the unfortunate being at the far end collides with something solid, inflicting damage on them proportional to the distance travelled.

spells.name: Gell's Gavotte
spells.description:
Briefly reorients local gravity to be in a cardinal direction of the caster's choosing, causing all creatures in sight to tumble a short distance in that direction.

The caster is not immune to the gravitational effects of this spell, but will be cushioned so they take no collision damage. Other creatures are not so fortunate, and the abrupt impact will batter anything which was not already standing beside its new 'floor'.

It takes a short time for gravity to stabilise enough to recast this spell, though more powerful mages are able to do so more frequently.

spells.name: Magnavolt
spells.description:
Envelops a target in a thin layer of magnetically charged metal fragments, then unleashes a powerful surge of electricity that arcs unerringly towards every visible target coated in these fragments - firing an additional beam at each target thus marked.

Magnetised creatures are additionally unable to evade attacks and will be revealed if invisible. If they die while still coated, they will leave behind a short-lived cloud of electrified metal that will continue to serve as a lightning rod for this spell.

spells.name: Fulsome Fusillade
spells.description:
A magnum opus of reckless chemistry, this spell conjures up a surfeit of volatile reagents to rain down upon your enemies. For the next several turns, up to 3 random enemies in sight will be struck by an exploding beaker that inflicts either fire, cold, electric, or poison damage. If any of these explosions overlap each other, the resulting reaction will inflict even greater irresistible damage and sometimes apply a random deleterious status on whoever is caught in the blast.

This spell costs a small amount of the caster's magical energy each turn to maintain, and while it will never aim an explosion where it could hurt the caster, the caster's allies (and anything else in the general vicinity) are not so fortunate.

spells.name: Rimeblight
spells.description:
Afflicts a creature (and up to two others near it) with a magical plague that slowly freezes them from the inside out. Victims take AC-ignoring cold damage each turn, and as the disease progresses, shards of crystalline ice will start erupting violently from their body, damaging nearby enemies. When they finally succumb, the plague may spread to those around them.

In living, holy, or demonic creatures, the disease is especially virulent, feeding off the necromantic energies released by its host's suffering. As they approach the point of death, it will accelerate rapidly, devouring the last vestiges of their body and leaving nothing behind but a twisted pillar of stygian ice.

spells.name: Hoarfrost Cannonade
spells.description:
Sculpts a pair of icy cannons that assail the caster's enemies from long range. The frigid shards they fire rapidly coat their targets with a layer of brittle frost which slows their movement.

The cannons are short-lived and consume a part of themselves with every shard they fire, but if they survive to fire their final salvo without interference, it will be extra-powerful.

spells.name: Seismic Stomp
spells.description: Stomps heavily upon the ground, sending out violent shockwaves that fracture the ground beneath multiple nearby enemies. Flying creatures take greatly reduced damage from this attack, but those on the ground may sometimes to lose their footing altogether, delaying their next action as they struggle to regain balance on the uneven terrain.

spells.name: Hoarfrost Bullet
spells.description:
Fires a shard of ice that coats whatever it hits with a layer of brittle frost which slows their movement.

Each shot fired will deplete the cannon's remaining durability, but if it survives to fire 5 times, the final shot will fragment to hit all enemies around the primary target for additional damage.

spells.name: Bestow Arms
spells.description: Temporarily grants numerous nearby allies a magical weapon from within the armoury, so long as the souls holding it together remain intact.

spells.name: Flashing Balestra
spells.description: A single soul from within the armoury leaps out, striking with their weapon and then duelling independently for a short time before returning to the maelstrom once more.

spells.name: Hellfire Mortar
spells.description:
Splits apart the ground in front of the caster and sculpts a terrifying weapon out of molten rock. This mortar will move slowly along the lava-filled chasm, autonomously launching gouts of magma at the caster's enemies as it does so.

When it reaches the end of its path, or is obstructed in its movement by another creature, it will sink back into the lava, and the chasm will seal itself shut shortly thereafter.

spells.name: Greater Ensnare
spells.description: Shoots a stream of webbing at a creature, ensnaring them in a sticky web and scattering additional webs nearby that dissolve after a short length of time.

spells.name: Mass Regeneration
spells.description: Causes all allied monsters nearby to rapidly regenerate over a short period of time. This regeneration is proportional to each of those creature's maximum health.

spells.name: Shadowball
spells.description: Hurls a ball of flickering shadows, which explodes in a small area.

spells.name: Creeping Shadow
spells.description: Calls forth shadows from the corners of nearby walls to strike at all of the caster's enemies standing adjacent to them.

spells.name: Shadow Tempest
spells.description: Calls down shadowy lightning upon up to half of all visible enemies, dealing irresistible damage to them.

spells.name: Shadow Prism
spells.description: Conjures a shadowy prism which will unleash a violent blast of shadows after a short duration. If destroyed prematurely, this blast will be much weaker.

spells.name: Shadow Puppet
spells.description: Summons a servant of living shadow to harass and constrict the caster's enemies. The strength of its attacks is directly increased by spellpower.

spells.name: Shadow Bind
spells.description: Pins several random nearby enemies to their own shadows, briefly preventing them from moving. At higher spellpower, it affects more enemies at once.

spells.name: Shadow Torpor
spells.description: Saps the energy from a line of enemies, slowing them for a short while. Spellpower increases the duration of this effect, but stronger creatures may shake off their lethargy more quickly.

spells.name: Shadow Draining
spells.description: Forcefully steals a sliver from the shadows of all nearby enemies, causing damage which bypasses the victim's armour entirely.

spells.name: Grave Claw
spells.description:
Calls forth the spite of the recently dead to skewer a targeted enemy with shards of bone. This spell never misses, and will pin its target in place for several turns, but casting it rapidly consumes the remnants of death that linger upon the caster.

You can stockpile enough malice to cast this spell at most three times, and this can only be replenished by causing the death of a sufficient number of living beings.

spells.name: Summon Mortal Champion
spells.description: Calls forth one of the mightiest and fastest mortal champions of the Shining One. In this Dungeon, spriggan defenders and deep elf blademasters will answer the call.

spells.name: Phantom Blitz
spells.description: Weaves and fires a phantom copy of the caster with great force. Such phantoms have the same martial and mystic prowess as the caster, and an impromptu night parade of illusions may overwhelm the caster's victims.

spells.name: Launch Clockwork Bee
spells.description:
Constructs a mechanical bee and winds its clockwork mechanisms over several turns before unleashing it against a targeted foe. The bee is swift and powerful, but its clockwork quickly winds down as it attacks, eventually leaving it helpless and unable to move.

The caster may repair and rewind a dormant bee by attempting to move into it, at the cost of 1 MP.

Spellpower increases the number of attacks the bee may perform before going dormant.

spells.name: Construct Spike Launcher
spells.description: Constructs a simple mechanical trap within an adjacent wall which repeatedly skewers random adjacent enemies. Protected by the wall itself, it is invulnerable to most forms of damage, but will fall apart if the caster leaves its vicinity.

spells.name: Kinetic Grapnel
spells.description: Weaves a thin kinetic filament around the caster's melee weapon and launches the other end of it at a nearby enemy. If this grapnel successfully hits and does damage, it will become lodged in them, allowing the next melee attack the caster performs against them to strike with perfect accuracy and a small slaying bonus.

spells.name: Diamond Sawblades
spells.description: Forges up to four razor-sharp sawblades at fixed positions around the caster which shred any enemies adjacent to them over several turns.

spells.name: Shred
spells.description: Spins in place, dealing grievous damage to adjacent enemies with its serrated body.

spells.name: Eringya's Surprising Crocodile
spells.description: Summons a toothy crocodile to assault an adjacent enemy. The crocodile will appear beneath the caster in a surge of murky water and perform an empowered attack against the chosen target, dragging both it and the caster backward before allowing the latter to dismount safely behind it. It cannot be recast while the crocodile is still active.

spells.name: Platinum Paragon
spells.description:
Constructs a gleaming metal champion whose prowess rivals that of the greatest living warriors. It is resistant to all forms of magic and wields a perfect replica of any artefact melee weapon the caster chooses.

It creates a damaging shockwave around itself when first deployed and slowly gains charge as it attacks enemies. When it has gained sufficient charge, the spell may be recast to overload the paragon, unleashing a flurry of attacks in a wide area which inflict increased damage, but destroying the paragon in the process.

Due to the magical link it maintains with its creator, it will perform an extra attack whenever they do, and will sometimes even parry attacks directed at them, if they are close enough together.

spells.name: Alistair's Walking Alembic
spells.description: Constructs a mobile and combat-capable alchemical manufactory. It uses the friction of melee combat to brew a variety of useful potions, venting clouds of their toxic byproducts at whatever it punches. When it has built up enough heat to complete its synthesis, it will automatically dispense the finished potions to nearby allies before falling apart.

spells.name: Forge Monarch Bomb
spells.description:
Constructs a flying incendiary factory, packed to the brim with cluster bomblets which it can deploy both in melee and launch at range. While the monarch's bomblets have no attack of their own, they will pursue the caster's enemies until given the signal to explode.

Recasting this spell while anything it has created is still active will detonate the monarch bomb and all bomblets, dealing a combination of fire and physical damage to everything adjacent to them besides the caster themselves.

spells.name: Launch Bomblet
spells.description:
Fires a bomblet on a ballistic trajectory that ignores line of fire, dealing minor damage to a single target within range and deploying the bomblet near it.

Cannot target enemies adjacent to the caster or those with no nearby room for the bomblet to land.

spells.name: Splinterfrost Shell
spells.description:
Constructs a frangible shell of reinforced ice in a half-circle around the caster, pushing creatures out of the way to make space for it, if possible.

This barricade is durable, and whenever a segment of it is destroyed, will fracture into a salvo of icy projectiles launched at whatever destroyed it.

If the caster strays too far away from their barrier, it will melt rapidly.

spells.name: Nazja's Percussive Tempering
spells.description: Manifests a magical hammer that repairs and temporarily augments the offensive capabilities of any construct that was created by the caster's own Forgecraft spells. This process results in a flurry of sparks, slag, and concussive shockwaves that do considerable damage to any enemies adjacent to the targeted construct, but it cannot be recast upon the same object until the enhancement wears off.

spells.name: Fortress Blast
spells.description:
Draws upon the caster's own physical integrity to create a kinetic shockwave that damages foes in a large area. The caster is locked in place for several turns as the shockwave starts to form, and the spell will be cancelled if they are displaced during that time, but they may otherwise perform other actions freely.

Spellpower causes the spell to complete more quickly, but the damage depends entirely upon the caster's AC.

spells.name: Summon Seismosaurus Egg
spells.description:
Summons the egg of a brutish lizard, just on the verge of hatching. So long as there are visible foes nearby and the caster remains adjacent to the egg, it will hatch several turns after being summoned to wreak havoc upon its summoner's foes.

Even as a juvenile, a seismosaurus is a force to be reckoned with. It is nearly as hardy as a mountain, and its footfalls are capable of creating violent seismic shockwaves. Each shockwave deals considerable damage to non-flying enemies, and may sometimes even cause them to lose their footing altogether.

Spell power increases the egg's durability and the strength of the seismosaur within, but not the time it takes to hatch.

spells.name: Forge Phalanx Beetle
spells.description:
Constructs a small mechanical guardian which bolsters its creator's armour class for as long as it remains adjacent to them.

While also capable of biting foes, the phalanx beetle will never voluntarily leave its creator's side, and if forcibly separated, will prioritise returning to them over any other concern.

Spellpower increases the magnitude of the AC increase, as well as the beetle's own durability.

spells.name: Rending Blade
spells.description:
Condenses the caster's magical energy into the form of a violently crackling blade. Each time the caster successfully hits with a melee attack while the spell is active, this blade will rend a path back and forth through nearby foes, dealing irresistible damage.

Casting this spell temporarily drains *all* of the caster's remaining magical power to constitute the blade, but this energy will be returned to them as soon as the blade ceases to exist. Each point of magical power sequestered this way slightly increases the damage the blade inflicts.

spells.name: Magma Barrage
spells.description: Fires penetrating bolts of molten rock at up to two different enemy targets. Half of its damage bypasses fire resistance.

spells.name: Shadow Turret
spells.description: Forms a stationary turret of solidified shadow that repeatedly fires upon the caster's enemies.

spells.name: Shadow Shot
spells.description: Fires a small bullet of hardened shadow at a single enemy.

spells.name: Throw Bolas
spells.description: Hurls a colossal bolas at the target, wrapping around even the largest of foes and binding them in place.

spells.name: Siphon Essence
spells.description: Torments nearby living foes, cutting their health in half. This damage is never directly lethal. The pain inflicted then heals the user.

spells.name: Poisonous Vapours
spells.description:
Transmutes a small amount of the air around a target into toxic vapours, poisoning anyone unfortunate enough to breathe them in. The quantity of air affected is small and it will not persist beyond the turn in which it is cast.

It cannot affect those with any resistance to poison.

spells.name: Sojourning Bolt
spells.description: Breathes a penetrating and unstable bijection burst. If it hits, it may teleport victims after a short delay. For particularly interesting morsels of adventurers such as yourself, this teleport will translocate those victims towards the caster's allies and bring the caster along for the ride, if possible.

spells.name: Vex
spells.description: Attempts to cloud the target's mind with thoughtless frustration, forcing them to spend several turns doing nothing but attacking nearby spaces (whether those spaces are empty or even contain their allies).

spells.name: Ravenous Swarm
spells.description:
Unleashes a torrent of vampire bats, filling the air around a target.

These vampires will gnaw on anything which isn't undead with a voracious hunger, and their bites will eventually even lull their victims to sleep, leaving them easy prey.

spells.name: Dominate Undead
spells.description:
Attempts to forcibly change the allegiance of all nearby undead which are not already loyal to the caster.

Adventurers, being famously headstrong, cannot be fully controlled by this spell. They will instead lash out randomly for the duration of its effect, attacking nearby friend and foe alike before regaining their wits.

This spell can be broken prematurely by the death of its caster.

spells.name: Pyrrhic Recollection
spells.description:
Ignites a memory from the nimbus which surrounds Nobody, temporarily granting them the knowledge of a powerful spell and healing their injuries.

This power is fleeting and will be extinguished after taking any significant amount of damage, but so long as any other memories remain, they cannot be put to rest for good.

spells.name: Detonation Catalyst
spells.description: Affixes a volatile catalyst to the caster's fists or melee weapon, causing each of their strikes to release a fiery explosion at its primary target. The caster and their allies are protected from the explosion's effects. The activity of the catalyst may be prolonged indefinitely as long as the caster continues to attack, but it rapidly loses potency when they take other actions. The base damage of the caster's weapon and the caster's spellpower each increase the explosion's damage.

spells.name: Beckoning Gale
spells.description: Twists the air around a creature to both deal damage and attempt to pull them closer to the caster.

spells.name: Nazja's All-Purpose Tempering
spells.description: Manifests a magical hammer that repairs and temporarily augments the offensive capabilities of any nearby construct - be it golem or phalanx beetle or even dancing weapon. This process results in a flurry of sparks, slag, and concussive shockwaves that do considerable damage to any enemies adjacent to the targeted construct, but it cannot be recast upon the same object until the enhancement wears off.

spells.name: Sphinx Sisters
spells.description:
Summons a pair of riddling sphinxes - one guardian and one marauder - to debilitate the caster's enemies with hexes and batter them with violent winds.

Spell power increases the sphinxes' durability and the power of their spells.

spells.name: Bolt of Flesh
spells.description: Fires a penetrating barrage of conjured flesh, which will briefly remain as a pile on the ground at the end of its path.

spells.name: Awaken Flesh
spells.description: Channels a surge of chaotic energy through each pile of flesh in the caster's sight, animating them into empowered large abominations and dealing chaos damage to any foes unfortunate enough to be standing next to them.

spells.name: Ill Omen
spells.description: Bends the weave of fate against a target, inflicting significant Doom. Cannot be used if there are any obstructions between the caster and their target.

spells.name: Doom Bolt
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of accursed malice which inflicts Doom.

spells.name: Warp Body
spells.description: Twists a creature's body with mutagenic corruption, doing a small amount of damage and inflicting a transient mutation. If the target is already suffering from multiple transient mutations, it will inflict Vitrify instead.

spells.name: Ostracise
spells.description:
Isolates a target from the divine - temporarily reducing their piety in the eyes of whichever god they worship and denying them access to any divine abilities that piety would allow. Being repeatedly affected by this spell will reduce the one's effective piety further and further, but can never directly lead to excommunication.

This effect will slowly wear off as the afflicted being gains experience, eventually restoring access to the full piety they once possessed.

spells.name: Mutagenic Gaze
spells.description:
Causes mutagenic energy to accumulate in a target, eventually reaching levels high enough to cause harmful mutations or explosions of unstable magical energy.

This spell requires line of sight but not line of fire.

spells.name: Planar Overlay
spells.description:
Overlays part of an adjacent reality onto this one, causing random local monsters to appear elsewhere on the floor. The first time this is used, multiple monsters will arrive at once; afterward, they will appear at a slow, steady rate.

After a considerable amount of time has passed, these monsters may even appear near the player.

spells.name: Acid Ball
spells.description: Hurls an explosive ball of corrosive acid.

spells.name: Doomsaying
spells.description:
Foretells a terrible future, inflicting Doom equal to half of what it would take for you to reach 100%. Upon the caster's death, a sliver of this fate will come to pass in the form of an ambush; several well-hidden enemies from the floor will seek out your position unerringly and all stairs will temporarily be sealed.

Can only be cast a single time, but even slaying the messenger in their sleep will not avoid what fate has in store for you.

spells.name: Sleetstrike
spells.description: Causes the air around a creature to twist itself into a whirling vortex of frigid meteorological fury, encasing the victim in ice and slowing their movement briefly. It does more damage to targets surrounded by empty space and half of its damage bypasses cold resistance.

spells.name: Diminish Spells
spells.description: Irresistibly weakens the power of an enemy's spells for a period of time.

spells.name: Draining Gaze
spells.description: Fills a living creature with negative energy, draining them for a fraction of their maximum health. This spell requires line of sight but not line of fire.

spells.name: Launch Sporangium
spells.description: Launches a caustic sporangium which will pursue any intriguing sources of nutrients - such as yourself - and engulf them in a massive acidic explosion. Nascent plasmodia, capable of firing acid of their own, may take root on any walls this explosion touches - though none within 2 tiles of any other.

spells.name: Freezing Gust
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of frigid air that leaves clouds of lethally cold vapour in its wake.

spells.name: Landbreaker
spells.description: Violently fractures the landscape, causing rubble to fall upon several nearby enemies and also the ground behind them - obstructing their path to flee the caster.

spells.name: Bolt of Antimagic
spells.description: Fires a penetrating bolt of ontologically-paradoxical antimagic, draining its victims' reserves of magic.

spells.name: Stampede
spells.description:
Charges rapidly in a straight line towards a foe. The user will move at double speed in that direction each turn afterward, attacking any enemies in their path with increased damage and accuracy and pushing them backward, until they either become unable to move or have overshot their target.

Can only be used while their target is standing in a compass direction from the user.

spells.name: Murky Legion
spells.description: Summons some glowmurk ghasts, which spread both magical contamination and shallow water in a single attack before disappearing.

spells.name: Bolster
spells.description: Enhances the caster's physical form, greatly increasing the damage they deal in melee as well as their resistance to all elements.

spells.name: Phase Shift
spells.description: Shifts the caster's body slighty out of phase with normal space, causing their exact position to become blurry and indistinct. Any attackers without supernaturally acute vision will have a much harder time hitting them and also be unable to assess the degree of their injuries.

spells.name: Touch of Paradox
spells.description: Unmoors a random nearby ally from space, granting it Manifold Assault as a natural ability (which permits it to strike many distant foes with a single melee attack that can't miss), and also giving it a chance to blink when it uses such.

spells.name: Dragon Veins
spells.description:
Allows the caster to tap into ley lines of elemental energy which pervade the dungeon and channel their destructive power against enemies. Casting it exposes up to four dragon veins on adjacent floor tiles - one corresponding to each of fire, ice, air, and earth magic. Stepping onto any of them will trigger an immediate destructive spellcast at the cost of 1 MP, targeting up to 3 random enemies with an additional property that depends on the element tapped into:

Fire (West): Prioritises enemies with the least health. Leaves behind brief fire clouds when it kills something.

Ice (East): Prioritises enemies with the most health. Briefly freezes them, slowing their movement.

Air (North): Prioritises the most distant enemies. Unlike the other 3 elements, does full damage even to distant targets.

Earth (South): Prioritises the closest enemies. Strikes one fewer target and does greatly reduced damage to flying creatures, but enemies hit at close range may be staggered.

You may channel from up to two of these dragon veins before the spell expires.

spells.name: Ice Thorns
spells.description:
Causes a ring of sharp icy thorns to sprout from the ground around a targeted enemy. These thorns deal damage to any non-flying creature which steps on them and then crumble away.

The caster can step onto their own thorns without harm (but they will still crumble when doing so).

spells.name: Sirocco
spells.description:
Unleashes a gust of searingly hot wind, burning up to 3 adjacent creatures and blowing them backwards. Alas, the capricious winds left swirling around those creatures will also speed their movements for several turns afterward.

This spell cannot be recast for several turns and moving will delay its recharge.

spells.name: Aegis Link
spells.description: Weaves threads of silver translocation around the caster and their nearest visible ally, granting both increased armour class and shielding (+2 AC, +2 SH in co-op; +3 AC, +3 SH in solo). While both linked partners are in sight of one another, 35% of damage suffered by the more wounded partner is redirected to the healthier partner.

spells.name: Ballad of the Vanguard
spells.description: Strikes up a stirring martial anthem that inspires the caster and all co-op teammates in sight. Those inspired by the Ballad gain +4 slaying, +3 evasion, and cleaving melee attacks for the duration of the song.

spells.name: Sanctuary Chorus
spells.description: Intones a consecrated chorus that immediately cleanses poison, corrosion, and slowness from the caster and all visible co-op teammates, while warding them with +2 AC, +1 negative energy resistance (rN+), accelerated health regeneration, and a 30% reduction in damage from poison, smiting, pain, torment, and damnation.

spells.name: Aura of Protection
spells.description: Projects a bastion aura of iron will and earthen resilience in a 3-tile radius around the caster. While active, the caster and all co-op teammates within the aura gain +2 to +3 AC, +2 to +3 SH, and +1 Willpower pip (Will+). Only one Aura stance may be maintained by a single caster at a time, though different Auras maintained by multiple party members stack.

spells.name: Aura of Zeal
spells.description: Blazes with a fervent crusader's aura in a 3-tile radius around the caster. While active, the caster and all co-op teammates within the aura gain +3 to +4 slaying, fire resistance (rF+), immunity to fear, and radiant fire damage on their melee strikes. Only one Aura stance may be maintained by a single caster at a time, though different Auras maintained by multiple party members stack.

spells.name: Aura of Rime
spells.description: Envelops the caster and all co-op teammates within a 3-tile radius in a whirling aura of hoarfrost. Those inside the aura gain +2 to +3 evasion, cold resistance (rC+), and a retaliatory frost lash that damages and slows enemies who strike them in melee. Only one Aura stance may be maintained by a single caster at a time, though different Auras maintained by multiple party members stack.

spells.name: Aura of Vitality
spells.description: Radiates a restorative aura of alchemical and sacred life-force in a 3-tile radius around the caster. Casting or refreshing the aura immediately heals and purges confusion, weakness, and fear from the caster and nearby teammates, while the sustained aura grants poison resistance (rPois) and +1.20/turn health regeneration. Only one Aura stance may be maintained by a single caster at a time, though different Auras maintained by multiple party members stack.

spells.name: Aura of Sanctuary
spells.description: Weaves a shimmering dimensional ward in a 3-tile radius around the caster. While active, the caster and all co-op teammates within the aura gain +2 SH, +2 EV, negative energy resistance (rN+), and a 15% reduction in all incoming damage. Only one Aura stance may be maintained by a single caster at a time, though different Auras maintained by multiple party members stack.

species.name: Human
species.description: An uppity sort of surface-dwelling, hairless ape. Dwarves think of them as fragile, elves think of them as clumsy, and monsters think of them as tasty.

species.name: Kobold
species.description: A small, greyish creature with the look and temperament of a feral dog. No one knows for sure where kobolds come from, but ancient demon-gods, evil spirits, and meddling wizards have all been suggested as culprits.

species.name: Mummy
species.description: An undead figure covered in bandages and embalming fluids, compelled to walk by an ancient curse. It radiates a malign aura.

species.name: Naga
species.description: A hybrid that is human from the waist up; below is a scaly, muscular snakelike tail. Its mouth drips with venomous saliva.

species.name: Oni
species.description: A large, rowdy, and drink-loving creature. When they're not busy with their duties serving any number of gods, oni mostly love a good fight.

species.name: Troll
species.description: A huge and physically powerful humanoid creature. Short on intelligence but long on brawn, its thick knobbly hide heals rapidly from most wounds.

species.name: Red Draconian
species.description: A muscular red-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

species.name: White Draconian
species.description: A muscular white-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

species.name: Green Draconian
species.description: A muscular green-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

species.name: Yellow Draconian
species.description: A muscular yellow-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

species.name: Grey Draconian
species.description: A muscular grey-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

species.name: Black Draconian
species.description: A muscular black-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and powerful wings.

species.name: Purple Draconian
species.description: A muscular purple-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.

species.name: Pale Draconian
species.description: A muscular humanoid with pale scales, a reptilian tail and small wings.

species.name: Draconian
species.description: A brown-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings. It is yet to develop the distinct colouring and powerful breath attack of its mature form.

species.name: Centaur
species.description: A hybrid with the torso of a human atop the body of a horse. It is highly skilled in archery.

species.name: Demigod
species.description: A human-like figure with an aura of power betraying its divine ancestry.

species.name: Spriggan
species.description: A small humanoid, resembling a human or elf except for the size. It moves at a great speed, and loves playing dirty tricks on people.

species.name: Minotaur
species.description: A large muscular human with the head of a bull. It makes its home in a gauntlet where it awaits worthy challengers.

species.name: Demonspawn
species.description: A half-mortal, half-demonic creature, with its hellish heritage asserting itself through a certain devilish cast to its features.

species.name: Ghoul
species.description: A decayed cadaver, reanimated and accursed with a terrible hunger. It desires nothing but to feed on the flesh of the living, and will fell its victims with its vicious claws.

species.name: Tengu
species.description: A humanoid figure with the head and talons of a bird. Its ferociously combative nature belies its fragile appearance.

species.name: Merfolk
species.description: A hybrid with the torso of a human and the tail of a fish. It is capable of dwelling both in water and on land, and fiercely defends its domain.

species.name: Deep Dwarf
species.description: A pallid, stocky subterranean dwarf whose body has adapted to the crushing weight of the deep earth. Though incapable of natural regeneration, it shrugs off blows with uncanny resilience and mends its own flesh with dark subterranean magic.

species.name: Felid
species.description: A feline creature that has been granted sentience by magical means. It uses the gift of speech to demand milk, treats and catnip.

species.name: Octopode
species.description: A more intelligent cousin of the mighty kraken, capable of using tools and spells. It is fully amphibious, but most of its species choose to stay beneath the waves and serve their King.

species.name: Djinni
species.description: An elemental spirit formed from smokeless fire.

species.name: Gargoyle
species.description: A granite statue of a hideous winged monster, somehow brought to life.

species.name: Formicid
species.description: A sentient ant that walks upright and is competent at digging.

species.name: Vine Stalker
species.description: A bizarre symbiotic creature, made up of a carnivorous vine magically combined with a humanoid.

species.name: Barachi
species.description: An amphibious humanoid with a very ugly attitude.

species.name: Gnoll
species.description: A taller and better-equipped relative of goblins, and ally of orcs. It is somewhat doglike in appearance.

species.name: Poltergeist
species.description: A ghostly trickster that is fond of possessing small objects and making them fly noisily through the air.

species.name: Revenant
species.description: The skeletal remains of someone who died unmourned and forgotten. It burns with an unquenchable hunger to be remembered.

jobs.name: Necromancer
jobs.description: An evil wizard who is devoted to the practice of death magic, the mastery of unholy energies, and the raising of corpses into a parody of life.

jobs.name: Shapeshifter
jobs.description: A disturbing creature with the power to change its form. It is very rarely observed alive in its natural state.

jobs.name: Death Knight
jobs.description: A warrior-priest of Yredelemnul, chanting fearful supplications to its dark god.

gods.name: Zin
gods.description: Zin is a god of discipline. Followers must remain pure of body and soul, refraining from dark magic and chaotic acts. They must also tithe a fraction of all gold gained, preferably followed by donations of more. In exchange, worshippers may invoke Zin's wrath upon sinners, and eventually gain various divine protections. Zin's followers can convert to Elyvilon or the Shining One while keeping some piety.

abilities.name: Recite
abilities.description: You can recite Zin's Axioms of Law.

abilities.name: Vitalisation
abilities.description: You can call upon Zin for vitalisation.

abilities.name: Imprison
abilities.description: You can call upon Zin to imprison the lawless.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: You can call upon Zin to create a sanctuary.
Zin will cleanse your potions of mutation.

abilities.name: Donate Gold
abilities.description: You can donate money to Zin.

gods.name: the Shining One
gods.description: Followers of the Shining One are bound to the code of the honourable warrior, soldiers in their god's eternal crusade against evil. For forsaking dark magic and underhanded tactics, the Shining One rewards them and their allies with the power they need to slay demons and the undead. Especially devout warriors can even call upon angels in times of need. The Shining One's followers can convert to Elyvilon or Zin while keeping some piety.

abilities.description: Your summoned allies will not expire while fighting evil.
You can gain power from killing the unholy and evil.
The Shining One sometimes blesses your followers when you slay foes.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: You can call upon the Shining One for a divine shield.

abilities.name: Cleansing Flame
abilities.description: You can channel blasts of cleansing flame.

abilities.name: Summon Divine Warrior
abilities.description: You can summon a divine warrior.

abilities.name: Brand Weapon With Holy Wrath
abilities.description: The Shining One will bless your weapon with holy wrath... once.

gods.name: Kikubaaqudgha
gods.description: Kikubaaqudgha is a terrible Demon-God, served by those who wish to indulge in the powers of death. An evil god, Kikubaaqudgha requires worshippers to cause the death and destruction of as many creatures as possible. In exchange, Kikubaaqudgha offers great assistance to the aspiring necromancer: a supply of useful bodies, knowledge of dark magic, and protection against necromantic backlash.

abilities.name: Unearth Wretches
abilities.description: You can bring forth the wretched and dying.
Kikubaaqudgha protects you from necromantic miscasts and death curses.
Kikubaaqudgha protects you from unholy torment.

abilities.name: Sign of Ruin
abilities.description: You can invoke the sign of ruin.

abilities.name: Brand Weapon With Pain
abilities.description: Kikubaaqudgha will grant you forbidden knowledge or bloody your weapon with pain... once.

abilities.name: Receive Forbidden Knowledge
abilities.description: Kikubaaqudgha will grant you forbidden knowledge.

gods.name: Yredelemnul
gods.description: Cast down by the good gods eons ago, Yredelemnul seeks to despoil their creations and chain all living souls within their inexorable grip. Followers who would conquer in Yredelemnul's name are granted the power to reap an army of the dead and bind powerful souls into eternal service - provided they can sweep across the land in a tide as inexorable as their god.

abilities.name: Light the Black Torch
abilities.description: You can light the black torch and reap souls in Yredelemnul's name.

abilities.name: Recall Undead Harvest
abilities.description: You can recall your undead harvest.
Yredelemnul will gift you temporary undead servants when you light the torch.

abilities.name: Hurl Torchlight
abilities.description: You can hurl gouts of umbral torchlight.

abilities.name: Bind Soul
abilities.description: You can bind living souls.

abilities.name: Fathomless Shackles
abilities.description: You can engulf your surroundings in Yredelemnul's grip.

gods.name: Xom
gods.description: Xom is a wild and unpredictable god of chaos, who seeks not worshippers but playthings with which to toy. Many choose to follow Xom in the hope of receiving fabulous rewards and mighty powers, but Xom is nothing if not capricious. There is nothing a follower can do to influence Xom's mood.

gods.name: Vehumet
gods.description: Vehumet is a god of the destructive powers of magic. Followers will gain divine assistance in commanding the hermetic arts, and the most favoured stand to gain access to some of the fearsome spells in Vehumet's library. One's devotion to Vehumet can be proven by the causing of as much carnage and destruction as possible.

abilities.description: You can gain magical power from killing.
Vehumet aids your destructive spells.
Vehumet extends the range of your destructive spells.

gods.name: Okawaru
gods.description: Okawaru is a dangerous and powerful god of battle. Followers are expected to constantly prove themselves in combat, and may channel Okawaru's might to enhance their prowess. Okawaru demands that followers prove themselves by their own strength alone, and so worshippers are forbidden from gaining allies by any means. Okawaru pays little heed to easy victories, but will reward worshippers for heroic feats against mighty foes.

abilities.description: Okawaru requires that you fight alone, and prevents you from gaining allies.

abilities.name: Heroism
abilities.description: You can gain great but temporary skills.

abilities.name: Finesse
abilities.description: You can speed up your combat.

abilities.name: Duel
abilities.description: You can enter into single combat with a foe.
Okawaru will gift you throwing weapons as you gain piety.

abilities.name: Receive Weapon
abilities.description: Okawaru will grant you a choice of weapons... once.

abilities.name: Receive Armour
abilities.description: Okawaru will grant you a choice of armour... once.

gods.name: Makhleb
gods.description: Makhleb the Destroyer is a fearsome deity of bloodshed and mortification of the flesh. Followers are expected to cleanse others by inflicting suffering and death on them in Makhleb's name. Dedicated followers may also access the raw energies and hell-spawned servants of chaos, so that they may better break the impure world and its false laws for their evil god's glory.

abilities.description: You can gain health from killing.

abilities.name: Unleash Destruction
abilities.description: You can unleash Makhleb's destructive might.

abilities.name: Infernal Servant
abilities.description: You can summon an infernal servant of Makhleb.

abilities.name: Accept (null)
abilities.description: Makhleb will allow you to brand your body with an infernal mark... once.

gods.name: Sif Muna
gods.description: Sif Muna the Loreminder is a contemplative but powerful deity, served by those who seek magical knowledge. Followers who tirelessly pursue new horizons can call upon the Loreminder for magical power and the ability to cast spells beyond their magical training. The devout are rewarded with a supply of spellbooks taken directly from Sif Muna's legendary library.

abilities.name: Channel Magic
abilities.description: You can call upon Sif Muna for magical energy.

abilities.name: Forget Spell
abilities.description: You can freely open your mind to new spells.

abilities.name: Divine Exegesis
abilities.description: You can call upon Sif Muna to cast any spell from your library.
Sif Muna will gift you books as you gain piety.

gods.name: Trog
gods.description: Trog is an ancient god of anger and violence. Followers are expected to kill in Trog's name, and especially to slay wizards. In return, worshippers of Trog gain the ability to go berserk at will in combat, and will be granted assistance in the form of powerful weapons and mighty allies. Followers are absolutely forbidden the use of spell magic.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: You can go berserk at will.

abilities.name: Trog's Hand
abilities.description: You can call upon Trog for regeneration and willpower.

abilities.name: Brothers in Arms
abilities.description: You can call in reinforcements.
Trog will gift you melee weapons as you gain piety.

gods.name: Nemelex Xobeh
gods.description: Nemelex is a strange and unpredictable chaotic trickster god, whose powers are invoked through magical packs of cards painted in the ichor of demons. Followers will be granted decks of cards as they traverse the dungeon, and are encouraged to trust in the cards to provide them with divine assistance. However, the Trickster can also ensure that fortune favours the bold.

abilities.description: You can draw from decks of power.
Nemelex will gift you decks of power as you gain piety.

abilities.name: Triple Draw
abilities.description: You can choose one out of three cards.

abilities.name: Deal Four
abilities.description: You can deal four cards at a time.

abilities.name: Stack Five
abilities.description: You can stack five cards from your decks.

gods.name: Elyvilon
gods.description: Elyvilon the Healer welcomes all kind souls prepared to help others. Those individuals can expect to gain powerful healing abilities, by which they can avoid bloodshed. Elyvilon appreciates exploration of the dungeon. Elyvilon's followers can convert to the Shining One or Zin while keeping some piety.

abilities.description: Elyvilon prevents you from doing harm to neutral creatures.

abilities.name: Purification
abilities.description: You can purify yourself.

abilities.name: Pacify
abilities.description: You can attempt to pacify hostile creatures.

abilities.name: Heal Self
abilities.description: You can provide healing for yourself.

abilities.name: Divine Alms
abilities.description: You can comfort your suffering allies.

abilities.name: Aura of Vigour
abilities.description: You can call upon Elyvilon for divine vigour.

gods.name: Lugonu
gods.description: Banished to the chaotic realm of the Abyss, Lugonu the Unformed seeks followers to spread bloodshed and corruption in the overworld. Those who gain Lugonu's favour will be granted some of the power of the Abyss itself, allowing them to call forth eldritch horrors, and even to travel between the overworld and the Abyss at will.

abilities.description: Lugonu protects you from the effects of unwielding distortion weapons.
Lugonu may banish nearby foes when other gods try to punish you.

abilities.name: Depart the Abyss
abilities.description: You can depart the Abyss.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.description: You can banish your foes.

abilities.name: Corrupt
abilities.description: You can corrupt the fabric of space.

abilities.name: Enter the Abyss
abilities.description: You can gate yourself to the Abyss.

abilities.name: Brand Weapon With Distortion
abilities.description: Lugonu will corrupt your weapon with distortion... once.

gods.name: Beogh
gods.description: A god of outcasts, pariahs, and the dispossessed, Beogh's altars are rarely found among those of other faiths, but Beogh's missionaries may always be sought by those looking for a place to belong. Worshippers will find many friends within the dungeon, and those who prove their strength to Beogh may gain lifelong companions the equal of any adventurer. To worship Beogh is to believe there is strength that transcends species and bloodline. To worship Beogh is to be an orc.

abilities.name: Smiting
abilities.description: You can smite your foes.

abilities.name: Recall Apostles
abilities.description: You can recall your apostles.
Beogh will send orc apostles to challenge you in battle as you gain piety.
You can recruit apostles that you defeat into your service.
Your apostles are sometimes healed when you deal damage.
You can walk on water.

abilities.name: Blood for Blood
abilities.description: You can rally a vengeful horde.

gods.name: Jiyva
gods.description: Jiyva is the ancient deity of the slimes. Followers are expected to support the spread and satiation of their fellow slimes by allowing them to consume items, and are prevented from harming any slimes. Especially favoured followers will become as shapeless as their god, mutating wildly.

abilities.description: Jiyva protects you from corrosive effects.
Jiyva will mutate your body as you gain piety.

abilities.name: Oozemancy
abilities.description: You can call acidic ooze from nearby walls.

abilities.name: Slimify
abilities.description: You can turn your foes to slime.
You may expel jellies when seriously injured.

gods.name: Fedhas
gods.description: Fedhas is the god of plant and fungal life. Followers are prevented from harming any species under Fedhas' protection. In return, Fedhas grants a number of abilities that promote the growth of plants and fungi. These abilities may incidentally prove useful to adventurers.

abilities.description: You can walk through plants and fire through allied plants.

abilities.name: Wall of Briars
abilities.description: You can encircle yourself with summoned briar patches.

abilities.name: Grow Ballistomycete
abilities.description: You can grow a ballistomycete.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: You can transform dungeon walls and trees into plant allies.

abilities.name: Grow Oklob
abilities.description: You can grow an oklob plant.

gods.name: Cheibriados
gods.description: Cheibriados is a god of deliberation. Those following Cheibriados travel more slowly the further they progress in their faith, and are forbidden from using any means to hasten themselves. In the process of so imitating their god, they attain perfection of mind and body, and the mysteries of time unfold before them. Especially devout followers may even momentarily abandon the flow of time and its needless disturbances.

abilities.description: Cheibriados slows the effects of poison on you.

abilities.name: Bend Time
abilities.description: You can bend time to slow others.

abilities.name: Temporal Distortion
abilities.description: You can warp the flow of time around you.

abilities.name: Slouch
abilities.description: You can inflict damage on those overly hasty.

abilities.name: Step From Time
abilities.description: You can step out of the flow of time.

gods.name: Ashenzari
gods.description: While it seems inconceivable that the divine could be shackled, Ashenzari is just that: bound to the sky for eternity, the unbudging god is all-knowing, all-seeing. Devoted worshippers are allowed to grasp shreds of this knowledge and foresight, but be warned: to Ashenzari, power and blessing and curse are all the same thing.

abilities.description:
Ashenzari warns you of distant threats and treasures.
Ashenzari shows you where magical portals lie.
Ashenzari identifies your possessions.
Ashenzari reveals the unseen.
Ashenzari keeps your mind clear.
Ashenzari protects you from the dungeon's malevolent forces.
Ashenzari reveals the structure of the nearby dungeon.

gods.name: Dithmenos
gods.description: Dithmenos is the god of night and of things half-seen in flickering torchlight. Worshipped by actors as often as thieves, followers of Dithmenos can learn to control their own shadow as if it were an extension of their body - misdirecting onlookers and acting upon the world with force as tangible as anything that has ever been imagined lurking in the dark.

abilities.description: Dithmenos quiets all noise in your surroundings.
Your shadow sometimes tangibly mimics your actions.

abilities.name: Shadowslip
abilities.description: You can mislead enemies by swapping places with your shadow.

abilities.name: Aphotic Marionette
abilities.description: You can unleash an enemy's spells as if they were a marionette.

abilities.name: Primordial Nightfall
abilities.description: You can surround yourself with impenetrable night.

gods.name: Gozag
gods.description: Gozag Ym Sagoz the Greedy teaches that the world belongs to the rich. Those accepting this principle may exchange their gold for divine assistance. Followers of Gozag do not earn piety; the only way to impress this god is by amassing a fortune, and worshippers may request as much assistance as they can afford. Fortunately, Gozag's worshippers are said to have the touch of gold.

abilities.description: Gozag turns your defeated foes' bodies to gold.
Your enemies may become distracted by gold.

abilities.name: Potion Petition
abilities.description: You can petition Gozag for potion effects.

abilities.name: Call Merchant
abilities.description: You can fund merchants seeking to open stores in the dungeon.

abilities.name: Bribe Branch
abilities.description: You can bribe branches to halt enemies' attacks and recruit allies.

gods.name: Qazlal
gods.description: Qazlal Stormbringer is a violent god of tempests, who delights in unleashing the forces of nature against the unsuspecting. Those who invite Qazlal's gaze will find themselves the eye in a storm of elemental destruction, from which only their God can protect them. Pious worshippers of Qazlal will gain the ability to direct and control the destructive might of the storm.

abilities.description: Qazlal grants you and your divine allies immunity to clouds.
You are surrounded by a storm.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.description: You can call upon nature to destroy your foes.

abilities.name: Elemental Force
abilities.description: You can give life to nearby clouds.
The storm surrounding you is powerful enough to repel missiles.
You adapt resistances upon receiving elemental damage.

abilities.name: Disaster Area
abilities.description: You can call upon nature's wrath in a wide area around you.

gods.name: Ru
gods.description: Of all the gods, only Ru opposed creation. Not as folly, but as distraction. Initiates of Ru can open channels to the powers underlying the visible world by renouncing the fetters that bind them here. These sacrifices are not made to Ru, but rather given up freely and permanently. Having made such sacrifices, initiates will become able to draw upon this immense power to aid themselves, eventually gaining the ability to unleash its destructive might against their foes.

abilities.description: You now exude an aura of power that intimidates your foes.
Your aura of power can strike those that harm you.

abilities.name: Draw Out Power
abilities.description: You can heal your body and restore your magic.

abilities.name: Power Leap
abilities.description: You can gather your power into a mighty leap.

abilities.name: Apocalypse
abilities.description: You can wreak a terrible wrath on your foes.

gods.name: Pakellas
gods.description: Pakellas the Inventive believes in the supremacy of devices, magical or otherwise, over spells and other forms of magic. Followers, although cut off from ambient magical power, are provided with magical energy to empower their devices so long as they use them to assert Pakellas' supremacy. Pakellas will grant devout worshippers access to increasingly powerful devices.

abilities.description: Pakellas channels magical and device energy from your kills.

abilities.name: Quick Charge
abilities.description: You can recharge a wand or miscellaneous evokers.

abilities.name: Device Surge
abilities.description: You can surge your and your allies' next wand or device activation.

abilities.name: Capacitor Overcharge
abilities.description: You can overcharge a wand and unleash a capacitor storm.

gods.name: Uskayaw
gods.description: Uskayaw the Reveller is a god of ecstatic dance. In the dungeon, Uskayaw appreciates the passion and rhythm of combat, rewarding followers for each strike they deliver and for the damage they deal their foes. The longer the dance continues, the greater powers Uskayaw offers. When the dance ends, Uskayaw quickly loses interest.

abilities.name: Stomp
abilities.description: You can stomp with the beat.

abilities.name: Line Pass
abilities.description: You can pass through a line of other dancers.
Uskayaw will force your foes to helplessly watch your dance.
Uskayaw will force your foes to share their pain.

abilities.name: Grand Finale
abilities.description: You can merge with and destroy a victim.

gods.name: Hepliaklqana
gods.description: Hepliaklqana the Forgotten accepts the worship of those who would remember their forebears, and fight alongside the greatest of them all. Acolytes of Hepliaklqana sacrifice a small part of their life essence to manifest their ancestor into the world; as they explore and form new experiences, they will find themselves able to shape and control their ancestor's memory, eventually bringing them into the ranks of the mythical heroes.

abilities.description: Your ancestor manifests to aid you.

abilities.name: Recall Ancestor
abilities.description: You can recall your ancestor.

abilities.name: Ancestor Identity
abilities.description: You can remember your ancestor's identity.

abilities.name: Transference
abilities.description: You can swap creatures with your ancestor.

abilities.name: Idealise
abilities.description: You can heal and protect your ancestor.
You drain nearby creatures when transferring your ancestor.

gods.name: Wu Jian
gods.description: The Wu Jian Council is a congregation of martial monks, ascended to divinity after battling their way out of the afterlife. Disciples of the Council are able to execute acrobatic martial maneuvers, such as wall jumps, spinning attacks and punishing lunges. They will eventually become able to request help in the form of a storm of heavenly clouds.

abilities.description: You can perform damaging attacks by moving towards foes.
You can lightly attack monsters by moving around them.

abilities.name: Wall Jump
abilities.description: You can perform airborne attacks.

abilities.name: Serpent's Lash
abilities.description: You can briefly move at supernatural speeds.

abilities.name: Heavenly Storm
abilities.description: You can summon a storm of heavenly clouds to empower your attacks.

gods.name: Ignis
gods.description: Ignis the Dying Flame offers followers power over fire in many forms. All of Ignis' power is offered unconditionally to any who would deign to worship, but once used, it can never be replenished. Ignis' other worshippers deserted long ago; the divine fire burns low, and soon it will go out.

abilities.description: You are resistant to fire.

abilities.name: Fiery Armour
abilities.description: You can armour yourself in flame.

abilities.name: Foxfire Swarm
abilities.description: You can call a swarm of foxfires against your foes.

abilities.name: Rising Flame
abilities.description: You can rocket upward and away, once.

mutations.name: antennae
mutations.description: You have antennae, allowing you to sense nearby monsters, but preventing you from wearing helmets. Each level of this mutation lets you sense monsters from further away. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing any type of headgear, and allows you to see invisible monsters.
level_descriptions: You have a pair of small antennae on your head.
You have a pair of antennae on your head.
You have a pair of large antennae on your head. (SInv)

mutations.name: big wings
mutations.description: You have big, strong wings, capable of bearing you through the air.
level_descriptions: Your large and strong wings let you fly.

mutations.name: beak
mutations.description: You have a beak for a mouth, allowing you to peck at foes when launching melee attacks, but preventing you from wearing helmets.
level_descriptions: You have a beak for a mouth.

mutations.name: claws
mutations.description: You have sharp nails, increasing the strength of your main-hand unarmed attacks if you aren't wearing gloves. If your off-hand is free, the strength of your off-hand punch attacks is also increased. Each level of this mutation makes your nails sharper, longer, and stronger. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing gloves.
level_descriptions: You have sharp fingernails.
You have very sharp fingernails.
You have claws for hands.

mutations.name: fangs
mutations.description: You have sharp teeth, allowing you to bite foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation makes your teeth sharper, longer, and stronger.
level_descriptions: You have very sharp teeth.
You have extremely sharp teeth.
You have razor-sharp teeth.

mutations.name: hooves
mutations.description: You have hooves, allowing you to kick foes when launching melee attacks if you aren't wearing boots. Each level of this mutation makes your hooves harder and stronger. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing boots.
level_descriptions: You have large cloven feet.
You have hoof-like feet.
You have hooves in place of feet.

mutations.name: horns
mutations.description: You have horns on your head, allowing you to try to gore foes when launching melee attacks, but preventing you from wearing helmets. Each level of this mutation increases the damage of your gore attacks. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing any type of headgear.
level_descriptions: You have a pair of small horns on your head.
You have a pair of horns on your head.
You have a pair of large horns on your head.

mutations.name: stinger
mutations.description: You have a venomous barb on the end of your tail, allowing you to sting foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation makes your stinger sharper, longer, and stronger.
level_descriptions: Your tail ends in a venomous barb.
Your tail ends in a sharp venomous barb.
Your tail ends in a wickedly sharp and venomous barb.

mutations.name: talons
mutations.description: You have sharp toenails, allowing you to kick foes when launching melee attacks if you aren't wearing boots. Each level of this mutation makes your nails sharper, longer, and stronger. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing boots.
level_descriptions: You have sharp toenails.
You have razor-sharp toenails.
You have claws for feet.

mutations.name: tentacle spike
mutations.description: You have a spiked tentacle, allowing you to pierce foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation makes your spike sharper, longer, and stronger.
level_descriptions: One of your tentacles bears a spike.
One of your tentacles bears a nasty spike.
One of your tentacles bears a large vicious spike.

mutations.name: repulsion field
mutations.description: You are surrounded by a repulsion field, providing a small amount of evasion. Each level of this mutation provides more EV. The third level of this mutation also repels missiles, greatly increasing your EV against such attacks.
level_descriptions: You are surrounded by a mild repulsion field. (EV +2)
You are surrounded by a moderate repulsion field. (EV +3)
You are surrounded by a strong repulsion field. (EV +4, RMsl)

mutations.name: icy blue scales
mutations.description: You are covered in blue scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to cold.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in icy blue scales. (AC +2)
You are mostly covered in icy blue scales. (AC +3)
You are completely covered in icy blue scales. (AC +4, rC+)

mutations.name: iridescent scales
mutations.description: You are covered in iridescent scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +2 AC.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in iridescent scales. (AC +2)
You are mostly covered in iridescent scales. (AC +4)
You are completely covered in iridescent scales. (AC +6)

mutations.name: large bone plates
mutations.description: You are covered in bone plates, providing a small amount of shielding. Each level of this mutation provides more SH.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in large bone plates. (SH +4)
You are mostly covered in large bone plates. (SH +6)
You are completely covered in large bone plates. (SH +8)

mutations.name: molten scales
mutations.description: You are covered in molten scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to fire.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in molten scales. (AC +2)
You are mostly covered in molten scales. (AC +3)
You are completely covered in molten scales. (AC +4, rF+)

mutations.name: rugged brown scales
mutations.description: You are covered in brown scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC and also increases your health slightly.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in rugged brown scales. (AC +1, +3% HP)
You are mostly covered in rugged brown scales. (AC +2, +5% HP)
You are completely covered in rugged brown scales. (AC +3, +7% HP)

mutations.name: slimy green scales
mutations.description: You are covered in green scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to poison.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in slimy green scales. (AC +2)
You are mostly covered in slimy green scales. (AC +3)
You are completely covered in slimy green scales. (AC +4, rPois)

mutations.name: thin metallic scales
mutations.description: You are covered in metallic scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to electricity.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in thin metallic scales. (AC +2)
You are mostly covered in thin metallic scales. (AC +3)
You are completely covered in thin metallic scales. (AC +4, rElec)

mutations.name: thin skeletal structure
mutations.description: Your bones are light and porous. Each level of this mutation provides +2 Dexterity and Stealth+.
level_descriptions: You have a somewhat thin skeletal structure. (Dex +2, Stealth+)
You have a moderately thin skeletal structure. (Dex +4, Stealth++)
You have an unnaturally thin skeletal structure. (Dex +6, Stealth+++)

mutations.name: yellow scales
mutations.description: You are covered in yellow scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to acid and corrosion.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in yellow scales. (AC +2)
You are mostly covered in yellow scales. (AC +3)
You are completely covered in yellow scales. (AC +4, rCorr)

mutations.name: camouflage
mutations.description: Your skin changes colour to match your surroundings. Each level of this mutation provides Stealth+.
level_descriptions: Your skin changes colour to match your surroundings (Stealth+).
Your skin blends seamlessly with your surroundings (Stealth++).
Your skin perfectly mimics your surroundings (Stealth+++).

mutations.name: see invisible
mutations.description: You have supernaturally acute vision, allowing you to see monsters that are hidden from mundane sight. This has no effect on your accuracy otherwise.
level_descriptions: You have supernaturally acute vision. (SInv)

mutations.name: agile
mutations.description: Your reflexes have become unnaturally fast. Each level of this mutation provides +4 Dexterity, but the rest of your body can't keep up with your speed, giving -1 to both your Strength and Intelligence for each level.
level_descriptions: You are agile. (Dex +4, Str/Int -1)
You are very agile. (Dex +8, Str/Int -2)

mutations.name: clarity
mutations.description: Your mind is exceptionally clear, preventing you from becoming confused, mesmerised, or supernaturally afraid. You also cannot become involuntarily enraged.
level_descriptions: You possess an exceptional clarity of mind.

mutations.name: clever
mutations.description: Your mind has become unnaturally acute. Each level of this mutation provides +4 Intelligence, but all the blood flowing to your head weakens your constitution, giving -1 to both your Strength and Dexterity for each level.
level_descriptions: Your mind is acute. (Int +4, Str/Dex -1)
Your mind is very acute. (Int +8, Str/Dex -2)

mutations.name: clumsy
mutations.description: Your reflexes have become unnaturally clumsy. Each level of this mutation provides -3 Dexterity.
level_descriptions: You are clumsy. (Dex -3)
You are very clumsy. (Dex -6)

mutations.name: cold resistance
mutations.description: You resist cold. Each level of this mutation reduces the amount of damage taken from cold.
level_descriptions: You are cold resistant. (rC+)
You are very cold resistant. (rC++)
You are almost immune to the effects of cold. (rC+++)

mutations.name: deformed body
mutations.description: Your body is shaped in an inhuman way, somewhat reducing the amount of protection provided by body armour. This has no effect on protection provided by armour enchantments.
level_descriptions: Armour fits poorly on your strangely shaped body.

mutations.name: demonic guardian
mutations.description: When you are harmed, there is a chance that a demonic guardian will rush to aid you. The greater the damage done and the closer you are to death, the greater the odds. Each level of this mutation increases the strength of your guardians.
level_descriptions: A weak demonic guardian rushes to your aid.
A demonic guardian rushes to your aid.
A powerful demonic guardian rushes to your aid.

mutations.name: poor constitution
mutations.description: Your body reacts poorly to injury; when you suffer damage, you have a chance for your attacks to become weakened for a short while. The second level of this mutation sometimes additionally causes this to slow you as well.
level_descriptions: Your body sometimes grows weak upon taking damage.
Your body sometimes grows weak and slow upon taking damage.

mutations.name: dopey
mutations.description: Your mind has become unnaturally dopey. Each level of this mutation provides -3 Intelligence.
level_descriptions: You are dopey. (Int -3)
You are very dopey. (Int -6)

mutations.name: fire resistance
mutations.description: You resist heat. Each level of this mutation reduces the amount of damage taken from fire.
level_descriptions: You are heat resistant. (rF+)
You are very heat resistant. (rF++)
You are almost immune to the effects of heat. (rF+++)

mutations.name: hurl damnation
mutations.description: You can hurl damnation with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>. Foes beware!
level_descriptions: You can hurl damnation.

mutations.name: speed
mutations.description: You cover ground quickly - moving to new positions takes you less time. This has no effect on other types of actions, like attacking or casting spells. Each level of this mutation makes you move faster.
level_descriptions: You move with supernatural speed. (Speed+)
You move with supernatural speed. (Speed++)
You move with supernatural speed. (Speed+++)

mutations.name: frail
mutations.description: Your health is poor. Each level of this mutation worsens your health further (-10% HP).
