level_descriptions: You are frail. (-10% HP)
You are very frail. (-20% HP)
You are extremely frail. (-30% HP)

mutations.name: foul stench
mutations.description: Foes who strike you in melee sometimes cause you to emit a cloud of foul miasma, slowing and severely poisoning those caught within. This mutation also grants you immunity to miasma (from any source).
level_descriptions: You may rarely emit foul miasma when damaged in melee.
You sometimes emit foul miasma when damaged in melee.
You frequently emit foul miasma when damaged in melee.

mutations.name: high MP
mutations.description: You have an increased reservoir of magic. Each level of this mutation provides +10% MP.
level_descriptions: You have an increased reservoir of magic. (+10% MP)
You have a considerably increased reservoir of magic. (+20% MP)
You have a greatly increased reservoir of magic. (+30% MP)

mutations.name: icemail
mutations.description: You are coated in a protective layer of ice. Fiery attacks can temporarily melt the ice, removing the protection until the ice reforms. Each level of this mutation increases the protection imparted.
level_descriptions: A meltable icy envelope protects you from harm. (AC +0)
A meltable icy envelope protects you from harm. (AC +0)

mutations.name: ignite blood
mutations.description: Whenever you see blood spilled (yours or others'), it may ignite, bursting into a cloud of flame. Each level of this mutation makes this more likely. This mutation also grants you immunity to clouds of flame.
level_descriptions: Your demonic aura sometimes causes spilled blood to erupt in flames.
Your demonic aura often causes spilled blood to erupt in flames.
Your demonic aura causes all spilled blood to erupt in flames.

mutations.name: low MP
mutations.description: You have a low magical capacity. Each level of this mutation provides -10% MP.
level_descriptions: Your magical capacity is low. (-10% MP)
Your magical capacity is very low. (-20% MP)
Your magical capacity is extremely low. (-30% MP)

mutations.name: strong-willed
mutations.description: You have an unnaturally strong will, improving your resistance to certain types of hostile magic. Each level of this mutation increases your willpower further.
level_descriptions: You are strong-willed. (Will+)
You are highly strong-willed. (Will++)
You are extremely strong-willed. (Will+++)

mutations.name: mutation resistance
mutations.description: Your genetic code is unusually stable, making it less likely that you will be mutated (or have existing mutations removed). Each level of this mutation makes you more resistant.
level_descriptions: You are somewhat resistant to further mutation.
You are somewhat resistant to both further mutation and mutation removal.
You are almost entirely resistant to further mutation and mutation removal.

mutations.name: negative energy resistance
mutations.description: You resist negative energy. Each level of this mutation reduces the amount of damage taken from negative energy, along with the amount that it drains your health.
level_descriptions: You resist negative energy. (rN+)
You are quite resistant to negative energy. (rN++)
You are immune to negative energy. (rN+++)

mutations.name: nightstalker
mutations.description: You are attuned to the shadows, reducing the distance that you can see or be seen from.
level_descriptions: You are slightly more attuned to the shadows.
You are significantly more attuned to the shadows.
You are completely attuned to the shadows.

mutations.name: passive freeze
mutations.description: Foes who strike you in melee will be frozen, taking damage. This effect is guaranteed to trigger if your foe does any damage.
level_descriptions: A frigid envelope surrounds you and freezes all who hurt you.

mutations.name: sense surroundings
mutations.description: You have a second sense for the dungeon, allowing you to sense terrain you haven't yet seen. Each level of this mutation allows you to sense more and more thoroughly.
level_descriptions: You passively map the area around you.
You passively map a large area around you.

mutations.name: poison resistance
mutations.description: You resist poisons, toxins and other contaminants. This does not confer full immunity, but reduces your chances of being affected to roughly one-third what it would be otherwise.
level_descriptions: You are resistant to poisons. (rPois)

mutations.name: powered by death
mutations.description: Death fuels you, allowing you to heal somewhat for each life you take. Each level of this mutation increases the healing further.
level_descriptions: You regenerate a little health from kills.
You regenerate health from kills.
You regenerate a lot of health from kills.

mutations.name: powered by pain
mutations.description: When you are harmed, you sometimes gain power, refilling your magical reservoir or granting you temporary agility or might. Each level of this mutation increases the magnitude of this effect.
level_descriptions: You sometimes gain a little power by taking damage.
You sometimes gain power by taking damage.
You are powered by pain.

mutations.name: regeneration
mutations.description: You heal quickly. Each level of this mutation increases the rate at which you heal.
level_descriptions: Your natural rate of healing is unusually fast.
You heal very quickly.
You regenerate.

mutations.name: robust
mutations.description: You can take a beating. Each level of this mutation improves your health further (+10% HP).
level_descriptions: You are robust. (+10% HP)
You are very robust. (+20% HP)
You are extremely robust. (+30% HP)

mutations.name: screaming
mutations.description:
You are sometimes seized by an uncontrollable urge to scream whenever you sustain an injury. All of your shouts are also louder than usual.

The second level of this mutation makes this urge harder to resist and makes your shouts even louder.
level_descriptions: You occasionally shout uncontrollably at those who injure you.
You frequently scream uncontrollably at those who injure you.

mutations.name: shaggy fur
mutations.description: You are covered in fur, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to cold.
level_descriptions: You are covered in fur. (AC +1)
You are covered in thick fur. (AC +2)
Your thick and shaggy fur keeps you warm. (AC +3, rC+)

mutations.name: electricity resistance
mutations.description: You resist electricity (rElec), taking less damage from it.
level_descriptions: You are resistant to electric shocks. (rElec)

mutations.name: slowness
mutations.description: You cover ground slowly - moving to new positions takes you more time. This has no effect on other types of actions, like attacking or casting spells. Each level of this mutation makes you move slower.
level_descriptions: You cover ground slowly.
You cover ground very slowly.
You cover ground extremely slowly.

mutations.name: inhibited regeneration
mutations.description: You do not heal over time while foes are in sight. Other sources of healing, such as potions, are unaffected.
level_descriptions: You do not regenerate when monsters are visible.

mutations.name: spiny
mutations.description: Foes who strike you in melee have a 50% chance of being impaled on your spines, taking damage. Each level of this mutation increases the damage. This mutation also grants you immunity to constriction.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in sharp spines.
You are mostly covered in sharp spines.
You are completely covered in sharp spines.

mutations.name: spit poison
mutations.description: You can spit poison with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>. The second level of this mutation intensifies the poison from a single glob into a large cloud.
level_descriptions: You can spit poison.
You can exhale a cloud of poison.

mutations.name: strong
mutations.description: Your muscles have grown unnaturally strong. Each level of this mutation provides +4 Strength, but the extra muscles slow your movements and thoughts, giving -1 to both your Intelligence and Dexterity for each level.
level_descriptions: You are strong. (Str +4, Int/Dex -1)
You are very strong. (Str +8, Int/Dex -2)

mutations.name: teleportitis
mutations.description:
You periodically teleport towards hostile monsters. You will sense yourself destabilising several turns in advance of this happening, and may suppress it temporarily by reading a scroll of teleportation.

Each level of this mutation increases the frequency with which you start to teleport.
level_descriptions: You are occasionally teleported next to monsters.
You are often teleported next to monsters.

mutations.name: torment resistance
mutations.description: You are less affected by unholy torment, which would otherwise cut your health in half. The second level of this mutation renders you entirely immune.
level_descriptions: You are resistant to unholy torment.
You are immune to unholy pain and torment.

mutations.name: tough skin
mutations.description: Your epidermis has hardened, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC.
level_descriptions: You have tough skin. (AC +1)
You have very tough skin. (AC +2)
You have extremely tough skin. (AC +3)

mutations.name: weak
mutations.description: Your muscles have grown unnaturally weak. Each level of this mutation provides -3 Strength.
level_descriptions: You are weak. (Str -3)
You are very weak. (Str -6)

mutations.name: wild magic
mutations.description: Your spells are slightly harder to cast (increased miscast chance and severity), but more powerful. Each level of this mutation increases both effects further.
level_descriptions: Your spells are a little harder to cast, but a little more powerful.
Your spells are harder to cast, but more powerful.
Your spells are much harder to cast, but much more powerful.

mutations.name: acidic bite
mutations.description: You have acidic saliva, allowing you to bite foes and apply corrosion to them when launching melee attacks.
level_descriptions: You have acidic saliva.

mutations.name: eyeballs
mutations.description: Golden eyeballs sprout from your flesh like mushrooms, confusing your foes. Each level of this mutation improves your accuracy with weapons, unarmed attacks, auxiliary attacks, and spells. The third level of this mutation also allows you to see invisible foes.
level_descriptions: Your body has grown eyes which may confuse attackers. (Acc +3)
Your body has grown many eyes which may confuse attackers. (Acc +5)
Your body is covered in eyes which may confuse attackers. (Acc +7, SInv)

mutations.name: gelatinous body
mutations.description: Your body is rubbery, and your foes like glue. Each level of this mutation confers +1 AC and +1 EV.
level_descriptions: Your rubbery body absorbs attacks. (AC +1, EV +1)
Your pliable body absorbs attacks. (AC +2, EV +2)
Your gelatinous body deflects attacks. (AC +3, EV +3)

mutations.name: pseudopods
mutations.description: You are covered in pseudopods, allowing you to slap your foes when launching melee attacks, but somewhat reducing the amount of protection provided by body armour. This has no effect on protection provided by armour enchantments. Each level of this mutation makes your pseudopods larger and stronger.
level_descriptions: Armour fits poorly on your pseudopods.
Armour fits poorly on your large pseudopods.
Armour fits poorly on your massive pseudopods.

mutations.name: translucent skin
mutations.description: Your skin is transparent, improving your stealth and reducing the accuracy of your foes' attacks against you. Each level of this mutation reduces your foes' accuracy further.
level_descriptions: Your translucent skin slightly reduces your foes' accuracy. (Stealth+)
Your translucent skin reduces your foes' accuracy. (Stealth+)
Your transparent skin significantly reduces your foes' accuracy. (Stealth+)

mutations.name: evolution
mutations.description: As you gain experience, your body's hidden potential will express itself in the form of new beneficial mutations.
level_descriptions: You have hidden genetic potential.
You have great hidden genetic potential.

mutations.name: augmentation
mutations.description: While in good health, you are more powerful, casting spells and slaying foes more effectively. Each level of this mutation increases this effect further.
level_descriptions: Your magical and physical power is slightly enhanced at high health.
Your magical and physical power is enhanced at high health.
Your magical and physical power is greatly enhanced at high health.

mutations.name: tendrils
mutations.description: When struck in melee, the slimy tendrils covering your body may grab your attacker's weapon and yank it from their grasp, disarming them.
level_descriptions: You are covered in slimy tendrils that may disarm your opponents.

mutations.name: jelly sensing items
mutations.description: You have a small jelly attached to you that senses nearby items.
level_descriptions: You have a small jelly attached to you that senses nearby items.

mutations.name: jelly absorbing missiles
mutations.description: When struck by a missile (such as an arrow or crossbow bolt), a jelly on your body may eat it, healing you somewhat.
level_descriptions: You have a small jelly attached to you that may absorb projectiles.

mutations.name: magic shield
mutations.description: When you are harmed, some damage is redirected to deplete your magic reserves instead.
level_descriptions: When hurt, damage is shared between your health and your magic reserves.

mutations.name: magic regeneration
mutations.description: Your magical reserves regenerate quickly.
level_descriptions: You regenerate magic rapidly.

mutations.name: magic link
mutations.description: When low on magic, you restore magic in place of health.
level_descriptions: When low on magic, you restore magic in place of health.

mutations.name: stone body
mutations.description: You are made of living stone which is very resistant to damage. You gain a large bonus to your AC, which increases with your experience level, and are immune to petrification, poison, disease, sleep, and certain other effects.
level_descriptions: Your stone body is resiliant and immune to petrification. (AC +2)

mutations.name: antimagic bite
mutations.description: You have a thirst for magic, allowing you to bite foes when launching melee attacks. This restores your magical reserves and also disrupts magical foes, sometimes leaving them unable to act.
level_descriptions: Your bite disrupts and absorbs the magic of your enemies.

mutations.name: no potion heal
mutations.description: Your system is resistant to potable panaceas, reducing the effectiveness of all kinds of healing potions. The second level of this mutation completely blocks potion-based healing. (Aid from the god Gozag is unaffected.)
level_descriptions: Potions are less effective at restoring your health.
Potions cannot restore your health.

mutations.name: cold vulnerability
mutations.description: You are vulnerable to cold and take more damage from it.
level_descriptions: You are vulnerable to cold. (rC-)
You are very vulnerable to cold. (rC--)
You are extremely vulnerable to cold. (rC---)

mutations.name: heat vulnerability
mutations.description: You are vulnerable to fire and take more damage from it.
level_descriptions: You are vulnerable to heat. (rF-)
You are very vulnerable to heat. (rF--)
You are extremely vulnerable to heat. (rF---)

mutations.name: black mark
mutations.description: When you strike a foe in melee, the black mark on your body may debilitate them. This can weaken foes, drain their health, or disrupt their magic.
level_descriptions: Your melee attacks may debilitate your foes.

mutations.name: electricity vulnerability
mutations.description: You are vulnerable to electricity and take more damage from it.
level_descriptions: You are vulnerable to electric shocks. (rElec-)

mutations.name: cold-blooded
mutations.description: When struck by a cold attack, you may be slowed until your blood warms again.
level_descriptions: You are cold-blooded and may be slowed by cold attacks.

mutations.name: freezing cloud immunity
mutations.description: You are immune to freezing clouds.
level_descriptions: You are immune to freezing clouds.

mutations.name: flame cloud immunity
mutations.description: You are immune to clouds of flame.
level_descriptions: You are immune to clouds of flame.

mutations.name: forlorn
mutations.description: You cannot, will not, and will never worship any god.
level_descriptions: You shall have no god before yourself.

mutations.name: subdued magic
mutations.description: Your spells are slightly easier to cast (reduced miscast chance and severity), but less powerful. Each level of this mutation increases both effects further.
level_descriptions: Your spells are a little easier to cast, but a little less powerful.
Your spells are easier to cast, but less powerful.
Your spells are much easier to cast, but much less powerful.

mutations.name: renounce potions
mutations.description: You refuse to drink potions in combat unless badly injured. While enemies are in your line of sight (and for several turns afterward), you will be unable to drink anything unless your HP is below 50% of its maximum.
level_descriptions: You refuse to drink potions in combat unless seriously injured.

mutations.name: renounce scrolls
mutations.description: You refuse to read scrolls in combat unless badly injured. While enemies are in your line of sight (and for several turns afterward), you will be unable to read anything unless your HP is below 50% of its maximum.
level_descriptions: You refuse to read scrolls in combat unless seriously injured.

mutations.name: missing a hand
mutations.description: You are considerably less handy than you used to be. You cannot wield two-handed weapons, wear a shield, launch off-handed attacks, or use more than one magical ring at a time.
level_descriptions: You are missing a hand.

mutations.name: no stealth
mutations.description: You have no Stealth. You will always alert monsters when they see you, and they will track you very effectively.
level_descriptions: You cannot be stealthy.

mutations.name: inability to use devices
mutations.description: You cannot use magical devices. This includes wands and most items evoked with <input>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</input>, excepting reaching weapons, talismans, and ziggurat figurines. This also renders magical staves much less effective in melee.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or use magical devices.

mutations.name: hated by all
mutations.description: You are hated by all and cannot acquire allies, temporarily or permanently, by any means. Simplistic, unthinking magical constructs, such as spectral weapons, orbs of destruction, and battlespheres, are unaffected.
level_descriptions: You are hated by all.

mutations.name: cowardly
mutations.description: Seeing threatening monsters fills you with dread, reducing the power of your spells and your ability to slay monsters with melee and ranged attacks. Seeing multiple such monsters at once, or extremely threatening monsters, renders this even worse.
level_descriptions: Your cowardice makes you less effective in combat with threatening foes.

mutations.name: inability to train dodging
mutations.description: Your Dodging skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot train Dodging skill.

mutations.name: inability to train armour
mutations.description: Your Armour skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot train Armour skill.

mutations.name: no air magic
mutations.description: Your Air Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Air magic.

mutations.name: no conjurations magic
mutations.description: Your Conjurations skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Conjurations magic.

mutations.name: no earth magic
mutations.description: Your Earth Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Earth magic.

mutations.name: no fire magic
mutations.description: Your Fire Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Fire magic.

mutations.name: no hexes magic
mutations.description: Your Hexes skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Hexes magic.

mutations.name: no ice magic
mutations.description: Your Ice Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Ice magic.

mutations.name: no necromancy magic
mutations.description: Your Necromancy skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Necromancy magic.

mutations.name: no alchemy magic
mutations.description: Your Alchemy skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Alchemy magic.

mutations.name: no summoning magic
mutations.description: Your Summoning skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Summoning magic.

mutations.name: no translocations magic
mutations.description: Your Translocations skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Translocations magic.

mutations.name: reduced AC
mutations.description: You are easily battered and bruised, reducing the benefits of your armour.
level_descriptions: You take slightly more damage. (AC -5)
You take more damage. (AC -10)
You take considerably more damage. (AC -15)

mutations.name: reduced EV
mutations.description: Your reflexes are slow, making it easier for foes to hit you.
level_descriptions: You have somewhat slow reflexes. (EV -5)
You have slow reflexes. (EV -10)
You have very slow reflexes. (EV -15)

mutations.name: weak-willed
mutations.description: You have an unnaturally weak will, reducing your resistance to certain types of hostile magic. Each level of this mutation reduces your willpower further.
level_descriptions: You are slightly weak-willed. (Will-)
You are weak-willed. (Will--)
You are extremely weak-willed. (Will---)

mutations.name: disrupted magic
mutations.description: Your chance to miscast spells is higher. Each level of this sacrifice increases the chance to miscast further.
level_descriptions: Your casting is slightly disrupted.
Your casting is disrupted.
Your casting is seriously disrupted.

mutations.name: MP-powered wands
mutations.description: Your wands draw upon your magical reserves, becoming somewhat more powerful in the process. If you have no magic left to draw upon, your wands function as normal.
level_descriptions: You expend magic power (3 MP) to strengthen your wands.

mutations.name: unskilled
mutations.description: It takes you more experience to improve your skills. Each level of this sacrifice makes your skills cost even more.
level_descriptions: You are somewhat unskilled. (-1 Apt)
You are unskilled. (-2 Apt)
You are extremely unskilled. (-3 Apt)

mutations.name: inexperienced
mutations.description: You are inexperienced and unable to fully gain 27 levels.
level_descriptions: You are somewhat inexperienced. (-1 XL)
You are inexperienced. (-2 XL)
You are extremely inexperienced. (-3 XL)

mutations.name: stealthy paws
mutations.description: When launching attacks on unaware or incapacitated enemies, you inflict extra damage in the same way as a human with a short blade might.
level_descriptions: Your paws help you pounce on unaware monsters.

mutations.name: in touch with death
mutations.description: Your Necromancy spells are more powerful. The second level of this mutation enhances your Necromancy spellpower further.
level_descriptions: You are in touch with the powers of death.
You are strongly in touch with the powers of death.

mutations.name: naga tail
mutations.description:
You have a long, snake-like tail in place of feet. This gives you stability in water, but causes you to move much more slowly than most species.

The second level of this mutation allows you to constrict foes with your tail when attacking in melee. Your tail can constrict only one enemy at a time, and every attack at this mutation level will begin or renew a constriction attempt. The chances of succeeding are determined primarily by Dexterity, Fighting skill, and any slaying bonuses.
level_descriptions: Your snake-like lower body moves slowly.
Your snake-like lower body moves slowly, but can constrict enemies.

mutations.name: evasive flight
mutations.description: You fly evasively through the air, increasing your evasion somewhat.
level_descriptions: Your magical flight helps you evade attacks. (EV +4)

mutations.name: missing an eye
mutations.description: You are missing an eye, reducing the accuracy of your physical and magical attacks.
level_descriptions: You are missing an eye, making it more difficult to aim.

mutations.name: temperature sensitive
mutations.description: You are vulnerable to both cold and fire, and you take more damage from those effects.
level_descriptions: You are sensitive to extremes of temperature. (rF-, rC-)

mutations.name: sturdy frame
mutations.description: Your movements are less encumbered by armour, mitigating penalties to spell success, evasion, and ranged weapon attack speed. Each level of this mutation reduces armour ER by 2.
level_descriptions: Your movements are slightly less encumbered by armour. (ER -2)
Your movements are less encumbered by armour. (ER -4)
Your movements are significantly less encumbered by armour. (ER -6)

mutations.name: sanguine armour
mutations.description: When seriously injured, your blood congeals around you, forming armour. Each level of this mutation increases the AC provided.
level_descriptions: When seriously injured, your blood forms armour. (AC +0)
When seriously injured, your blood forms thick armour. (AC +0)
When seriously injured, your blood forms very thick armour. (AC +0)

mutations.name: frog-like legs
mutations.description:
Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an eye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is below average.

The second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.
level_descriptions: You can hop short distances, but move slowly.
You can hop long distances, but move slowly.

mutations.name: no regeneration
mutations.description: You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the effects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. Sources of HP gain such as potions and religious invocations will still heal you, and certain divine invocations can temporarily grant you the ability to regenerate. To compensate, you are able to heal yourself via the <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> key, at the cost of permanent MP.
level_descriptions: You do not regenerate.

mutations.name: treasure sense
mutations.description: You have an uncanny knack for knowing where items can be found. As you explore the dungeon, nearby item locations that you cannot directly see will gain a marker for as-yet-undiscovered items.
level_descriptions: You have an uncanny knack for detecting items.

mutations.name: acid resistance
mutations.description: You resist acid (rCorr), taking less damage from it. You are also less likely to become corroded.
level_descriptions: You are resistant to acid. (rCorr)

mutations.name: armoured tail
mutations.description: You have a large scaly tail, allowing you to tail-slap foes when launching melee attacks.
level_descriptions: You have an armoured tail.
You have a heavy armoured tail.

mutations.name: big brain
mutations.description: What's up? You have a big brain. Each level of this mutation provides +2 Intelligence. The third level of this mutation also makes you less likely to miscast spells.
level_descriptions: You have an unusually large brain. (Int +2)
You have an extremely huge brain. (Int +4)
You have an absolutely massive brain. (Int +6, Wiz)

mutations.name: sharp scales
mutations.description: You are covered in sharp scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC and Slay +1, improving your accuracy and damage with melee and ranged attacks.
level_descriptions: You are partially covered in razor-sharp scales. (AC +1, Slay +1)
You are mostly covered in razor-sharp scales. (AC +2, Slay +2)
You are completely covered in razor-sharp scales. (AC +3, Slay +3)

mutations.name: condensation shield
mutations.description: A shield of frost guards you, blocking some incoming attacks. Fiery attacks can temporarily melt the shield.
level_descriptions: A meltable shield of frost defends you. (SH +0)

mutations.name: demonic magic
mutations.description: When you cast spells, there's a chance that adjacent monsters will be paralysed. This effect is more powerful when casting higher-level spells, but monsters with greater willpower can resist it. Each level of this mutation allows more distant monsters to be affected. The third level of this mutation also allows you to paralyse monsters in the same way while zapping wands.
level_descriptions: Spells you cast may paralyse adjacent enemies.
Spells you cast may paralyse nearby enemies.
Spells you cast and wands you use may paralyse nearby enemies.

mutations.name: four strong arms
mutations.description: You have two pairs of two arms, allowing you to wield two-handed weapons with one pair and a shield with the other, as well as wear a second pair of gloves. You can even wield extremely large weapons like giant clubs, though this takes both arm-pairs.
level_descriptions: Your four strong arms can wield two-handed weapons with a shield.

mutations.name: no potions
mutations.description: You are unable to quaff potions.
level_descriptions: You cannot drink.

mutations.name: retaliatory headbutt
mutations.description: When a foe misses you in melee, you may reflexively retaliate, attempting to gore your attacker with your horns. You can perform this against a given enemy no more than once per player action.
level_descriptions: You reflexively headbutt those who attack you in melee.

mutations.name: steam resistance
mutations.description: You are immune to the damage from steam breath and steam clouds.
level_descriptions: You are immune to the effects of steam.

mutations.name: no weapons or thrown items
mutations.description: You are incapable of wielding weapons or throwing items.
level_descriptions: You are incapable of wielding weapons or throwing items.

mutations.name: no armour
mutations.description: You cannot wear armour.
level_descriptions: You cannot wear armour.

mutations.name: multi-lived
mutations.description: Every third experience level, you gain an extra life. If you are slain while you still have a life remaining, you will reappear elsewhere on the current floor. You can continue to gain extra lives even once you reach the maximum experience level, but you can't have more than two extra lives at a time.
level_descriptions: You gain extra lives every three experience levels.

mutations.name: distributed training
mutations.description: Whenever you gain experience, it is split between all of your skills. You cannot choose to focus. Effects that prevent you from training certain skills, such as divine restrictions, do not cause your other skills to rise faster.
level_descriptions: Your experience applies equally to all skills.

mutations.name: nimble swimmer
mutations.description: You can blend into the waves while swimming through water or flying above it, gaining Stealth+. The second level of this mutation also grants you improved evasion and increases your movement speed when in or above water.
level_descriptions: You are camouflaged when in or above water. (Stealth+)
You are very nimble when in or above water. (Stealth+, EV+, Speed+++)

mutations.name: tentacles
mutations.description:
Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow or deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in melee. Each tentacle can wear a ring, but you need four of them to move around, and either two or four tentacles to hold a weapon depending on its size, and two tentacles to hold a shield.

Your tentacles will try to constrict foes which you attack in melee. (You cannot constrict monsters larger than you.) Independently, you have a two-thirds chance of launching a damaging 'squeeze' attack whenever you attack in melee.
level_descriptions: You have tentacles for arms and can constrict enemies.

mutations.name: mertail
mutations.description: Your morphogenic matrix is unstable, allowing your lower body to shift to a powerful aquatic tail when in shallow or deep water. It will quickly reform into legs once you leave the water. When in merform, your tail allows you to tail-slap foes when launching melee attacks.
level_descriptions: Your lower body shifts to a powerful aquatic tail in water.

mutations.name: float
mutations.description: You hover through the air, forever free from the surly bonds of earth.
level_descriptions: You float through the air rather than walking.

mutations.name: innate caster
mutations.description: You cannot learn spells from books. Instead, as you gain experience, spells of higher and higher level bubble up from your fiery heart. These spells are unpredictable and unaffected by your choice of god. You cannot train specific spell schools - you can either train all spell schools at once, or none.
level_descriptions: You learn spells naturally, not from books.

mutations.name: HP casting
mutations.description: You have no separate reserve of magical power, and anything that would affect MP has no effect on you. When casting spells, using abilities, or doing anything else that *costs* MP for normal species, you spend HP instead.
level_descriptions: Your magical power is your life essence.

mutations.name: extra vitality
mutations.description: You are built differently from most species, making you slightly harder to kill. Each level of this mutation increases your maximum health by 4 points.
level_descriptions: You have superior vitality. (+4 MHP)
You have much superior vitality. (+8 MHP)
You have exceptionally superior vitality. (+12 MHP)

mutations.name: ooze flood
mutations.description: Your melee attacks may flood the airways of your foes with ooze. Those that need to breathe air will be silenced and take asphyxiation damage over time.
level_descriptions: Your melee attacks may flood your foes with ooze.

mutations.name: bedevilling
mutations.description: You cast Hex spells with increased power.
level_descriptions: Your hexes are more powerful.

mutations.name: aura of silence
mutations.description: You are surrounded by an aura of silence. Those adjacent to you cannot make any sound. This prevents most forms of spellcasting and prayer, though demonic magic, being noiseless, is unaffected.
level_descriptions: You are surrounded by an aura of silence.

mutations.name: corrupting presence
mutations.description: When you injure a foe, your presence may intensify the damage, corroding their weapons and defences. The second level of this mutation makes matters even worse, adding a chance that your wretched victims may become mutated and deformed.
level_descriptions: Your presence sometimes corrodes those you injure.
Your presence sometimes corrodes or deforms those you injure.

mutations.name: word of chaos
mutations.description: You can speak a Word of Chaos with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>.
level_descriptions: You can speak a Word of Chaos.

mutations.name: demonic willpower
mutations.description: Your willpower has a will of its own, sometimes injuring those who attempt to hex you. This mutation also bolsters your willpower.
level_descriptions: You punish those that try to bend your will. (Will+)

mutations.name: +LOS
mutations.description: The darkness flees at your approach, allowing an extended range of vision and ranged attack (+1 line of sight), but also allowing you to be seen and potentially targeted from further away.
level_descriptions: You have an extended range of vision and can be seen from far away.

mutations.name: devolution
mutations.description: As you gain experience, your body's hidden potential will express itself in the form of new detrimental mutations.
level_descriptions: You have hidden genetic defects.
You have terrible hidden genetic defects.

mutations.name: weakness stinger
mutations.description: You have a thin, orange tail, allowing you to attack foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation increases your tail's strength as it turns into a sharp stinger. The third level of this mutation prevents wearing cloaks or scarves, and causes the stinger to inflict brief weakness on those struck.
level_descriptions: You have a small tail.
You have a tail ending in a sharp stinger.
You have a sharp stinger which inflicts weakening toxins.

mutations.name: demonic touch
mutations.description: Your hands glow with unholy energy, allowing you to inflict irresistible damage when launching melee attacks as long as your off-hand is free. Your touch attacks deal damage which ignores armour, and each level of this mutation increases the damage dealt. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing gloves, and also causes your touch attacks to reduce your foes' willpower.
level_descriptions: Your touch may inflict minor irresistible damage on your foes.
Your touch may inflict irresistible damage on your foes.
Your touch may irresistibly damage your foes and sap their willpower.

mutations.name: divine attributes
mutations.description: Your divine heritage dramatically boosts your attribute gain (Strength, Intelligence, and Dexterity) as you level up relative to other species, both in quantity and in how much you can control your development. Every three levels, you choose an attribute to increase by four points.
level_descriptions: Your divine heritage dramatically boosts your attributes as you level up.

mutations.name: devour on kill
mutations.description: When you kill living creatures you have a chance to devour their life force and restore health.
level_descriptions: You thrive by killing the living.

mutations.name: otherworldly
mutations.description: You are foreign to this world, easily perceived by dark forces. You have only one-tenth the normal time on each dungeon floor before Zot finds you and permanently reduces your health.
level_descriptions: You are easily found by Zot.

mutations.name: foul shadow
mutations.description: Your body is shadowed by foul flame. Foes hit you less often, and your stealth is greatly enhanced. Foes who strike you in melee are sometimes seared by the foul flame; undead and demonic foes take less damage from it, while holy beings and good god worshippers take more.
level_descriptions: You are faintly shadowed, rarely releasing foul flame when damaged in melee.
You are shadowed, sometimes releasing foul flame when damaged in melee.
You are darkly shadowed, often releasing foul flame when damaged in melee.

mutations.name: explore regen
mutations.description: You are invigorated by the discovery of the unknown. As you explore the dungeon, your wounds will heal and your magic will replenish.
level_descriptions: You regain HP and MP as you explore.

mutations.name: faith
mutations.description: You were embalmed with holy oils and sacred spices and bound about with blessed cloth. Now you have a special connection with the divine, allowing you to gain favour with your chosen god more quickly.
level_descriptions: You have a special connection with the divine. (Faith)

mutations.name: stampede
mutations.description:
You rampage swiftly towards enemies and can continue to trample forward once you reach them, pushing entire lines of enemies backwards as you attack.

Performing any action besides a rampage movement will end your stampede.

The second level of this mutation augments your stampede with the blessing of one of the four winds, based on your highest skill:

 North Wind: Melee weapon skills (except Short Blades)
 South Wind: Short Blades or Stealth
 East Wind:  Magic skills (except Spellcasting)
 West Wind:  Ranged Weapons skill
level_descriptions: You stampede swiftly towards enemies and can push them backward.
You stampede swiftly towards enemies and can push them backward.

mutations.name: double potion healing
mutations.description: Whenever a potion restores your health or magic, it restores twice as much.
level_descriptions: You gain doubled healing and magic from potions.

mutations.name: no forms
mutations.description: You cannot voluntarily change forms, via talismans, potions, or any other means. You may still be involuntarily transformed by effects such as wands of polymorph.
level_descriptions: You cannot voluntarily change form.

mutations.name: acrobatic
mutations.description: Your magical nature helps you tumble your hollow bones around acrobatically, allowing you to evade attacks while moving or waiting.
level_descriptions: You can magically evade attacks while moving or waiting.

mutations.name: persistent drain
mutations.description: Your health recovers twice as slowly from being drained. (The total experience needed is doubled.)
level_descriptions: Your health recovers twice as slowly from being drained.

mutations.name: drunken brawling
mutations.description: Whenever you drink a potion, you perform an immediate attack against all enemies within melee range.
level_descriptions: Whenever you drink a potion, you attack all enemies around you.

mutations.name: runic magic
mutations.description:
You cast spells with the assistance of glyphs marked upon your armour, greatly reducing the complex movements which would otherwise be required.

(The encumbrance rating of all armour you wear is reduced by 1/2 for purposes of spell success.)
level_descriptions: Your spellcasting is much less encumbered by armour.

mutations.name: artefact enchanting
mutations.description:
You can use scrolls of enchant weapon and armour upon random artefacts.

This cannot raise their enchantment above what would normally be possible on a mundane item of the same type, and cannot affect especially unusual artefacts at all.
level_descriptions: You can use scrolls of enchantment on lesser artefacts.

mutations.name: off-hand wielding
mutations.description: You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a two-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. You will follow up attacks from your primary weapon with your off-hand weapon, with attack delay determined by the average of the two. Ranged weapons can only follow attacks by ranged weapons, and likewise melee weapons.
level_descriptions: You can wield a second weapon in your off-hand.

mutations.name: slow wielding
mutations.description: You must recalibrate your grasping arms when wielding or unwielding weapons. This takes as long as donning armour.
level_descriptions: It takes a long time for you to wield or remove held weapons.

mutations.name: initially attractive
mutations.description:
The first time you see a monster, it may be magically pulled toward you. This has a chance of waking sleeping monsters, though they will not necessarily be alerted to your position.

The second level of this mutation increases the chance of this happening.
level_descriptions: You sometimes pull newly seen creatures towards you.
You frequently pull newly seen creatures towards you.

mutations.name: warmup strikes
mutations.description: Your grasping arms need time to limber up, making your first few attacks in each fight less effective. Slow, heavy attacks help more than fast attacks. Both weapon-based and unarmed attacks are affected.
level_descriptions: Your first few attacks do less damage.

mutations.name: no jewellery
mutations.description: You cannot equip rings or amulets.
level_descriptions: You cannot equip rings or amulets.

mutations.name: Gehenna destruction
mutations.description: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Gehenna. You are able to hurl bolts of magma instead of cold, and your bolts of fire can strip away their victims' fire resistance.
level_descriptions: You draw destruction from the endless fires of Gehenna.

mutations.name: Cocytus destruction
mutations.description: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Cocytus. You are able to hurl bolts of ice instead of fire, and your bolts of cold freeze victims solid, slowing their movement.
level_descriptions: You draw destruction from the frigid wastes of Cocytus.

mutations.name: Tartarus destruction
mutations.description: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Tartarus. You are able to hurl bolts of devastation which lower their victims' willpower instead of lightning, and your bolts of negative energy are more powerful.
level_descriptions: You draw destruction from the wailing grief of Tartarus.

mutations.name: Dis destruction
mutations.description: Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Dis. You are able to hurl bolts of corrosive acid and metal splinters instead of negative energy.
level_descriptions: You draw destruction from the ruthless spite of Dis.

mutations.name: Mark of Haemoclasm
mutations.description:
When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of gore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.

Enemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of Haemoclasm.

mutations.name: Mark of the Legion
mutations.description:
Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Infernal Legion, allowing you to call in a small army of demons over time. While individually short-lived, their numbers are inexhaustible for as long as the status lasts, and they will never be hostile to you.

You may also unleash Makhleb's Destruction through your summoned allies without harming them.
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of the Legion.

mutations.name: Mark of Carnage
mutations.description:
Your Infernal Servants are now summoned adjacent to a random enemy instead of near you. When they appear, they do so in a blast of your characteristic Destruction (which cannot hurt you or other allies).

(Your servants unleash blasts of either {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}.)
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of Carnage.

mutations.name: Mark of Annihilation
mutations.description:
Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Globe of Annihilation, allowing you to hurl slow-moving spheres of intense destructive force that detonate in an enormous blast of your characteristic Destruction.

(Your globes of annihilation unleash either {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}.)
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of Annihilation.

mutations.name: Mark of the Tyrant
mutations.description: Your Infernal Servants have a longer duration, and you can summon even stronger ones at very high Invocations (at the cost of additional piety). When you slay enemies, a random servant may gain one of: Haste, Might, Regeneration, or Brilliance.
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of the Tyrant.

mutations.name: Mark of the Celebrant
mutations.description:
Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite, unleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. You will fire at least one arrow for every valid target, but may fire additional ones if few are present. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will always bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them.

After performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has fully recovered.
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of the Celebrant.

mutations.name: Mark of Execution
mutations.description:
A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill an enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a maelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack whenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy attack.

You have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if you spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the demonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of Execution.

mutations.name: Mark of Atrocity
mutations.description: Your Unleash Destruction is empowered the more times you use it consecutively without pause, increasing in both damage and health cost. Upon using it a fourth time in a row, you will automatically unleash a wild barrage of additional bolts aimed at random targets and reset this boost.
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of Atrocity.

mutations.name: Mark of the Fanatic
mutations.description: Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a powerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short period of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh afterward and made to fight for your freedom.
level_descriptions: You bear the Mark of the Fanatic.

mutations.name: iron-fused scales
mutations.description: Your scales are fused with a thick layer of iron, giving them resilience akin to a suit of armour (+5 AC).
level_descriptions: Your scales are fused with iron. (AC + 5)

mutations.name: inviolate magic
mutations.description: Your magic is resistant to distruption by outside forces. Hostile effects which drain your MP drain only 1/3 as much and you are immune to having your magical effects be removed by anyone but yourself.
level_descriptions: Your magical power and effects resist disruption.

mutations.name: efficient magic
mutations.description: You have both an innate understanding and a greater control over the exact flow of your magic, letting you cast spells with greater efficiency. Each level of this mutation reduces the cost of your spells by 1 MP, to a minimum of 1 MP.
level_descriptions: Spells you cast cost 1 less MP (to a minimum of 1).
Spells you cast cost 2 less MP (to a minimum of 1).

mutations.name: ephemeral shield
mutations.description: Whenever you use spells or divine abilities with any costs, a shield forms from the excess loose magical or spiritual energy to guard you. The magical energy from spells only sustains the shield for but a moment, while the spiritual energy from using divine abilities lasts a brief bit longer.
level_descriptions: A shield forms around you when casting spells or using Invocations. (SH +7)

mutations.name: time-warped blood
mutations.description: Your blood has desynchronised itself from the flow of time. Whenever you fall below 66% of your maximum HP, the spilling of your blood surges strangely through your surroundings, hasting two of your strongest allies in sight for each level of this mutation. After doing so, your blood will be unable to further dilate time until your HP has fully recovered.
level_descriptions: Your blood hastes a few of your allies when you are sufficiently damaged.
Your blood hastes several of your allies when you are sufficiently damaged.

mutations.name: no forgecraft magic
mutations.description: Your Forgecraft skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
level_descriptions: You cannot study or cast Forgecraft magic.

mutations.name: formless
mutations.description:
You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting objects. This allows you to 'equip' up to 6 boots, gloves, cloaks, or helmets in any combination, but body armour is too large for you to usefully manipulate in this fashion.

At higher levels, you can even send the armour you are haunting out to attack enemies independently for short periods of time.
level_descriptions: You can equip up to 6 pieces of aux armour in any combination.
You can equip up to 6 pieces of aux armour in any combination and unleash them.

mutations.name: trickster
mutations.description:
Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread misfortune.

Whenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby enemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. This bonus improves with the number of different enemies affected, but will decay over time if you do not continue to inflict new misfortune.

At your current XL, you can gain a maximum bonus of {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:1: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}} AC this way.
level_descriptions: You gain AC when you inflict magical misfortune on nearby enemies.

mutations.name: mnemnophage
mutations.description:
You devour the memories and even the very existence of those you kill, subsuming them in the unholy fire that wreathes your body.

Once you have accumulated enough memories, you may choose to burn them all away as fuel to greatly enhance your damage-dealing spells for a short period of time.

At your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum of {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:1: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}} spells in a row this way.

Upon first gaining this ability, you will recall a fragment of your undead origins, granting knowledge of a damage-dealing spell that can be enhanced in this way.
level_descriptions: You can enhance your damage-dealing spells by burning harvested memories.

mutations.name: spellclaws
mutations.description:
You instinctually channel destructive magic through your claws. When casting a damage-dealing spell, you also perform a melee attack against the most healthy enemy in your attack range.

This attack does reduced damage if your attack speed is slower than your casting speed.
level_descriptions: You perform a melee attack whenever you cast damage-dealing spells.

mutations.name: slime shroud
mutations.description: When struck in melee, the slimy shroud covering your body may deflect the attack. Such deflection will break the shroud, however, and it will take time for it to reconstitute itself.
level_descriptions: A fragile, slimy shroud covers you, deflecting attacks.

mutations.name: efficient metabolism
mutations.description: Your altered digestive system extracts additional value out of select potion types, doubling the duration of all status effects gained via potions.
level_descriptions: Your metabolism doubles the duration of potion status effects.

mutations.name: protean grace
mutations.description:
Your limbs are overflowing with morphogenic power, guiding your every movement. Each other non-innate mutation you have also provides +1 EV and Slay +1 (up to a limit of 7), improving your accuracy and damage with melee and ranged attacks. This still applies even when the mutations would be suppressed by a different form.

You currently gain {{[string "db_embedded_lua"]:2: attempt to index a nil value (global 'you')}}
level_descriptions: You are empowered by your non-innate mutations. (+-1 EV, Slay +-1)

mutations.name: feed off suffering
mutations.description: A vile yet invigorating energy permeates your soul, which resonates with specific other energies released at the moment of death. Whenever poisoned or drained enemies die in sight of you, you have a chance to siphon away a small portion of their life force and magical power. Each level of this mutation increases the chance this happens and the amount one siphons.
level_descriptions: You can sometimes gain power from killing poisoned or drained foes.
You can regularly gain power from killing poisoned or drained foes.

mutations.name: accursed
mutations.description: Your accursed nature makes it harder to dispel malignant energies from your being, reducing the rate at which you can recover from Doom and Banes.
level_descriptions: You recover more slowly from Doom and Banes.

mutations.name: lucky
mutations.description: You have an uncanny knack for uncovering hidden properties of items other people might ignore as mundane. Whenever you encounter a new item on the ground for the first time, there is a very tiny chance to discover that it is actually an artefact. Each level of this mutation increases that chance.
level_descriptions: You discover slightly more artefacts.
You discover more artefacts.

mutations.name: contamination susceptible
mutations.description: You absorb twice as much mutagenic energy from being contaminated.
level_descriptions: You absorb twice as much mutagenic energy from being contaminated.

mutations.name: reckless
mutations.description: Your recklessness halves your SH, but the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons is increased by 15%.
level_descriptions: Your SH is halved, but you deal more damage with two-handed weapons.

mutations.name: booming voice
mutations.description: When reading scrolls in sight of hostile monsters, your voice resounds with a truly stupendous volume.
level_descriptions: You read scrolls incredibly loudly when enemies are in sight.

mutations.name: potion fungus
mutations.description: Your body is covered in a fungus that metabolises beneficial potions you drink and sometimes emits spores which transmit their effects to nearby monsters - whether friend or foe.
level_descriptions: You may spread the effect of potions you drink to nearby monsters.

mutations.name: spiteful blood
mutations.description:
Your blood pulses with a strange predatory malice. When you become significantly injured, some of it may rise up to attack you - though this may not happen again until you heal fully.

The second level of this mutation causes two erythrospites to be created at once.
level_descriptions: Your shed blood may rise up to attack you.
Your shed blood may rise up to attack you as a group.

mutations.name: spatial entanglement
mutations.description:
Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled along to your new location. If you translocated a short distance, this will always be some monster in sight of your previous location, but long distance teleports may pull a monster from anywhere else on the floor.

The experience is mildly disorienting for the monster, and it will not be able to act immediately after being pulled this way.
level_descriptions: When you translocate, a monster is sometimes pulled along with you.

mutations.name: meek
mutations.description: All of your attacks are less effective, dealing less damage and being a little less accurate. This effect worsens with each level of this mutation.
level_descriptions: Your attacks are a little less effective. (Slay -3)
Your attacks are less effective. (Slay -5)
Your attacks are much less effective. (Slay -7)

mutations.name: North Wind's embodiment
mutations.description: You rapidly regenerate up to 70% of all damage you suffer while Stampeding. The rate of this regeneration increases with your maximum HP.
level_descriptions: The North Wind lets you shrug off injuries taken while stampeding.

mutations.name: West Wind's embodiment
mutations.description: Whenever you rampage towards foes while wielding a ranged weapon, you also fire a penetrating shot that does increased damage and your next normal attack becomes empowered to fire at multiple foes at once.
level_descriptions: The West Wind empowers your ranged attacks as you Rampage.

mutations.name: South Wind's embodiment
mutations.description: Your stealth is increased by 50% while Rampaging and whenever you successfully stab an enemy, your next Rampage movement becomes instant.
level_descriptions: The South Wind quickens your rampage movements after stabbing.

mutations.name: East Wind's embodiment
mutations.description:
Whenever you Rampage, you regain a small percentage of your maxmimum MP and unleash a bitter wind that makes all enemies within 2 spaces of you Exposed, increasing the damage they take from non-attack sources by 35% and also their chance to be hit or affected by them.

Additionally, casting spells will not cause you to stop Stampeding.
level_descriptions: The East Wind leaves your foes to susceptible to magic after you Rampage.

mutations.name: spark swarm
mutations.description: A subtle flock of eager sparks and bright cinders chases after your movements. Whenever you deal fire damage to a foe without rFire∞ or electric damage to a foe without rElec∞, you have a chance to outline it with a soft glow of light, which makes it easier to hit and reveals it if invisible. Each level of this mutation increases the chance this happens.
level_descriptions: Foes burned or shocked in your presence may be outlined in light.
Foes burned or shocked in your presence are regularly outlined in light.
